st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: Identify the five components of a data communication system.
qh: Data communication system के पाँच components की पहचान कीजिए।
o: Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission medium, Protocol
oh: Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission medium, Protocol
e: Forouzan lists exactly five components — Message (the information), Sender, Receiver, Transmission medium (the physical path) and Protocol (the rules).
eh: Forouzan में पाँच components हैं — Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission medium और Protocol।
n: 5 components: Message → Sender → Medium → Receiver + Protocol (rules). सबसे favourite exam question.
nh: 5 components: Message → Sender → Medium → Receiver + Protocol (rules)। Exam का favourite question।

st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: The _______ is the physical path over which a message travels from sender to receiver.
qh: _______ वह physical path है जिस पर message sender से receiver तक जाता है।
e: In data communication, the transmission medium is the physical path (twisted-pair, coaxial, fiber or radio waves) by which the message travels from sender to receiver. (Forouzan)
eh: Data communication में transmission medium वह physical path है (twisted-pair, coaxial, fiber या radio waves) जिस पर message sender से receiver तक जाता है। (Forouzan)
n: Medium = physical path between sender and receiver. Remember: Message -> Sender -> Medium -> Receiver.
nh: Medium = sender और receiver के बीच का physical path. याद रखें: Message -> Sender -> Medium -> Receiver.

st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: The information to be communicated in a data communication system is called the _______.
qh: Data communication system में communicate की जाने वाली information _______ कहलाती है।
e: Forouzan: The message is the data (information) to be communicated. It can be text, numbers, images, audio or video.
eh: Forouzan: Message = communicate की जाने वाली data (information). यह text, numbers, images, audio या video हो सकती है।
n: Message = the data/information to be communicated. 5 popular forms: text, numbers, images, audio, video.
nh: Message = communicate की जाने वाली data. 5 popular forms: text, numbers, images, audio, video.

st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: Which of the following shares the data of two computers?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन दो computers का data share (साझा) करता है?
e: A computer network is a set of devices (nodes) connected together mainly to share data, resources and information between computers.
eh: Computer network = devices (nodes) का ऐसा connection जो mainly computers के बीच data, resources और information share करने के लिए होता है।
n: Network = 2 or more devices connected to share data/resources.
nh: Network = 2 या ज़्यादा devices का आपस में जुड़ना, data/resources share करने के लिए।

st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: In a computer network, nodes are:
qh: Computer network में nodes होते हैं:
o: the computer that originates the data
the computer that routes the data
the computer that terminates the data
oh: जो computer data को originate (shurua) करता है
जो computer data को route करता है
जो computer data को terminate (समाप्त) करता है
e: A node is any device connected to the network. It can originate (sender), route (router/switch) or terminate (receiver) data, so all of the mentioned is correct.
eh: Node = network से जुड़ा कोई भी device. यह data को originate (sender), route (router/switch) या terminate (receiver) कर सकता है, इसलिए उपर्युक्त सभी सही हैं।
n: Node = any connected device of the network (computer, printer, router, etc.).
nh: Node = network का कोई भी connected device (computer, printer, router, आदि).

st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: _______ refers to two characteristics: when data should be sent and how fast it can be sent.
qh: _______ दो characteristics को बताता है: data कब भेजा जाए और कितनी तेज़ी से भेजा जा सकता है।
e: The three key elements of a protocol are syntax, semantics and timing. Timing refers to two characteristics: when data should be sent and how fast it can be sent. (Forouzan)
eh: Protocol के 3 key elements हैं: syntax, semantics और timing. Timing दो characteristics से जुड़ा है: data कब भेजा जाए और कितनी तेज़ी से भेजा जा सकता है। (Forouzan)
n: Protocol के 3 elements = Syntax (format), Semantics (meaning), Timing (when & how fast).
nh: Protocol के 3 elements = Syntax (format), Semantics (अर्थ), Timing (कब और कितनी तेज़ी से).

st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: Consider the statements: S1: The physical medium of connection is known as a link. S2: The computers connected to it are known as nodes.
qh: कथनों पर विचार करें: S1: connection का physical medium link कहलाता है। S2: इससे जुड़े computers nodes कहलाते हैं।
o: Both S1 and S2 are false
oh: दोनों S1 और S2 ग़लत हैं
S1 सही है लेकिन S2 ग़लत है
S1 ग़लत है लेकिन S2 सही है
दोनों S1 और S2 सही हैं
e: In networking, the physical medium connecting devices is called a link, and the connected devices (computers) are called nodes. Both statements are true.
eh: Networking में devices को जोड़ने वाला physical medium link कहलाता है, और जुड़े हुए devices (computers) nodes कहलाते हैं। दोनों कथन सही हैं।
n: Link = physical medium; Node = connected device (computer).
nh: Link = physical medium; Node = जुड़ा हुआ device (computer).

st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: What are the main elements of a protocol? 1. Syntax  2. Semantics  3. Timing
qh: किसी protocol के मुख्य तत्व (elements) क्या हैं? 1. Syntax  2. Semantics  3. Timing
e: A protocol has three key elements: syntax (data format/structure), semantics (meaning of the data) and timing (when to send and how fast).
eh: Protocol के 3 key elements हैं: syntax (data का format/structure), semantics (data का अर्थ) और timing (कब भेजना है और कितनी तेज़ी से).
n: याद रखें: Protocol = Syntax + Semantics + Timing.
nh: याद रखें: Protocol = Syntax + Semantics + Timing.

st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: Why are protocols needed in data communication?
qh: Data communication में protocols की आवश्यकता क्यों होती है?
o: To enable communication between different types of systems by providing common rules
To increase the processing speed of the CPU
To convert every message into a common language
Protocols are optional — devices can communicate without rules
oh: अलग-अलग प्रकार की systems के बीच communication के लिए common rules देना
CPU की processing speed बढ़ाने के लिए
हर message को एक common language में बदलने के लिए
Protocols optional हैं — बिना rules के भी devices communicate कर सकती हैं
e: An agreement (protocol) of rules is needed before communication can begin — without common rules, unlike devices cannot understand each other.
eh: Communication से पहले rules का agreement (protocol) ज़रूरी है — बिना common rules के devices एक-दूसरे को समझ नहीं सकतीं।
n: Protocol = agreement of rules (syntax + semantics + timing). Iske बिना communication impossible.
nh: Protocol = rules का agreement (syntax + semantics + timing)। इसके बिना communication impossible है।

st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: A set of rules that governs data communication is called a:
qh: Data communication को regulate (नियंत्रित) करने वाले rules का set _______ कहलाता है:
e: A protocol is a set of rules that governs data communication. It defines what is communicated, how it is communicated and when it is communicated. (Forouzan)
eh: Protocol = नियमों का set जो data communication को govern करता है. यह बताता है की क्या communicate होगा, कैसे होगा और कब होगा। (Forouzan)
n: Protocol = rules का set. याद रखें: without a protocol, two devices may be connected but cannot communicate.
nh: Protocol = नियमों का set. याद रखें: बिना protocol के दो devices जुड़े to हो सकते हैं लेकिन communicate नहीं कर सकते।

st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: The physical path between the sender and receiver is called:
qh: Sender और receiver के बीच का physical path _______ कहलाता है:
e: In this context, the physical medium of connection between devices is known as a link (the devices connected to it are called nodes).
eh: Is context में, devices को जोड़ने वाला physical medium link कहलाता है (is से जुड़े devices को nodes कहते हैं).
n: Note: In Forouzan's 5 components, this same physical path is called the transmission medium. Both terms mean the physical path.
nh: Note: Forouzan के 5 components में इसी physical path को transmission medium कहा गया है। दोनों का मतलब physical path ही है।

st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: Consider: (1) Twisted pair cables (2) Microwaves and satellite signals (3) Repeaters (4) Analog transmissions (5) Fiber optics. Which of the above is considered as signal transmission medium in data communications?
qh: विचार करें: (1) Twisted pair cables (2) Microwaves और satellite signals (3) Repeaters (4) Analog transmissions (5) Fiber optics। उपरोक्त में से data communications में signal transmission medium के रूप में क्या माना जाता है?
e: Twisted pair, microwaves/satellite and fiber optics are transmission media (guided and unguided). A repeater is a device (it regenerates the signal), and analog transmission is a form of signal, not a medium.
eh: Twisted pair, microwaves/satellite और fiber optics transmission media हैं (guided और unguided). Repeater एक device है (signal regenerate करता है), और analog transmission signal का एक रूप है, medium नहीं।
n: Guided media: twisted pair, coaxial, fiber. Unguided media: radio, microwave, infrared.
nh: Guided media: twisted pair, coaxial, fiber. Unguided media: radio, microwave, infrared.

st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: Data communication is the exchange of _______ between two devices via some form of transmission medium.
qh: Data communication = do devices के बीच _______ का exchange, किसी transmission medium के through।
o: data (the message) - text, numbers, images, audio or video
oh: data (message) - text, numbers, images, audio या video
e: Forouzan: Data communications is the exchange of data between two devices via some form of transmission medium. The data exchanged is called the message.
eh: Forouzan: Data communications = do devices के बीच किसी transmission medium के through data का exchange. Exchange होने वाले data को message कहते हैं।
n: Data communication = exchange of DATA (message) between two devices over a medium.
nh: Data communication = do devices के बीच DATA (message) का exchange, medium के through।

st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: Which one of the following is NOT one of the five basic components of a data communication system?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन data communication system के five basic components में से एक नहीं है?
e: The five basic components are: message, sender, receiver, transmission medium and protocol. A router is a networking device (Network layer), not one of the five fundamental components.
eh: Five basic components हैं: message, sender, receiver, transmission medium और protocol. Router एक networking device है (Network layer), five fundamental components में से नहीं।
n: याद रखें 5 components: Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol. Router = device, component नहीं।
nh: याद रखें 5 components: Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol. Router = device है, component नहीं।

st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: The device that sends the data message in a data communication system is called the _______.
qh: Data communication system में जो device data message भेजता है, use _______ कहते हैं।
e: The sender is the device (computer, workstation, mobile phone, camera, TV, etc.) that sends the data message.
eh: Sender वह device है (computer, workstation, mobile phone, camera, TV, आदि) जो data message भेजता है।
n: Sender = source device; Receiver = destination device.
nh: Sender = source device; Receiver = destination device.

st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: Which of the following best lists the popular forms of information (message) in data communication?
qh: Data communication में information (message) के popular forms को सबसे achhe से कौन बताता है?
o: Text, numbers, images, audio and video
oh: text, numbers, images, audio और video
e: Forouzan: The popular forms of information are text, numbers, images, audio, and video.
eh: Forouzan: Information के popular forms हैं text, numbers, images, audio, और video.
n: 5 popular forms of message: text, numbers, images, audio, video.
nh: Message के 5 popular forms: text, numbers, images, audio, video.

st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: ARPANET stands for:
qh: ARPANET का पूरा नाम है:
e: ARPANET = Advanced Research Projects Agency Network — अमेरिकी रक्षा विभाग की ARPA द्वारा बनाया गया विश्व का पहला packet-switching network.
eh: ARPANET = Advanced Research Projects Agency Network — अमेरिकी रक्षा विभाग की ARPA द्वारा बनाया गया विश्व का पहला packet-switching network.
n: This is the network on which TCP/IP was later installed — the grandmother of the Internet.
nh: यही वह network है जिस पर TCP/IP बाद में लगाया गया — Internet की दादी.

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: What does jitter refer to in data communication?
qh: Data communication में jitter का मतलब क्या होता है?
e: Jitter is the variation in packet arrival time. It is the uneven delay in the delivery of audio or video packets (e.g., video packets sent every 30 ms but arriving with 30 ms and 40 ms delays). (Forouzan)
eh: Jitter = packets के पहुँचने के समय में अंतर (variation). यह audio या video packets की delivery में uneven delay है (जैसे video packets हर 30 ms पर bheje जाते हैं लेकिन 30 ms और 40 ms के delay से pahunchte हैं). (Forouzan)
n: Jitter = uneven delay in packet arrival -> distorted audio/video playback.
nh: Jitter = packet पहुँचने में uneven delay -> audio/video playback ख़राब हो जाती है।

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: Which of the following is a characteristic of data communication?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन data communication की एक characteristic (विशेषता) है?
e: The four fundamental characteristics of effective data communication are delivery, accuracy, timeliness and jitter. Timeliness means data must be delivered in a timely manner; data delivered late is useless.
eh: Effective data communication की 4 fundamental characteristics हैं: delivery, accuracy, timeliness और jitter. Timeliness का मतलब है data time पर pahunchna; देर से पहुँचने वाला data बेकार है।
n: 4 characteristics याद रखो: Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter.
nh: 4 characteristics याद रखो: Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter.

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: Accuracy in data communication means:
qh: Data communication में accuracy का अर्थ है:
oh: data तेज़ी से भेजा जाता है
e: Accuracy means the system must deliver the data accurately. Data that has been altered in transmission and left uncorrected is useless.
eh: Accuracy का मतलब है system data को accurately (सही) पहुँचाए. जो data transmission में बदल गया और सुधारा नहीं गया, बेकार है।
n: Accuracy = error-free data; altered/corrupted data is useless.
nh: Accuracy = error-free data; बदल गया/corrupt data बेकार है।

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: What is the maximum data rate of a transmission medium known as?
qh: Transmission medium की अधिकतम data rate को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Bandwidth is the maximum data rate (transmission capacity) of a communication channel/medium, usually measured in bits per second (bps).
eh: Bandwidth = किसी communication channel/medium की अधिकतम data rate (transmission capacity) है, जिसे आम तौर पर bits per second (bps) में मापा जाता है।
n: Bandwidth = maximum capacity of the channel (in bps). Throughput = actual rate achieved (usually less).
nh: Bandwidth = channel की अधिकतम capacity (bps में). Throughput = वास्तविक रूप से हासिल होने वाली rate (आम तौर पर कम).

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: Speed of an internet connection is measured in:
qh: Internet connection की speed किसमें मापी जाती है?
e: Data transmission speed (data rate / bandwidth) is measured in bits per second — kbps, Mbps or Gbps — not bytes and not metres.
eh: Data transmission speed (data rate / bandwidth) bits per second में मापी जाती है — kbps, Mbps या Gbps — bytes में नहीं, metres में नहीं।
n: Speed = bits per second (bps family). KB/s (bytes) is for file-size/download display — exam answer is kbps.
nh: Speed = bits per second (bps family)। KB/s (bytes) file-size/download display के लिए है — exam का answer kbps है।

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: Frequency of failure and network recovery time after a failure are measures of the _______ of a network.
qh: Failure की आवृत्ति (frequency) और failure के बाद network recovery time किस चीज़ के measures हैं?
e: Reliability is measured by the frequency of failure (how often the network fails), the time it takes to recover after a failure, and robustness in a catastrophe. (Forouzan)
eh: Reliability को failure की frequency (network कितनी बार fail होता है), failure के बाद recover होने का time, और catastrophe में robustness से मापा जाता है। (Forouzan)
n: Reliability = failure frequency + recovery time + robustness. Performance = transit time, response time, throughput, delay.
nh: Reliability = failure frequency + recovery time + robustness. Performance = transit time, response time, throughput, delay.

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: An unauthorized user is a network _______ issue.
qh: An unauthorized user एक network _______ issue है.
e: Security means protecting data from unauthorized access, protecting data from damage, and ensuring confidentiality and data integrity. An unauthorized user is a security issue.
eh: Security का मतलब है data को unauthorized access से bachana, damage से bachana, और confidentiality और data integrity sunishchit करना। Unauthorized user एक security issue है।
n: Security = unauthorized access से बचाव + confidentiality + integrity (CIA triad).
nh: Security = unauthorized access से बचाव + confidentiality + integrity (CIA triad).

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: What is the criteria to check the reliability of a network? 1. Downtime  2. Failure Frequency  3. Fault Tolerance  4. Security
qh: Network की reliability check करने के criteria क्या हैं? 1. Downtime  2. Failure Frequency  3. Fault Tolerance  4. Security
e: Reliability is measured by downtime/frequency of failure, recovery time and fault tolerance (robustness). Security is a separate criterion of a network, not a reliability measure.
eh: Reliability को downtime/failure frequency, recovery time और fault tolerance (robustness) से मापा जाता है। Security एक अलग criterion है, reliability measure नहीं।
n: 3 network criteria: Performance, Reliability, Security. Reliability = failure frequency + recovery time + fault tolerance.
nh: 3 network criteria: Performance, Reliability, Security. Reliability = failure frequency + recovery time + fault tolerance.

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: What are the three criteria necessary for an effective and efficient network?
qh: Effective और efficient network के लिए आवश्यक तीन criteria क्या हैं?
e: Forouzan: an effective network must satisfy three criteria — Performance (throughput/delay), Reliability (failure frequency/downtime) and Security (protection from unauthorised access).
eh: Forouzan: network के तीन criteria — Performance, Reliability और Security।
n: Network के 3 CRITERIA = Performance, Reliability, Security. Data communication के 4 CHARACTERISTICS = Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter. दोनों को confuse मत करना!
nh: Network के 3 criteria = Performance, Reliability, Security। Data communication के 4 characteristics = Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter।

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: Which physical layer impairment mainly causes jitter in VoIP traffic?
qh: VoIP traffic में jitter का मुख्य kaaran कौन सा physical layer impairment है?
e: Jitter is caused by delay variation: packets experience different queuing/transmission delays, so they arrive at uneven intervals, distorting real-time VoIP/video.
eh: Jitter delay variation से होता है: packets को अलग-अलग queuing/transmission delays milte हैं, इसलिए वह uneven intervals पर pahunchte हैं, जिससे real-time VoIP/video ख़राब होता है।
n: Jitter = delay variation. Attenuation = signal weakening; distortion = signal shape change; crosstalk = interference from nearby cables.
nh: Jitter = delay variation. Attenuation = signal की shakti कम होना; distortion = signal का रूप badalna; crosstalk = पास की cables से interference.

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: What network property is achieved through the use of the Automatic Repeat reQuest (ARQ) mechanism?
qh: Automatic Repeat reQuest (ARQ) mechanism से network की कौन सी property हासिल होती है?
e: ARQ (Automatic Repeat reQuest) is an error-control mechanism: lost/corrupted frames are retransmitted, so reliable data transfer is achieved. Reliability is thus the property achieved.
eh: ARQ (Automatic Repeat reQuest) एक error-control mechanism है: khoye/corrupt frames दोबारा bheje जाते हैं, जिससे reliable data transfer होता है। इसलिए reliability property हासिल होती है।
n: ARQ = error control -> Reliability. Flow control = efficient delivery (no overflow).
nh: ARQ = error control -> Reliability. Flow control = efficient delivery (receiver का buffer overflow नहीं होना).

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: For effective data communication, the system must deliver data to the correct destination. This characteristic is called _______.
qh: Effective data communication के लिए system को data सही destination पर पहुँचाना चाहिए। Is characteristic को _______ कहते हैं।
e: Delivery: the system must deliver data to the correct destination. Data must be received by the intended device or user and only by that device or user. (Forouzan)
eh: Delivery: system को data सही destination पर पहुँचाना चाहिए। Data सिर्फ usi intended device/user को pahunchna चाहिए जिस के लिए है। (Forouzan)
n: 4 characteristics: Delivery (right destination), Accuracy (error-free), Timeliness (on time), Jitter (even delay).
nh: 4 characteristics: Delivery (सही jagah), Accuracy (error-free), Timeliness (time पर), Jitter (even delay).

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: Data delivered late is useless (especially in real-time audio/video). Delivering data in a timely manner is called _______.
qh: देर से पहुँचने वाला data बेकार है (ख़ास कर real-time audio/video में)। Time पर data pahunchane को _______ कहते हैं।
e: Timeliness: the system must deliver data in a timely manner. Data delivered late is useless. For video/audio, timely delivery means delivering data as they are produced, in the same order, without significant delay (real-time transmission). (Forouzan)
eh: Timeliness: system को data time पर पहुँचाना चाहिए। देर से पहुँचने वाला data बेकार है। Video/audio के लिए timely delivery का मतलब है data जिस तरह produce हुए हैं usi तरह, बिना किसी बड़े delay के पहुँचाना (real-time transmission). (Forouzan)
n: Timeliness = on-time delivery; late data is useless -> real-time transmission (audio/video).
nh: Timeliness = time पर पहुँचाना; देर वाला data बेकार है -> real-time transmission (audio/video).

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: The network criterion measured by transit time, response time, throughput and delay is called _______.
qh: Transit time, response time, throughput और delay से maape jane वाले network criterion को _______ कहते हैं।
e: Performance of a network is measured by transit time (time for a message to travel from one device to another), response time (time between request and response), throughput and delay. (Forouzan)
eh: Network की performance को transit time (एक device से दूसरे तक message पहुँचने का time), response time (request और response के बीच का time), throughput और delay से मापा जाता है। (Forouzan)
n: Performance = transit time + response time (throughput & delay are related measures).
nh: Performance = transit time + response time (throughput और delay isse जुड़े measures हैं).

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: Which of the following is NOT one of the three fundamental criteria (properties) that a network must meet?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन network के तीन fundamental criteria (properties) में से एक नहीं है?
e: Forouzan: a network must meet certain criteria; the most important are performance, reliability, and security. Topology is a structure/arrangement, not one of the three criteria.
eh: Forouzan: एक network को कुछ criteria पूरे करने चाहिए; सबसे ज़रूरी हैं performance, reliability और security. Topology एक structure/arrangement है, तीन criteria में से नहीं।
n: Network criteria = 3: Performance, Reliability, Security.
nh: Network criteria = 3: Performance, Reliability, Security.

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: The capacity of a communication channel is measured in:
qh: Communication channel की क्षमता मापी जाती है:
e: A channel's capacity is measured as bandwidth — how many frequencies/bits per second are possible.
eh: Channel की क्षमता यानी bandwidth मापी जाती है — कितनी आवृत्तियाँ/bits प्रति सेकंड संभव हैं.
n: Channel capacity ↔ bandwidth (Hz या bps) — यही standard इकाई है.
nh: Channel capacity ↔ bandwidth (Hz या bps) — यही standard इकाई है.

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: Consider a 100 Mbps link between an earth station (sender) and a satellite (receiver) at an altitude of 2100 km. The signal propagates at 3×10⁸ m/s. The time taken (in milliseconds, rounded to two decimal places) for the receiver to completely receive a 1000-byte packet transmitted by the sender is ______.
qh: 100 Mbps के link पर earth station से 2100 km ऊँचे satellite को 1000-byte packet भेजा गया; signal की speed 3×10⁸ m/s है। Receiver को packet पूरा मिलने में लगा समय (ms में, दो दशमलव) कितना है?
e: Transmission time = 8000 bits ÷ 10⁸ bps = 0.08 ms; propagation time = 2100×10³ m ÷ 3×10⁸ m/s = 7 ms; total = 7.08 ms — link ki poori latency transmission aur propagation dono ka yog hota hai.
eh: Transmission time = 8000 ÷ 10⁸ = 0.08 ms; propagation = 2100×10³ ÷ 3×10⁸ = 7 ms; kul = 7.08 ms — dono delay milte hain.
n: Round-off trap: 2.10 sirf propagation ka fraction pakadta hai; 7.00 transmission time bhool jata hai.
nh: Round-off jaal: 2.10 sirf propagation; 7.00 mein transmission time chhoot jata hai.

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: What is the bit rate for transmitting an uncompressed 800×600 pixel colour frame with 8 bits/pixel at 40 frames per second?
qh: बिना compression के 800×600 pixel वाला colour frame (8 bits/pixel) 40 frames per second पर transmit हो — bit rate कितना होगा?
e: 800×600×8 bits × 40 = 153,600,000 bps = 153.6 Mbps — frame ke total bits ko frame rate se guna karo.
eh: 800×600×8 × 40 = 15,36,00,000 bps = 153.6 Mbps — frame ke bits × frame rate.
n: Decimal shift jaal: 15.36 aur 1536 bas decimal ki galti hain; 2.4 Mbps sirf pixel count se bina bits aur frames ke nikla hai.
nh: Decimal ki galtiyan: 15.36/1536; 2.4 Mbps bits aur frames bhool kar aata hai.

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: An analog signal carries 4 bits in each signal unit. If 1000 signal units are sent per second, then the baud rate and bit rate of the signal are ______ and ______.
qh: एक analog signal हर signal unit में 4 bits रखता है। 1000 signal units per second भेजे जाएँ तो signal की baud rate और bit rate क्रमशः कितनी होगी?
e: Baud rate = signal units per second = 1000 bauds; bit rate = baud × bits per unit = 1000×4 = 4000 bps — baud rate signalling speed hai, bit rate data speed.
eh: Baud rate = 1000 signals/sec = 1000 bauds; bit rate = 1000×4 = 4000 bps — baud signal ki speed, bit rate data ki.
n: Dono ko same mat samjho: 4000 bauds/4000 bps confusion hai; 4000 bauds/1000 bps ulta ratio hai.
nh: Dono alag hain: 4000/4000 confusion; 4000/1000 ulta hai.

st: Section C - Transmission Mode (Direction of Data Flow: Simplex, Half-Duplex, Full-Duplex)
q: Which of the following transmission directions listed is not a legitimate channel?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा transmission direction एक legitimate (vaidh) channel नहीं है?
e: The three legitimate directions of data flow are simplex (one way only), half-duplex (both ways, one at a time) and full-duplex (both ways simultaneously). Double duplex is not a stअंदरd term.
eh: Data flow के तीन legitimate directions हैं: simplex (एक ही तरफ़), half-duplex (दोनों तरफ़, एक समय में एक), full-duplex (दोनों तरफ़, एक साथ). Double duplex कोई stअंदरd term नहीं है।
n: 3 transmission modes: Simplex, Half-Duplex, Full-Duplex. Double duplex = गलत.
nh: 3 transmission modes: Simplex, Half-Duplex, Full-Duplex. Double duplex = गलत है।

st: Section C - Transmission Mode (Direction of Data Flow: Simplex, Half-Duplex, Full-Duplex)
q: Communication between a computer and a keyboard involves ______________ transmission.
qh: Computer और keyboard के बीच communication में ______________ transmission होता है।
e: A keyboard only sends data to the computer; the computer does not send data back to the keyboard. So the communication is unidirectional = simplex.
eh: Keyboard सिर्फ computer को data भेजता है; computer keyboard को data wapas नहीं भेजता. इसलिए communication एक ही direction में है = simplex.
n: Keyboard -> Computer = simplex (one way). Examples: keyboard-monitor, TV broadcast.
nh: Keyboard -> Computer = simplex (एक तरफ़). Examples: keyboard-monitor, TV broadcast.

st: Section C - Transmission Mode (Direction of Data Flow: Simplex, Half-Duplex, Full-Duplex)
q: A television broadcast is an example of _______ transmission.
qh: Television broadcast _______ transmission का एक example है।
e: TV broadcast is unidirectional: the TV station only transmits and the TV set only receives. One direction only = simplex.
eh: TV broadcast एक direction का है: TV station सिर्फ transmit करता है और TV set सिर्फ receive करता है। Ek ही direction = simplex.
n: TV/radio broadcast = simplex (station -> TV only, wapas नहीं).
nh: TV/radio broadcast = simplex (station -> TV ही, wapas नहीं).

st: Section C - Transmission Mode (Direction of Data Flow: Simplex, Half-Duplex, Full-Duplex)
q: What is the mode of transmission where data flows in only one direction?
qh: Wo transmission mode kaunsa है जिसमें data सिर्फ एक direction में flow करता है?
e: Simplex: communication is unidirectional, like a one-way street. Only one of the two devices on a link can transmit; the other can only receive. (Forouzan)
eh: Simplex: communication एक ही direction का होता है, जैसे one-way street. Link के दो devices में से सिर्फ एक transmit कर सकता है; दूसरा सिर्फ receive करता है। (Forouzan)
n: Simplex = one-way only (keyboard to monitor, TV broadcast).
nh: Simplex = सिर्फ एक तरफ़ (keyboard to monitor, TV broadcast).

st: Section C - Transmission Mode (Direction of Data Flow: Simplex, Half-Duplex, Full-Duplex)
q: Which transmission mode is used in walkie-talkie communication?
qh: Walkie-talkie communication में कौन सा transmission mode use होता है?
e: A walkie-talkie is the classic example of half-duplex: both sides can talk, but only one at a time (push-to-talk). (Forouzan)
eh: Walkie-talkie half-duplex का classic example है: दोनों तरफ़ baat कर सकते हैं, लेकिन एक समय में सिर्फ एक (push-to-talk). (Forouzan)
n: Walkie-talkie = half-duplex (push-to-talk, एक समय में एक ही bolega).
nh: Walkie-talkie = half-duplex (push-to-talk, एक समय में एक ही bolega).

st: Section C - Transmission Mode (Direction of Data Flow: Simplex, Half-Duplex, Full-Duplex)
q: What is the difference between half-duplex and full-duplex transmission modes?
qh: Half-Duplex और Full-Duplex transmission modes में अंतर क्या है?
o: Half-duplex allows only one-way flow; full-duplex also allows only one-way flow
Half-duplex flows both ways one direction at a time; full-duplex flows both ways at the same time
Half-duplex is only for wireless; full-duplex only for wired networks
There is no difference between the two
oh: Half-Duplex में सिर्फ one-way flow; Full-Duplex में भी सिर्फ one-way flow
Half-Duplex में data दोनों तरफ़ पर एक समय में एक direction; Full-Duplex में एक साथ दोनों तरफ़
Half-Duplex सिर्फ wireless के लिए; Full-Duplex सिर्फ wired के लिए
दोनों में कोई अंतर नहीं है
e: Half-duplex = both directions, one at a time (walkie-talkie). Full-duplex = both directions simultaneously (telephone).
eh: Half-Duplex = दोनों direction, पर एक समय में एक (walkie-talkie)। Full-Duplex = एक साथ दोनों direction (telephone)।
n: Half = एक time पर एक ही side (walkie-talkie). Full = दोनों side एक साथ (telephone).
nh: Half = एक समय में एक side (walkie-talkie)। Full = दोनों side एक साथ (telephone)।

st: Section C - Transmission Mode (Direction of Data Flow: Simplex, Half-Duplex, Full-Duplex)
q: Data flow between two devices can occur in a _______ way.
qh: Do devices के बीच data flow _______ tareeke से हो सकता है।
e: Data flow between two devices can be simplex (one way), half-duplex (both ways, one at a time) or full-duplex (both ways at the same time). Hence all of the above.
eh: Do devices के बीच data flow simplex (एक तरफ़), half-duplex (दोनों तरफ़, एक समय में एक) या full-duplex (दोनों तरफ़, एक साथ) हो सकता है। इसलिए ऊपर सभी सही हैं।
n: 3 ways of data flow: simplex, half-duplex, full-duplex.
nh: Data flow के 3 tareeke: simplex, half-duplex, full-duplex.

st: Section C - Transmission Mode (Direction of Data Flow: Simplex, Half-Duplex, Full-Duplex)
q: In a telephone conversation, both persons can speak and hear each other at the same time. This is an example of _______.
qh: Telephone conversation में दोनों persons एक साथ bol और sun सकते हैं। यह _______ का example है।
e: Full-duplex: both stations can transmit and receive simultaneously. The telephone network is Forouzan's example of full-duplex.
eh: Full-duplex: दोनों stations एक साथ transmit और receive कर सकते हैं। Telephone network full-duplex का Forouzan का example है।
n: Telephone = full-duplex (दोनों एक साथ bol और sun सकते हैं).
nh: Telephone = full-duplex (दोनों एक साथ bol और sun सकते हैं).

st: Section C - Transmission Mode (Direction of Data Flow: Simplex, Half-Duplex, Full-Duplex)
q:
Which of the following statements are TRUE?
1. Hubs operate in Half-Duplex mode.
2. Switches operate in Full-Duplex mode.
3. Routers broadcast by default.
qh:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन से statements TRUE हैं?
1. Hubs Half-Duplex mode में काम करते हैं।
2. Switches Full-Duplex mode में काम करते हैं।
3. Routers by default broadcast करते हैं।
e: Statement 1 TRUE: a hub shares one collision domain and works in half-duplex. Statement 2 TRUE: a switch gives each port its own collision domain and supports full-duplex. Statement 3 FALSE: routers do NOT forward broadcasts by default (each router port = separate broadcast domain).
eh: Statement 1 TRUE: hub एक collision domain share करता है, Half-Duplex में काम करता है। Statement 2 TRUE: switch हर port को अलग collision domain देता है, Full-Duplex support करता है। Statement 3 FALSE: routers by default broadcasts forward नहीं करते।
n: Hub = half-duplex + एक collision domain; Switch = full-duplex + per-port collision domain; Router = broadcasts rokta है.
nh: Hub = Half-Duplex + एक collision domain; Switch = Full-Duplex + per-port collision domain; Router = broadcasts रोकता है।

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: What are the advantages of star topology?
qh: Star topology के क्या advantages (लाभ) हैं?
o: Less number of cables are required
More number of cables are required
e: In a star topology, each device has a dedicated point-to-point link only to a central hub, so far fewer cables are required than in a mesh. It is also easy to install and reconfigure.
eh: Star topology में हर device का सिर्फ central hub से dedicated point-to-point link होता है, इसलिए mesh की tulna में kaafi कम cables चाहिए. इसे install और reconfigure करना भी आसान है।
n: Star = hub at centre, dedicated links, fewer cables (vs mesh), easy to install. But if hub fails, whole network goes down.
nh: Star = centre में hub, dedicated links, कम cables (mesh के muqable), install करना आसान. लेकिन hub fail हो गया toh पूरा network band हो जाता है।

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: Which type of topology is best suited for large businesses which must carefully control and coordinate the operation of distributed branch outlets?
qh: Large businesses के लिए कौन सी topology सबसे उपयुक्त है, jahan distributed branch outlets के operation को carefully control और coordinate करना हो?
e: A hierarchical (tree) topology is best for large organisations with distributed branch outlets because it is a hierarchy of stars and allows central control and coordination at each level.
eh: Hierarchical (tree) topology large organisations के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त है jahan distributed branch outlets hon, क्योंकि यह stars की hierarchy है और हर level पर central control/coordination की अनुमति देती है।
n: Tree = hierarchical star. Large orgs with branches -> hierarchical/tree topology.
nh: Tree = hierarchical star. Badi sansthaon में branches के लिए -> hierarchical/tree topology.

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: Which one of the following is not a network topology?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक network topology नहीं है?
e: Star, ring and bus are physical topologies. Peer-to-peer is a network architecture (how devices share resources), not a topology.
eh: Star, ring और bus physical topologies हैं। Peer-to-peer एक network architecture है (devices कैसे resources share karenge), topology नहीं।
n: Topologies = mesh, star, bus, ring, hybrid, tree. P2P = architecture (not topology).
nh: Topologies = mesh, star, bus, ring, hybrid, tree. P2P = architecture है (topology नहीं).

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: In a traditional ring network, repeaters are particularly associated with which topology because each station can regenerate and forward the signal?
qh: पारंपरिक ring network में repeaters किस topology से विशेष रूप से जुड़े हैं, क्योंकि हर station signal को regenerate और आगे भेज सकता है?
e: In a classic/traditional ring, each station commonly regenerates (repeats) the incoming signal before passing it to the next station — repeaters are thus built into the ring model.
eh: पारंपरिक ring में हर station आने वाले signal को अगले station को देने से पहले regenerate (repeat) करता है — इसलिए ring model में repeaters अंतर्निहित हैं।
n: Concept-check correction of the old "repeater is used in ___ topology" stem (that wording wrongly implied repeaters are exclusive to one topology). Repeaters are Physical-layer devices usable on many links; the "traditional ring network" qualifier keeps the intended textbook answer (Ring) without the false universal claim. Not a verified PYQ.
nh: पुराने "repeater किस topology में" वाले प्रश्न का सुधार — repeater Physical-layer device है, हर link पर चलता है; "पारंपरिक ring" जोड़ने से अभीष्ट उत्तर (Ring) बना रहता है। यह सत्यापित PYQ नहीं है।

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: What type of topology connects each node in a closed loop?
qh: कौन सी topology हर node को एक closed loop में जोड़ती है?
e: In a ring topology, each device is connected to its two neighbours (one on each side), forming a closed loop. Data travels in one direction and each device regenerates the signal (token passing).
eh: Ring topology में हर device अपने दोनों neighbours से जुड़ा होता है (एक दोनों तरफ़), जिससे एक closed loop बनता है। Data एक ही direction में जाता है और हर device signal को regenerate करता है (token passing).
n: Ring = closed loop, one direction, token passing, each device = repeater.
nh: Ring = closed loop, एक direction, token passing, हर device = repeater.

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: In a _______ topology, every device has a dedicated point-to-point link to every other device. For n devices, the number of links is n(n-1)/2 and each device needs n-1 I/O ports.
qh: _______ topology में हर device का हर दूसरे device से dedicated point-to-point link होता है। n devices के लिए links की संख्या n(n-1)/2 होती है और हर device को n-1 I/O ports चाहिए।
e: Mesh: every device has a dedicated point-to-point link to every other device. Number of links = n(n-1)/2; each device needs n-1 I/O ports. (Forouzan)
eh: Mesh: हर device का हर दूसरे device से dedicated point-to-point link होता है। Links की संख्या = n(n-1)/2; हर device को n-1 I/O ports चाहिए। (Forouzan)
n: Mesh formula (EXAM favourite): links = n(n-1)/2, ports per device = n-1. E.g., 5 devices -> 10 links.
nh: Mesh formula (EXAM favourite): links = n(n-1)/2, हर device के ports = n-1. Jaise 5 devices -> 10 links.

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: For n devices in a network, how many cable links are required in a mesh topology?
qh: Network में n devices के लिए mesh topology में कितने cable links चाहिए?
e: In a mesh every device has a dedicated point-to-point link to every other device, so links = n(n-1)/2 (each link is shared by two devices).
eh: Mesh में हर device का हर दूसरे device तक dedicated point-to-point link होता है, इसलिए links = n(n-1)/2।
n: Mesh cables = n(n-1)/2, ports/device = n-1. Star = n cables. Ring = n. Bus = 1 backbone.
nh: Mesh cables = n(n-1)/2, ports/device = n-1। Star = n। Ring = n। Bus = 1।

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: Six devices are arranged in a mesh topology. How many cables are needed, and how many ports does each device need?
qh: छह devices को mesh topology में जोड़ा गया है। कितनी cables चाहिए और हर device को कितने ports चाहिए?
e: Links = n(n-1)/2 = 6×5/2 = 15 cables. Each device connects to the other 5 devices, so each needs n-1 = 5 ports.
eh: Links = n(n-1)/2 = 6×5/2 = 15 cables। हर device बाकी 5 devices से जुड़ता है, इसलिए ports = 5।
n: Mesh formula: cables = n(n-1)/2, ports/device = n-1. Numerical में हमेशा yahi do numbers maange जाते हैं.
nh: Mesh: cables = n(n-1)/2, ports/device = n-1। Numerical में यही दो numbers पूछे जाते हैं।

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: If a computer network cable breaks, the whole network goes down in which topology?
qh: यदि computer network cable टूट जाए, तो किस topology में पूरा network बंद हो जाता है?
e: In a Ring topology every device is connected to its two neighbours in a closed loop — one cable break opens the ring, so the whole network goes down.
eh: Ring topology में हर device अपने दो neighbours से बंद loop में जुड़ा होता है — एक cable टूटने से ring खुल जाती है, इसलिए पूरा network बंद हो जाता है।
n: Ring = one break downs ALL. Star = only that device drops. Mesh = network survives (many paths).
nh: Ring = एक break से सब down। Star = सिर्फ वह device गिरता है। Mesh = network बच जाता है (कई paths)।

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: In which topology does the failure of a single cable or device NOT affect the rest of the network?
qh: किस topology में एक cable या device के fail होने पर बाकी network प्रभावित नहीं होता?
e: In a mesh, redundant links exist — if one link/device fails, traffic takes another path, so the rest of the network keeps working. In bus/ring a cable failure breaks the whole network; in star the hub is a single point of failure.
eh: Mesh में redundant links होती हैं — एक link/device fail होने पर traffic दूसरे रास्ते से चलता है। Bus/ring में cable failure पूरा network तोड़ देता है; star में hub single point of failure है।
n: Mesh = most fault-tolerant (redundant paths) — इसलिए 'highest robustness' mesh में होती है.
nh: Mesh = सबसे ज़्यादा fault-tolerant (redundant paths) — इसीलिए mesh most robust है।

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: In a _______ topology, each device has a dedicated point-to-point link only to a central controller, usually called a hub (or switch).
qh: _______ topology में हर device का सिर्फ एक central controller (hub/switch) से dedicated point-to-point link होता है।
e: Star: each device has a dedicated point-to-point link only to a central controller, usually called a hub. The hub relays frames to the destination. (Forouzan)
eh: Star: हर device का सिर्फ एक central controller (usually hub) से dedicated point-to-point link होता है। Hub frames को destination तक relay करता है। (Forouzan)
n: Star = hub/switch at centre; easy to install & reconfigure; but if hub fails, the WHOLE network goes down.
nh: Star = centre में hub/switch; install और reconfigure करना आसान; लेकिन hub fail हो गया तो पूरा network बंद हो जाता है।

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: In a _______ topology, one long cable acts as a backbone to link all the devices; devices connect via drop lines and taps, and terminators are needed at both ends of the backbone.
qh: _______ topology में एक लंबा cable backbone की तरह सभी devices को जोड़ता है; devices drop lines और taps से connect होते हैं, और backbone के दोनों ends पर terminators चाहिए।
e: Bus: one long cable acts as a backbone to link all the devices. Nodes are connected to the bus cable by drop lines and taps. Terminators at both ends absorb the signal to prevent reflection. (Forouzan)
eh: Bus: एक लंबा cable backbone की तरह सभी devices को जोड़ता है। Nodes को bus cable से drop lines और taps के through जोड़ा जाता है। दोनों ends पर terminators signal को absorb करते हैं ताकि reflection na हो। (Forouzan)
n: Bus = one backbone + drop lines + taps + terminators at both ends. Fault isolation is difficult; a backbone break stops everything.
nh: Bus = एक backbone + drop lines + taps + दोनों ends पर terminators. Fault isolation मुश्किल है; backbone tootne से सब कुछ band हो जाता है।

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: Which network topology requires a multipoint connection?
qh: किस network topology में multipoint connection की आवश्यकता होती है?
e: In a bus topology one long cable acts as a backbone and three or more devices share it — a multipoint connection. Mesh, star and ring use point-to-point links.
eh: Bus topology में एक long cable backbone बनती है और तीन+ devices उसे share करती हैं — यही multipoint connection है। Mesh, star, ring point-to-point links use करते हैं।
n: Bus = multipoint (shared backbone). Mesh/Star/Ring = point-to-point links. Yahi difference exam में poochha जाता है.
nh: Bus = multipoint (shared backbone)। Mesh/Star/Ring = point-to-point links।

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: In a _______ topology, each device is connected to its two neighbours, data travels in one direction around the loop, and each device regenerates (repeats) the signal - this is called token passing.
qh: _______ topology में हर device अपने दो neighbours से जुड़ा होता है, data loop में एक ही direction में जाता है, और हर device signal को regenerate (repeat) करता है - इसे token passing कहते हैं।
e: Ring: each device is connected to its two neighbours. Data travels in one direction. Each device in the ring incorporates a repeater; it regenerates the bits and passes them along. Access is typically by token passing. (Forouzan)
eh: Ring: हर device अपने दो neighbours से जुड़ा होता है। Data एक ही direction में जाता है। Ring का हर device एक repeater की तरह काम करता है; यह bits को regenerate करके आगे pass करता है। Access आम तौर पर token passing से होता है। (Forouzan)
n: Ring = loop, one direction, token passing, each device = repeater.
nh: Ring = loop, एक direction, token passing, हर device = repeater.

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: A network in which two or more different topologies are combined (e.g., a star connected to another star) is called a _______ topology, while a _______ topology is a hierarchy of stars (a variation of the star topology).
qh: जिसमें do या ज़्यादा अलग topologies combine हो (जैसे एक star दूसरे star से जुड़ा हो), use _______ topology कहते हैं, और _______ topology stars की hierarchy है (star topology का variation).
e: Hybrid = a combination of two or more different topologies (e.g., a star of stars). Tree = a hierarchical arrangement of stars, a variation of the star topology.
eh: Hybrid = do या ज़्यादा अलग topologies का combination है (जैसे star of stars). Tree = stars की hierarchical arrangement है, star topology का एक variation.
n: Hybrid = mix of topologies; Tree = star of stars (hierarchical star).
nh: Hybrid = topologies का mix; Tree = star of stars (hierarchical star).

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: Hierarchical topology, used to establish a network, is also known as a:
qh: Hierarchical topology, जिससे network स्थापित किया जाता है, किस नाम से भी जानी जाती है?
e: A hierarchical (tree) topology connects groups of computers to a central computer (root/hub) and then links those groups in a tree-like structure — a star of stars.
eh: Hierarchical (tree) topology computers के groups को एक central computer (root/hub) से जोड़ती है, और फिर उन groups को tree जैसी structure में जोड़ती है — star of stars।
n: Hierarchical = Tree = star-of-stars (root + branches). Used in big office/campus LANs.
nh: Hierarchical = Tree = star-of-stars (root + branches)। बड़े office/campus LANs में use होती है।

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: The ______ topology of a network defines how the devices are physically laid out/connected, whereas the ______ topology defines how the data actually flow / how the devices access the network to transmit.
qh: Network की _______ topology बताती है की devices physically कैसे जुड़े हैं, jabki _______ topology बताती है की data asal में कैसे flow करता है / devices transmit करने के लिए network को कैसे access करते हैं।
e: Physical topology = the actual layout of devices and cables. Logical topology = the way data flows / how devices access the medium. Two networks can have the same logical topology but different physical topologies.
eh: Physical topology = devices और cables का वास्तविक layout. Logical topology = data कैसे flow करता है / devices medium को कैसे access करते हैं। दो networks की logical topology same हो सकती है लेकिन physical अलग हो सकती है।
n: Physical = कैसे जुड़े (cables); Logical = data कैसे flow करता है (access). Same logical, different physical possible.
nh: Physical = कैसे जुड़े (cables); Logical = data कैसे flow करता है (access). Same logical, different physical हो सकता है।

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: The IEEE 802 stअंदरds (such as 802.3 for Ethernet, 802.5 for Token Ring, 802.11 for Wi-Fi) primarily define the ______ of LANs/MANs.
qh: IEEE 802 stअंदरds (जैसे 802.3 Ethernet, 802.5 Token Ring, 802.11 Wi-Fi) primarily LANs/MANs की _______ define करते हैं।
o: Physical and Data Link layers (including the logical topology / MAC)
oh: Physical और Data Link layers (logical topology / MAC sahit)
e: IEEE 802 is the family of stअंदरds for LANs and MANs; it covers the Physical layer and the Data Link layer (split into LLC - 802.2 - and MAC sublayers). 802.3 = Ethernet, 802.5 = Token Ring, 802.11 = Wireless LAN. The logical topology (bus/ring) is a Data-Link/MAC concern.
eh: IEEE 802 LANs और MANs के लिए stअंदरds का family है; यह Physical layer और Data Link layer को cover करता है (LLC - 802.2 - और MAC sublayers में बनता है). 802.3 = Ethernet, 802.5 = Token Ring, 802.11 = Wireless LAN. Logical topology (bus/ring) एक Data-Link/MAC concern है।
n: IEEE 802 = LAN/MAN stअंदरds (Physical + Data Link). 802.3 Ethernet, 802.5 Token Ring, 802.11 Wi-Fi.
nh: IEEE 802 = LAN/MAN stअंदरds (Physical + Data Link). 802.3 Ethernet, 802.5 Token Ring, 802.11 Wi-Fi.

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: IEEE 802.2 stअंदरd is related to which sub-layer?
qh: IEEE 802.2 stअंदरd किस sub-layer से संबंधित है?
e: IEEE 802.2 defines the Logical Link Control (LLC) sub-layer of the Data Link layer; the MAC sub-layer is defined by IEEE 802.3 (Ethernet).
eh: IEEE 802.2 Data Link layer का LLC (Logical Link Control) sub-layer define करता है; MAC sub-layer IEEE 802.3 (Ethernet) से जुड़ा है।
n: 802.2 = LLC (upper sub-layer of Data Link). 802.3 = Ethernet/MAC, 802.5 = Token Ring, 802.11 = Wi-Fi.
nh: 802.2 = LLC। 802.3 = Ethernet/MAC, 802.5 = Token Ring, 802.11 = Wi-Fi।

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: Which physical topology offers the highest robustness (fault tolerance) because of multiple redundant paths, but is also the most expensive and hardest to install because of the huge amount of cabling?
qh: कौन सी physical topology सबसे ज़्यादा robust (fault tolerant) है क्योंकि ismein कई redundant paths होते हैं, लेकिन सबसे महंगी और install करने में सबसे मुश्किल भी है क्योंकि बहुत ज़्यादा cabling चाहिए?
e: Mesh has a dedicated link between every pair of devices, so the failure of one link does not affect the others - it is the most robust. But n(n-1)/2 links make it the most expensive and hardest to install/wire.
eh: Mesh में हर pair of devices के बीच dedicated link होता है, इसलिए एक link fail होने से दूसरे affected नहीं होते - यह सबसे robust है। लेकिन n(n-1)/2 links की वजह से यह सबसे महंगी और install करने में सबसे मुश्किल है।
n: Mesh = most robust + most costly (n(n-1)/2 cables). Star = cheap & easy but hub is a single point of failure. Bus = cheapest, hardest fault isolation.
nh: Mesh = सबसे robust + सबसे महंगी (n(n-1)/2 cables). Star = sasti और आसान लेकिन hub single point of failure है. Bus = सबसे sasti, fault isolation सबसे मुश्किल.

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: Four network segments in Bus topology are: A1–A2, B1–B2–B3, C1–C2 and D1–D2–D3. If A1, B1, C1 and D1 are interconnected in a mesh, how many mesh connections are required?
qh: Bus topology में चार network segments हैं: A1–A2, B1–B2–B3, C1–C2 और D1–D2–D3। यदि A1, B1, C1 और D1 को mesh में जोड़ा जाए, तो कितने mesh connections चाहिए?
e: Only the four interconnecting nodes (A1, B1, C1, D1) are meshed: links = n(n-1)/2 = 4×3/2 = 6. (Matches the official RPSC key.)
eh: सिर्फ चार interconnecting nodes (A1, B1, C1, D1) mesh हो रहे हैं: links = n(n-1)/2 = 4×3/2 = 6। (Official RPSC key से match.)
n: Mesh formula n(n-1)/2 — लेकिन n सिर्फ meshed nodes है (4), पूरे network के hosts (10) नहीं!
nh: Mesh formula n(n-1)/2 — पर n सिर्फ meshed nodes है (4), पूरे network के hosts (10) नहीं!

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: The term WAN stands for?
qh: WAN का पूरा नाम (full form) क्या है?
e: WAN = Wide Area Network. It spans a large geographical area - a country, continent or the whole world. The Internet is the largest WAN.
eh: WAN = Wide Area Network. यह एक बड़े geographical area को span करता है - एक देश, continent या पूरी दुनिया। Internet सबसे बड़ा WAN है।
n: WAN = Wide Area Network. Internet सबसे बड़ा WAN है.
nh: WAN = Wide Area Network. Internet सबसे बड़ा WAN है।

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: Which network is suitable for a building?
qh: किसी एक building के लिए कौन सा network उपयुक्त (suitable) है?
e: A LAN (Local Area Network) is usually privately owned and covers a small geographical area - a single office, building, or campus. So a building -> LAN.
eh: LAN (Local Area Network) आम तौर पर privately owned होता है और एक chhote geographical area - एक office, building, या campus - को cover करता है। इसलिए building के लिए LAN उपयुक्त है।
n: LAN = Local Area Network - छोटा area (office/building/campus), private, high speed.
nh: LAN = Local Area Network - छोटा area (office/building/campus), private, high speed.

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: Bluetooth is an example of:
qh: Bluetooth इसका example है:
e: Bluetooth connects devices around one person (mobile phone with earphones/headset). A network organized around an individual person is a PAN (Personal Area Network).
eh: Bluetooth एक व्यक्ति के aas-पास के devices को जोड़ता है (mobile phone को earphones/headset से). Ek व्यक्ति के around organized network को PAN (Personal Area Network) कहते हैं।
n: PAN = Personal Area Network - एक person के around (Bluetooth: phone <-> earphones).
nh: PAN = Personal Area Network - एक person के around (Bluetooth: phone <-> earphones).

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: Which one of the following extends a private network across public networks?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक private network को public networks के paar (across) extend करता है?
e: A Virtual Private Network (VPN) extends a private network across a public network (e.g., the Internet) using tunneling and encryption, so data travels securely as if on a private network.
eh: Virtual Private Network (VPN) एक private network को एक public network (जैसे Internet) के paar extend करता है, tunneling और encryption के through, ताकि data private network की तरह securely travel करे।
n: VPN = Virtual Private Network - private network को public (Internet) पर extend करता है, securely.
nh: VPN = Virtual Private Network - private network को public (Internet) पर extend करता है, securely.

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: ______ is a network that covers geographic areas that are larger, such as districts or cities.
qh: ______ एक ऐसा network है जो बड़े geographical areas, जैसे districts या cities, को cover करता है।
e: MAN (Metropolitan Area Network) covers a metropolitan area, usually a city - larger than a LAN but smaller than a WAN. Example: cable TV network of a city.
eh: MAN (Metropolitan Area Network) एक metropolitan area, आम तौर पर एक city, को cover करता है - LAN से बड़ा लेकिन WAN से छोटा। Example: एक city का cable TV network.
n: MAN = Metropolitan Area Network - city level (cable TV network).
nh: MAN = Metropolitan Area Network - city level (cable TV network).

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: Which factor primarily decides whether a communication system is a LAN or a WAN?
qh: कौन-सा factor मुख्य रूप से तय करता है कि communication system LAN है या WAN?
o: The number of protocols it uses
oh: वह कितने geographical area में फैला है
वह कितने protocols use करता है
e: Forouzan: a LAN covers a building/plant/campus (small area); a WAN spans states, countries or the whole world — geographical span is the primary factor.
eh: Forouzan: LAN building/campus जैसे छोटे area को cover करता है; WAN states/countries/दुनिया तक फैला होता है — geographical span ही मुख्य factor है।
n: Chhoti area = LAN, city = MAN, state/country/world = WAN. Faisla सिर्फ area का.
nh: छोटा area = LAN, city = MAN, state/country/world = WAN। फैसला सिर्फ area का।

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: In terms of the size of the network, the correct order (ascending) is:
qh: Network के size के hisaab से सही kram (badhta हुआ/ascending order) क्या है?
e: Ascending order of size: PAN (around a person, smallest) < LAN (building/campus) < MAN (city) < WAN (country/world, largest).
eh: Size के hisaab से badhta kram: PAN (एक person के around, सबसे छोटा) < LAN (building/campus) < MAN (city) < WAN (देश/दुनिया, सबसे बड़ा).
n: Remember: PAN < LAN < MAN < WAN (smallest to largest).
nh: याद रखें: PAN < LAN < MAN < WAN (छोटा से बड़ा).

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: Which type of network covers an entire city or campus?
qh: कौन सा network पूरे एक city या campus को cover करता है?
e: MAN (Metropolitan Area Network) covers an entire city; a large campus can also be of MAN scale. (Official answer key: MAN)
eh: MAN (Metropolitan Area Network) एक पूरे city को cover करता है; एक बड़ा campus भी MAN scale का हो सकता है। (Official answer key: MAN)
n: MAN = city level. Note: a single building/campus LAN is usually LAN/CAN; an entire city = MAN.
nh: MAN = city level. Note: एक building/campus का LAN आम तौर पर LAN/CAN होता है; पूरी city = MAN.

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: Which of these is NOT a type of network?
qh: इनमें से कौन network का एक prakar (type) नहीं है?
e: LAN, MAN and WAN are stअंदरd network types (by geographical area). TAN is not a stअंदरd type of network.
eh: LAN, MAN और WAN stअंदरd network types हैं (geographical area के aadhar पर). TAN कोई stअंदरd network type नहीं है।
n: Network types: PAN, LAN, MAN, WAN (+ CAN, SAN). TAN = नहीं है.
nh: Network types: PAN, LAN, MAN, WAN (+ CAN, SAN). TAN = नहीं है।

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: The Internet is an example of:
qh: Internet इसका example है:
e: The Internet is a global system of interconnected networks - it is the largest WAN (Wide Area Network).
eh: Internet interconnected networks का एक global system है - यह सबसे बड़ा WAN (Wide Area Network) है।
n: Internet = सबसे बड़ा WAN (network of networks).
nh: Internet = सबसे बड़ा WAN (network of networks).

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: What is the difference between an 'internet' and the 'Internet'?
qh: 'internet' और 'Internet' में अंतर क्या है?
o: There is no difference; both mean the World Wide Web
An internet is any network of networks; the Internet is the specific global one we use today
An internet is smaller than a LAN; the Internet is larger than a WAN
An internet uses cables; the Internet uses only wireless
oh: कोई अंतर नहीं; दोनों का अर्थ World Wide Web है
internet कोई भी network of networks है; Internet आज की वह विशिष्ट विश्वव्यापी network of networks है
internet LAN से छोटा है; Internet WAN से बड़ा है
internet cables use करता है; Internet सिर्फ wireless use करता है
e: An 'internet' (lower-case) is any generic network of networks. The 'Internet' (capital I) is THE specific worldwide internet that grew from ARPANET.
eh: 'internet' (छोटा i) कोई भी generic network of networks है। 'Internet' (बड़ा I) वह विशिष्ट विश्वव्यापी internet है जो ARPANET से विकसित हुआ।
n: internet = generic network of networks. Internet = THE global network (capital I).
nh: internet = generic network of networks। Internet = वह global network (बड़ा I)।

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: SAN is mainly used for:
qh: SAN का मुख्य उपयोग किसके लिए होता है?
e: SAN (Storage Area Network) is a dedicated high-speed private network used for storage management - connecting servers to storage devices in data centres.
eh: SAN (Storage Area Network) एक dedicated high-speed private network है जो storage management के लिए use होता है - servers को storage devices से जोड़ने के लिए (data centres में).
n: SAN = Storage Area Network - servers <-> storage devices, data centre.
nh: SAN = Storage Area Network - servers <-> storage devices, data centre.

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: PAN is used for connecting:
qh: PAN किसके connect करने के लिए use होता है?
o: Personal devices like mobile, laptop, Bluetooth headset
oh: personal devices जैसे mobile, laptop, Bluetooth headset
e: PAN (Personal Area Network) is a network organized around an individual person - connecting personal devices like mobile, laptop, Bluetooth headset.
eh: PAN (Personal Area Network) एक व्यक्ति के around organized एक network है - personal devices जैसे mobile, laptop, Bluetooth headset को जोड़ने के लिए।
n: PAN = Personal Area Network - एक person के devices (mobile, laptop, headset).
nh: PAN = Personal Area Network - एक person के devices (mobile, laptop, headset).

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: A school has four computer labs in the same building. Each lab has 20 computers connected to a central server. Students can share files and print from any lab. Which type of network is implemented in this school?
qh: Ek school में एक ही building में चार computer labs हैं. हर lab में 20 computers एक central server से जुड़े हैं। Students किसी भी lab से files share और print कर सकते हैं। School में कौन सा network implemented है?
e: All four labs are in the same building and share a central server - this is a small, privately-owned, single-site network = LAN (Local Area Network).
eh: Chaaron labs एक ही building में हैं और एक central server share करते हैं - यह एक छोटा, privately-owned, single-site network है = LAN (Local Area Network).
n: LAN = single building/campus, private, high speed. Example: school lab, office.
nh: LAN = एक building/campus, private, high speed. Example: school lab, office.

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: A university has different departments in separate buildings like Engineering, Arts, and Commerce. Each department has its own LAN. All these LANs are connected together for communication. Which type of network connects all these LANs?
qh: Ek university में अलग-अलग departments अलग buildings में हैं जैसे Engineering, Arts, Commerce। हर department का apna LAN है। यह सब LANs communication के लिए आपस में जुड़े हैं। कौन सा network in सब LANs को जोड़ता है?
e: A CAN (Campus Area Network) interconnects the LANs of different buildings across a campus (university/corporate). Here, multiple departmental LANs are joined = CAN.
eh: CAN (Campus Area Network) एक campus (university/corporate) की अलग buildings में maujood LANs को interconnect करता है। यहाँ कई departmental LANs जुड़े हैं = CAN.
n: CAN = Campus Area Network - एक campus की multiple buildings के LANs को जोड़ता है.
nh: CAN = Campus Area Network - एक campus की कई buildings के LANs को जोड़ता है।

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: An international bank connects its main office in New York with branches in Delhi, London, and Tokyo. Which network type is used here?
qh: Ek international bank अपने main office (New York) को Delhi, London, और Tokyo की branches से जोड़ता है। यहाँ कौन सा network type use होता है?
e: Branches in different cities and countries (New York, Delhi, London, Tokyo) are connected over long distances - this is a WAN (Wide Area Network).
eh: Alag-अलग cities और deshon में branches (New York, Delhi, London, Tokyo) लंबी दूरी पर जुड़े हैं - यह WAN (Wide Area Network) है।
n: WAN = long distance (city/country/continent). Bank branches worldwide = WAN.
nh: WAN = लंबी दूरी (city/देश/continent). Worldwide bank branches = WAN.

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: A company has several servers that store and manage large volumes of data. All storage devices are interconnected for high-speed data access. Which type of network is this?
qh: Ek company के पास कई servers हैं जो बड़ी matra में data store और manage करते हैं। सब storage devices high-speed data access के लिए interconnected हैं। यह कौन सा network है?
e: Servers plus storage devices, all interconnected for high-speed data access = SAN (Storage Area Network), a dedicated network for storage.
eh: Servers + storage devices, सब high-speed data access के लिए interconnected = SAN (Storage Area Network), storage के लिए एक dedicated network.
n: SAN = Storage Area Network - storage devices को high-speed access dene के लिए.
nh: SAN = Storage Area Network - storage devices को high-speed access dene के लिए।

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: A supplier accessing a company's order tracking system uses:
qh: Ek supplier जो company के order tracking system को access करता है, कौन सा network use करता है?
e: An Extranet is an intranet extended to authorized outsiders (suppliers, partners, customers). A supplier accessing the company's order tracking system = Extranet.
eh: Extranet एक ऐसा intranet है जो authorized outsiders (suppliers, partners, customers) के लिए extend किया गया हो। Company के order tracking system को access करने वाला supplier = Extranet.
n: Extranet = intranet + authorized outsiders (suppliers/partners/customers).
nh: Extranet = intranet + authorized outsiders (suppliers/partners/customers).

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: Which network type provides maximum security and privacy?
qh: कौन सा network type अधिकतम (maximum) security और privacy provide करता है?
e: An Intranet is a private network inside an organization, accessible only to its members - so it provides maximum security and privacy. Internet is public; extranet is shared with outsiders.
eh: Intranet एक organization के अंदर का private network है, सिर्फ uske members के लिए accessible - इसलिए यह maximum security और privacy provide करता है। Internet public है; extranet outsiders के साथ share होता है।
n: Security order: Intranet (सबसे secure/private) > Extranet > Internet (public).
nh: Security order: Intranet (सबसे secure/private) > Extranet > Internet (public).

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: A software company shares project reports and progress updates with its clients through a secure online portal that requires login credentials. Which network type is this?
qh: Ek software company अपने clients के साथ project reports और progress updates एक secure online portal के through share करती है जिसमें login credentials चाहिए। यह कौन सा network type है?
e: Sharing internal project information with clients (outsiders) through a secure login portal = Extranet (the company's intranet extended to authorized clients).
eh: Clients (outsiders) के साथ internal project information share करना, एक secure login portal के through = Extranet (company का intranet authorized clients के लिए extend किया गया).
n: Clients को secure portal से share करना = Extranet.
nh: Clients को secure portal से share करना = Extranet.

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: Bank employees access internal financial databases, while customers access their accounts through online banking websites. Which networks are being used by employees and customers respectively?
qh: Bank employees internal financial databases access करते हैं, jabki customers online banking websites के through अपने accounts access करते हैं। Employees और customers kramashah कौन से networks use कर रहे हैं?
e: Employees use the bank's internal private network = Intranet. Customers access the bank's system from outside = Extranet (per the official key: the bank's online banking is its intranet extended to customers).
eh: Employees bank के internal private network = Intranet use करते हैं। Customers बाहर से bank के system को access करते हैं = Extranet (official key के anusaar: bank का online banking uske intranet का customers के लिए extension है).
n: Employees -> Intranet (internal). Outsiders (customers/suppliers) -> Extranet. Public -> Internet.
nh: Employees -> Intranet (internal). Outsiders (customers/suppliers) -> Extranet. Public -> Internet.

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: Three or more devices share a link in ________ connection.
qh: Teen या अधिक devices एक link ________ connection में share करते हैं।
e: A multipoint (multidrop) connection is one in which more than two devices share a single link; the capacity of the channel is shared spatially or temporally. (Forouzan)
eh: Multipoint (multidrop) connection में do से ज़्यादा devices एक single link share करते हैं; channel की capacity spatially या temporally share होती है। (Forouzan)
n: Multipoint = एक link, कई devices; capacity shared. Point-to-point = dedicated link, सिर्फ 2 devices.
nh: Multipoint = एक link, कई devices; capacity shared. Point-to-point = dedicated link, सिर्फ 2 devices.

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: What are the two types of line configuration?
qh: Line configuration के दो प्रकार क्या हैं?
e: Forouzan: line configuration describes how devices are connected — a dedicated link between two devices (point-to-point) or a link shared by three or more devices (multipoint).
eh: Forouzan: line configuration बताती है कि devices कैसे जुड़ी हैं — दो devices के बीच dedicated link (point-to-point) या तीन+ devices का shared link (multipoint)।
n: Line configuration के सिर्फ 2 type: Point-to-Point & Multipoint. Simplex/Half/Full-Duplex TRANSMISSION MODES हैं.
nh: Line configuration के 2 type: Point-to-Point और Multipoint। Simplex/Half/Full-Duplex transmission modes हैं।

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: What is the advantage of a multipoint connection over a point-to-point connection?
qh: Point-to-point connection की तुलना में multipoint connection का क्या लाभ है?
o: Fewer cables are needed, so the cost is lower
It provides a dedicated link for every pair of devices
It is more secure than point-to-point
It needs more cables and ports
oh: कम cables लगती हैं, इसलिए cost कम होती है
हर device-युग्म को dedicated link मिलता है
यह point-to-point से ज़्यादा secure है
इसमें ज़्यादा cables और ports लगते हैं
e: In a multipoint connection three or more devices SHARE one link, so fewer cables are required and the cost is shared — its main advantage over dedicated point-to-point links.
eh: Multipoint connection में तीन+ devices एक link share करती हैं, इसलिए cables कम लगती हैं और cost कम आती है — यही इसका मुख्य लाभ है।
n: Multipoint = कम cable = कम kharch. Point-to-point = dedicated link (ज़्यादा cable, ज़्यादा privacy).
nh: Multipoint = कम cable = कम खर्च। Point-to-point = dedicated link (ज़्यादा cable, ज़्यादा privacy)।

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: A _______ connection provides a dedicated link between two devices.
qh: Ek _______ connection do devices के बीच एक dedicated link provide करता है।
e: A point-to-point connection provides a dedicated link between two devices; the entire capacity of the link is reserved for transmission between those two devices. (Forouzan)
eh: Point-to-point connection do devices के बीच एक dedicated link provide करता है; link की पूरी capacity सिर्फ unhi do devices के लिए reserved होती है। (Forouzan)
n: Point-to-point = dedicated link, पूरी capacity सिर्फ 2 devices के लिए. Example: TV remote (IR), leased line.
nh: Point-to-point = dedicated link, पूरी capacity सिर्फ 2 devices के लिए. Example: TV remote (IR), leased line.

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: How many point-to-point WANs are needed to connect n LANs so that every LAN can directly communicate with every other LAN?
qh: n LANs को इस तरह जोड़ने के लिए कितने point-to-point WANs चाहिए कि हर LAN हर दूसरी LAN से सीधे communicate कर सके?
e: Direct communication between every pair of LANs needs one WAN link per pair — n(n-1)/2 links (the same mesh formula).
eh: हर LAN-युग्म के बीच सीधे communication के लिए हर युग्म को एक WAN link चाहिए — n(n-1)/2 links (mesh जैसा ही formula)।
n: Full mesh of LANs = n(n-1)/2 WAN links. Formula mesh वाला ही है.
nh: LANs का full mesh = n(n-1)/2 WAN links। Formula mesh जैसा ही है।

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: When a person makes a local telephone call to another person, what type of connection is it?
