qh: जब कोई व्यक्ति दूसरे व्यक्ति को local telephone call करता है, तो यह किस प्रकार का connection है?
e: A local telephone call creates a dedicated circuit between exactly two parties through the exchange — a point-to-point connection.
eh: Local telephone call में exchange के medium से ठीक दो parties के बीच dedicated circuit बनता है — यह point-to-point connection है।
n: Telephone call = 2 parties, dedicated link = point-to-point. Bus/Ethernet = multipoint.
nh: Telephone call = 2 parties, dedicated link = point-to-point। Bus/Ethernet = multipoint।

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: Which of the following is an example of Client-Server architecture?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन Client-Server architecture का example है?
oh: do Bluetooth devices के बीच chat
web browser जो एक website access कर रहा है
e: A web browser (client) requesting and receiving a web page from a web server is the classic client-server architecture: the client requests a service and the server provides it.
eh: Web browser (client) जो एक web server से web page request करता है और receive करता है - यह classic client-server architecture है: client service request करता है और server use provide करता है।
n: Client-Server = client request करता है, server service provide करता है. Example: web browser - website.
nh: Client-Server = client request करता है, server service provide करता है। Example: web browser - website.

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: Which of the following uses Peer-to-Peer (P2P) architecture, not Client-Server?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन Peer-to-Peer (P2P) architecture use करता है, Client-Server नहीं?
e: BitTorrent is peer-to-peer: users (peers) share file pieces directly with each other without a central server. Google search, Gmail and YouTube are client-server services.
eh: BitTorrent peer-to-peer है: users (peers) file के tukde directly आपस में share करते हैं बिना किसी central server के। Google search, Gmail और YouTube client-server services हैं।
n: P2P = peers आपस में directly share करते हैं (BitTorrent). Client-Server = server service देता है (Google, Gmail, YouTube).
nh: P2P = peers आपस में directly share करते हैं (BitTorrent). Client-Server = server service देता है (Google, Gmail, YouTube).

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: In a bank, customers use ATMs to check balance or withdraw cash. ATM machines send the request to a central computer for verification and processing. Which type of architecture is used here?
qh: Ek bank में customers ATMs से balance check या cash withdraw करते हैं। ATM machines request एक central computer को verification और processing के लिए bhejte हैं। यहाँ कौन सी architecture use होती है?
e: The ATM (client) sends a request to a central computer (server) for verification and processing - the client requests a service and the server provides it = client-server architecture.
eh: ATM (client) request एक central computer (server) को verification और processing के लिए भेजता है - client service request करता है और server use provide करता है = client-server architecture.
n: ATM -> central server = client-server (client request, server verify/process).
nh: ATM -> central server = client-server (client request, server verify/process).

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: In a LAN, connectivity can be created using Wi-Fi or _______.
qh: Ek LAN में connectivity Wi-Fi या _______ से बनाई जा सकती है।
e: LAN connectivity is created using Wi-Fi (wireless) or Ethernet cables (wired). TV, radio and mobile are not LAN connectivity media.
eh: LAN connectivity Wi-Fi (wireless) या Ethernet cables (wired) से बनाई जाती है। TV, radio और mobile LAN connectivity media नहीं हैं।
n: LAN connectivity = Wi-Fi (wireless) + Ethernet (wired cable).
nh: LAN connectivity = Wi-Fi (wireless) + Ethernet (wired cable).

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: Which network type is built on top of another existing network?
qh: कौन-सा network type किसी मौजूदा network के ऊपर बनाया जाता है?
e: An overlay network is a virtual network built on top of another (host) network — e.g. VPN tunnels over the Internet or P2P networks over the Internet.
eh: Overlay network एक virtual network है जो किसी दूसरे (host) network के ऊपर बनता है — जैसे Internet पर VPN tunnels या P2P networks।
n: Overlay = network के ऊपर बना network (VPN classic example है). Baaki 3 asli network types नहीं हैं.
nh: Overlay = network के ऊपर बना network (VPN इसका classic example है)। बाकी 3 real network types नहीं हैं।

st: Section E - Types of Networks (LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN, CAN, SAN; Internet, Intranet, Extranet; Point-to-Point, Multipoint; Client-Server, P2P)
q: ______ converts analog voice signals into digital and then transmits them over the broadband line.
qh: ______ analog voice signals को digital में बदलकर broadband line पर भेजता है.
e: VoIP आवाज़ को digital packets में बदलकर Internet जैसी lines पर भेजता है — Skype/WhatsApp call इसी के उदाहरण हैं.
eh: VoIP आवाज़ को digital packets में बदलकर Internet जैसी lines पर भेजता है — Skype/WhatsApp call इसी के उदाहरण हैं.
n: VoIP = the new Internet form of the old telephone voice.
nh: VoIP = पुरानी फ़ोन-आवाज़ का नया internet-रूप.

st: Section F - Network History (ARPANET to Today's Network)
q: In the original ARPANET, _______ were directly connected together.
qh: Original ARPANET में, _______ आपस में directly connected the।
e: In the original ARPANET, the IMPs (Interface Message Processors - the packet switches) were directly connected together; the host computers connected to the IMPs.
eh: Original ARPANET में, IMPs (Interface Message Processors - packet switches) आपस में directly connected the; host computers IMPs से connect होते the।
n: Original ARPANET: IMPs (packet switches) directly connected; hosts attached to IMPs.
nh: Original ARPANET: IMPs (packet switches) directly connected the; hosts IMPs से attach होते the।

st: Section F - Network History (ARPANET to Today's Network)
q: The first operational computer network in the world was the _________ for the United States Department of Defense.
qh: दुनिया का पहला operational computer network, United States Department of Defense के लिए _________ था।
e: ARPANET was the first operational computer network in the world, created for the U.S. Department of Defense (1969).
eh: ARPANET दुनिया का पहला operational computer network था, जो U.S. Department of Defense के लिए बनाया गया था (1969).
n: First operational network = ARPANET (1969, U.S. DoD).
nh: First operational network = ARPANET (1969, U.S. DoD).

st: Section F - Network History (ARPANET to Today's Network)
q: ARPANET - the precursor of today's Internet - was created in ______ by ARPA (Advanced Research Projects Agency) of the U.S. Department of Defense, starting with four nodes (UCLA, SRI, UC Santa Barbara, University of Utah).
qh: ARPANET - aaj के Internet का purvaj - ______ में ARPA (Advanced Research Projects Agency), U.S. Department of Defense द्वारा बनाया गया था, चार nodes से shuruaat हुई (UCLA, SRI, UC Santa Barbara, University of Utah).
e: ARPANET was born in 1969 with four nodes: UCLA, Stanford Research Institute (SRI), UC Santa Barbara and the University of Utah. The first message was sent on 29 October 1969 (the LO of LOGIN).
eh: ARPANET 1969 में चार nodes के साथ बना था: UCLA, Stanford Research Institute (SRI), UC Santa Barbara और University of Utah. पहला message 29 October 1969 को भेजा गया था (LOGIN का LO).
n: ARPANET = 1969, 4 nodes (UCLA, SRI, UCSB, Utah); first message 29 Oct 1969 (LO of LOGIN).
nh: ARPANET = 1969, 4 nodes (UCLA, SRI, UCSB, Utah); पहला message 29 Oct 1969 (LOGIN का LO).

st: Section F - Network History (ARPANET to Today's Network)
q: TCP/IP (developed by Vint Cerf and Bob Kahn) was adopted by ARPANET as its official protocol suite on 1 January ______ - an event known as the fflag day.
qh: TCP/IP (Vint Cerf और Bob Kahn द्वारा develop किया गया) को ARPANET ने apna official protocol suite बनाया था 1 January ______ को - is event को fflag day कहा जाता है।
e: On 1 January 1983, ARPANET officially switched to TCP/IP - the fflag day - making TCP/IP the common language of the network. Cerf and Kahn developed TCP/IP in the 1970s (publicly demonstrated in 1972).
eh: 1 January 1983 को ARPANET officially TCP/IP पर switch हो गया - fflag day - जिससे TCP/IP network की common language बन गया। Cerf और Kahn ने TCP/IP 1970s में develop किया था (1972 में publicly demonstrate हुआ).
n: Fflag day = 1 Jan 1983 (ARPANET -> TCP/IP). TCP/IP developed by Cerf & Kahn in 1970s (demo 1972). Syllabus का TCP/IP model 1972 = development era.
nh: Fflag day = 1 Jan 1983 (ARPANET -> TCP/IP). TCP/IP Cerf & Kahn ने 1970s में develop किया (demo 1972). Syllabus का TCP/IP model 1972 = development era.

st: Section F - Network History (ARPANET to Today's Network)
q: NSFNET, created by the U.S. National Science Foundation in ______, became a major backbone of the Internet, connecting universities and research centres.
qh: NSFNET, U.S. National Science Foundation द्वारा ______ में बनाया गया, Internet का एक major backbone बन गया, universities और research centres को जोड़ता था।
e: NSFNET was created in 1986 by the National Science Foundation; it connected universities and research centres with T1 lines (1.544 Mbps) and became a major Internet backbone.
eh: NSFNET 1986 में National Science Foundation द्वारा बनाया गया था; isne universities और research centres को T1 lines (1.544 Mbps) से जोड़ा और एक major Internet backbone बन गया।
n: NSFNET = 1986 (National Science Foundation), T1 backbone -> Internet backbone.
nh: NSFNET = 1986 (National Science Foundation), T1 backbone -> Internet backbone.

st: Section F - Network History (ARPANET to Today's Network)
q: The World Wide Web (WWW) was invented in 1991 at CERN by ______, and it made the Internet popular among the general public.
qh: World Wide Web (WWW) का invention 1991 में CERN में ______ ने किया था, और isne Internet को आम public के बीच popular बनाया।
e: Tim Berners-Lee invented the WWW at CERN in 1991 (using HTML, HTTP and URLs). The Mosaic browser (1993) later made the web popular; the Internet opened to commercial use in the 1990s.
eh: Tim Berners-Lee ने 1991 में CERN में WWW का invention किया था (HTML, HTTP और URLs का use करके). Mosaic browser (1993) ने बाद में web को popular बनाया; Internet 1990s में commercial use के लिए खुला।
n: WWW = 1991, Tim Berners-Lee @ CERN. Mosaic browser 1993. Vint Cerf & Bob Kahn = fathers of the Internet (TCP/IP).
nh: WWW = 1991, Tim Berners-Lee @ CERN. Mosaic browser 1993. Vint Cerf & Bob Kahn = Internet के fathers (TCP/IP).

st: Section G - General Network Basics (WWW, E-mail, Protocols, Servers, Switching - from repo intro tests)
q: A collection of hyperlinked documents on the internet forms the?
qh: Internet पर hyperlinked documents का sangrah (collection) क्या banata है?
e: A collection of hyperlinked documents on the Internet forms the World Wide Web (WWW). HTML is the markup language used to create those documents.
eh: Internet पर hyperlinked documents का sangrah World Wide Web (WWW) banata है। HTML वह markup language है जिस से यह documents bante हैं।
n: WWW = hyperlinked documents का collection. HTML = un documents की language (WWW नहीं).
nh: WWW = hyperlinked documents का collection. HTML = un documents की language है (WWW नहीं).

st: Section G - General Network Basics (WWW, E-mail, Protocols, Servers, Switching - from repo intro tests)
q: Which one of the following is a valid email address?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक valid email address है?
e: A valid email address has a local part, the @ symbol, and a domain with a top-level domain (TLD). computech@academy.com follows this format.
eh: Ek valid email address में local part, @ symbol, और एक domain with top-level domain (TLD) होता है। computech@academy.com यह format follow करता है।
n: Valid email = local@domain.TLD (e.g., name@site.com).
nh: Valid email = local@domain.TLD (जैसे name@site.com).

st: Section G - General Network Basics (WWW, E-mail, Protocols, Servers, Switching - from repo intro tests)
q: Which of the following best describes uploading information?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन uploading information को सबसे achhe से describe करता है?
o: Sorting data on a disk drive
Sending information to a host computer
Receiving information from a host computer
Sorting data on a hard drive
oh: disk drive पर data को sort करना
information को एक host computer को भेजना
एक host computer से information receive करना
hard drive पर data को sort करना
e: Uploading means sending/transferring information from a local device to a host/remote computer over a network.
eh: Uploading का मतलब है information को एक local device से एक host/remote computer को network के through भेजना।
n: Uploading = local से remote/host को भेजना. Downloading = remote से local को लेना.
nh: Uploading = local से remote/host को भेजना. Downloading = remote से local को लेना.

st: Section G - General Network Basics (WWW, E-mail, Protocols, Servers, Switching - from repo intro tests)
q: Which one of the following is the most common internet protocol?
qh: Nimnlikhis में से कौन सा सबसे common internet protocol है?
e: TCP/IP is the core protocol suite of the Internet - it is the most common protocol used on the Internet. HTML is a markup language, not a protocol.
eh: TCP/IP Internet का core protocol suite है - यह Internet पर सबसे common protocol है। HTML एक markup language है, protocol नहीं।
n: Internet का core protocol = TCP/IP. HTML = language, protocol नहीं.
nh: Internet का core protocol = TCP/IP. HTML = language है, protocol नहीं.

st: Section G - General Network Basics (WWW, E-mail, Protocols, Servers, Switching - from repo intro tests)
q: The dial-up connections to access the internet use ___ protocol.
qh: Internet access के लिए dial-up connections ___ protocol use करते हैं।
e: Dial-up connections to access the Internet use PPP (Point-to-Point Protocol), which carries IP traffic over the telephone line.
eh: Internet access के लिए dial-up connections PPP (Point-to-Point Protocol) use करते हैं, जो telephone line पर IP traffic carry करता है।
n: Dial-up Internet = PPP (Point-to-Point Protocol).
nh: Dial-up Internet = PPP (Point-to-Point Protocol).

st: Section G - General Network Basics (WWW, E-mail, Protocols, Servers, Switching - from repo intro tests)
q: When a resident uses a dial-up or DSL service to connect to the Internet, what is the role of the telephone company?
qh: जब कोई व्यक्ति Internet से जुड़ने के लिए dial-up या DSL service use करता है, तो telephone company की भूमिका क्या होती है?
o: It provides the switching/connection path from the user to the ISP
It hosts every website the user visits
It assigns IP addresses to every website
It encrypts all the user's data
oh: वह user से ISP तक switching/connection path देती है
वह user की हर website host करती है
वह हर website को IP address देती है
वह user का सारा data encrypt करती है
e: Forouzan: with dial-up/DSL the telephone company is a switching service provider — it provides the local loop and connection path (circuit) from the customer to the ISP; the ISP connects to the Internet.
eh: Forouzan: dial-up/DSL में telephone company switching service provider है — वह customer से ISP तक local loop/connection path देती है; ISP Internet से जोड़ता है।
n: Telephone company सिर्फ 'road' देती है (local loop + switching). Website hosting/IP assignment ISP/DNS का काम है.
nh: Telephone company सिर्फ रास्ता देती है (local loop + switching)। Website hosting/IP assignment ISP/DNS का काम है।

st: Section G - General Network Basics (WWW, E-mail, Protocols, Servers, Switching - from repo intro tests)
q: Home broadband connections that work on DSL (Digital Subscriber Line) use ___ protocol.
qh: DSL (Digital Subscriber Line) पर काम करने वाले home broadband connections ___ protocol use करते हैं।
e: Home DSL broadband connections typically use PPPoE (PPP over Ethernet) to carry PPP traffic over the DSL/Ethernet connection.
eh: Home DSL broadband connections आम तौर पर PPPoE (PPP over Ethernet) use करते हैं ताकि PPP traffic DSL/Ethernet connection पर carry हो sake।
n: Home DSL broadband = PPPoE (PPP over Ethernet).
nh: Home DSL broadband = PPPoE (PPP over Ethernet).

st: Section G - General Network Basics (WWW, E-mail, Protocols, Servers, Switching - from repo intro tests)
q: Which of the following servers allows LAN users to share data?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा server LAN users को data share करने की अनुमति देता है?
e: A file server stores files and allows LAN users to share/access data (files) over the network.
eh: Ek file server files store करता है और LAN users को network पर data (files) share/access करने की अनुमति देता है।
n: File server = files store + LAN users को share करने देता है.
nh: File server = files store करता है + LAN users को share करने देता है।

st: Section G - General Network Basics (WWW, E-mail, Protocols, Servers, Switching - from repo intro tests)
q: EDI stands for ____.
qh: EDI का पूरा नाम है ____.
e: EDI = Electronic Data Interchange - the computer-to-computer exchange of business documents (orders, invoices) in a stअंदरd electronic format.
eh: EDI = Electronic Data Interchange - business documents (orders, invoices) का computer-to-computer exchange, एक stअंदरd electronic format में.
n: EDI = Electronic Data Interchange (business documents का e-exchange).
nh: EDI = Electronic Data Interchange (business documents का e-exchange).

st: Section G - General Network Basics (WWW, E-mail, Protocols, Servers, Switching - from repo intro tests)
q: A computer network permits sharing of:
qh: एक computer network किस चीज़ की sharing की अनुमति देता है?
e: A computer network permits sharing of both resources (printers, storage, devices) and information (data/messages) among connected users.
eh: Ek computer network दोनों cheezon की sharing की अनुमति देता है: resources (printers, storage, devices) और information (data/messages), connected users के बीच।
n: Network = resources + information sharing.
nh: Network = resources + information sharing.

st: Section G - General Network Basics (WWW, E-mail, Protocols, Servers, Switching - from repo intro tests)
q: Which of the following is a benefit of networking?
qh: Networking का कौन-सा लाभ (benefit) है?
e: Computer networks allow file sharing, easy access to shared resources (printers, servers, internet) and easier centralised backups — so all of these are benefits.
eh: Computer networks file sharing, shared resources (printers, server, internet) तक आसान पहुँच, और आसान centralised backups की अनुमति देते हैं — इसलिए ये सभी लाभ हैं।
n: Networking benefits: sharing (files/resources/peripherals) + communication + backup + cost saving. Exam favourite: "All of the above".
nh: Networking के लाभ: sharing (files/resources/peripherals) + communication + backup + cost saving। Exam favourite: "All of the above"।

st: Section G - General Network Basics (WWW, E-mail, Protocols, Servers, Switching - from repo intro tests)
q: The term UPnP is a short form of:
qh: UPnP term का पूरा नाम (full form) क्या है?
e: UPnP = Universal Plug and Play — a set of networking protocols that lets devices discover each other and connect automatically (zero-configuration).
eh: UPnP = Universal Plug and Play — networking protocols का एक set जो devices को एक-दूसरे को automatically discover और connect (zero-configuration) करने देता है।
n: UPnP = Universal Plug and Play (device auto-discovery). Compare: DHCP = auto IP configuration.
nh: UPnP = Universal Plug and Play (device auto-discovery)। तुलना: DHCP = auto IP configuration।

st: Section G - General Network Basics (WWW, E-mail, Protocols, Servers, Switching - from repo intro tests)
q: How many digits of the Data Network Identification Code (DNIC) identify the country?
qh: Data Network Identification Code (DNIC) के kitne digits देश (country) की पहचान करते हैं?
e: In the DNIC (used in X.121 addressing), the first three digits are the country code and the fourth digit identifies the network within that country. So the first three digits identify the country.
eh: DNIC (X.121 addressing में use होता है) में पहले तीन digits country code होते हैं और चौथा digit उस देश के अंदर के network की पहचान करता है। इसलिए पहले तीन digits देश की पहचान करते हैं।
n: DNIC: first 3 digits = country code, 4th digit = network code.
nh: DNIC: पहले 3 digits = country code, चौथा digit = network code.

st: Section G - General Network Basics (WWW, E-mail, Protocols, Servers, Switching - from repo intro tests)
q:
Consider the switching statements:
1. Circuit Switching establishes a dedicated path.
2. Packet Switching routes data in packets on different paths.
3. Message Switching uses store-and-forward.
Which statements are correct?
qh:
Switching statements देखिए:
1. Circuit Switching dedicated path बनाता है।
2. Packet Switching data को packets में अलग paths पर भेजता है।
3. Message Switching store-and-forward use करता है।
कौन से statements सही हैं?
e: All three correct: circuit switching sets up a dedicated end-to-end path; packet switching splits data into packets that may take different paths; message switching stores the whole message at each node and forwards it (store-and-forward).
eh: तीनों सही: circuit switching dedicated end-to-end path बनाता है; packet switching data को packets में बाँटकर अलग paths से भेजता है; message switching हर node पर पूरा message store करके आगे भेजता है।
n: 3 switching types: Circuit (dedicated path), Packet (packets, अलग paths), Message (store-and-forward) — teeno statements correct.
nh: 3 switching types: Circuit (dedicated path), Packet (packets, अलग paths), Message (store-and-forward) — तीनों सही।

st: Section G - General Network Basics (WWW, E-mail, Protocols, Servers, Switching - from repo intro tests)
q: All the information on the internet is passed using _______ switching method.
qh: Internet पर saari information _______ switching method से pass होती है।
e: The Internet uses packet switching: data is broken into small packets that travel independently over the network and are reassembled at the destination.
eh: Internet packet switching use करता है: data को chhote packets में tod कर भेजा जाता है जो network पर independently travel करते हैं और destination पर reassemble होते हैं।
n: Internet = packet switching. Circuit switching = dedicated path (old telephone).
nh: Internet = packet switching. Circuit switching = dedicated path (पुराना telephone).

st: Section G - General Network Basics (WWW, E-mail, Protocols, Servers, Switching - from repo intro tests)
q: Which technique breaks data into packets for transmission?
qh: Transmission के लिए data को packets में तोड़ने की technique कौन-सी है?
e: Packet switching breaks the message into packets, sends each (possibly over different paths) and reassembles them at the destination. Circuit switching sends a continuous stream over a dedicated path; FDM/TDM are multiplexing techniques.
eh: Packet switching message को packets में तोड़ता है, हर packet भेजता है और destination पर जोड़ता है। Circuit switching dedicated path पर continuous stream भेजता है; FDM/TDM multiplexing techniques हैं।
n: Internet packet switching पर चलता है — data packets में tootta है.
nh: Internet packet switching पर चलता है — data packets में टूटता है।

st: Section G - General Network Basics (WWW, E-mail, Protocols, Servers, Switching - from repo intro tests)
q: Which of the following is true for Circuit Switching handling multiple simultaneous connections?
qh: एक साथ अनेक connections संभालते समय Circuit Switching के बारे में क्या सही है?
o: A single path is used and shared for all data
All connections are multiplexed into a single channel
It encodes all data into a single channel
Separate physical paths are allocated for each channel
oh: एक ही path सभी data के लिए share होता है
सभी connections एक channel में multiplex होते हैं
यह सारे data को एक channel में encode करता है
हर channel के लिए अलग physical paths दिए जाते हैं
e: In circuit switching each connection gets its own dedicated physical path for the whole duration — multiple simultaneous connections mean multiple separate paths (as in the traditional telephone network). (Matches the official RPSC key.)
eh: Circuit switching में हर connection को पूरे समय के लिए अपना dedicated physical path मिलता है — एक साथ अनेक connections = अलग-अलग paths (पारंपरिक telephone network जैसा)। (Official RPSC key से match.)
n: Circuit switching = हर connection का apna अलग path. Packet switching = shared medium, packets अलग paths से.
nh: Circuit switching = हर connection का अपना अलग path। Packet switching = shared medium, packets अलग paths से।

st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: Which of the following is NOT a component of data communication?
qh: निम्न में से कौन data communication का component नहीं है?
e: Message, sender, receiver, medium, protocol — paanch components; compiler programming ka tool hai.
eh: पाँच components; compiler programming का tool है।
n: Odd-one-out: compiler ka data communication se koi sambandh nahi.
nh: compiler का संबंध नहीं।

st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: In a protocol, the meaning of each section of the message is called:
qh: एक protocol में message के हर भाग के अर्थ को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Semantics = har field/section ka meaning; syntax = format; timing = speed/order.
eh: Semantics = हर भाग का अर्थ; syntax = format; timing = क्रम।
n: Syntax format dikhata hai, semantics matlab.
nh: Syntax format, Semantics अर्थ।

st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: Coaxial cable and fiber optic cable are examples of:
qh: Coaxial cable और fiber optic cable किसके उदाहरण हैं?
e: Dono wired (guided) media hain — signal ek physical medium se guzarta hai.
eh: दोनों wired (guided) media हैं।
n: Wireless = unguided (radio, microwave).
nh: Wireless = unguided।

st: Section A - DC Components & Protocol Basics (Message, Sender, Receiver, Transmission Medium, Protocol)
q: The three aspects of TIMING in a protocol are speed matching, sequencing, and:
qh: एक protocol में TIMING के तीन पक्ष हैं — speed matching, sequencing और:
e: Forouzan: protocol ke 3 elements — syntax (format), semantics (meaning), timing (speed matching + sequencing + flow control).
eh: protocol के 3 elements — syntax, semantics, timing (speed matching + sequencing + flow control)।
n: Yaad rakho: timing = events ka order + speed + flow control; error control reliability ke liye alag concept hai.
nh: timing = क्रम + गति + flow control; error control अलग concept है।

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: If packets arrive at the receiver with uneven delay, this problem is called:
qh: यदि packets receiver पर असमान delay से पहुँचें, तो इस समस्या को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Uneven/variable delay = jitter; audio-video playback kharab karta hai.
eh: असमान delay = jitter।
n: Attenuation signal weakness hai; jitter delay ka variation.
nh: Attenuation कमज़ोरी; jitter delay का उतार-चढ़ाव।

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: The amount of data that is actually delivered successfully per unit time is called:
qh: प्रति इकाई समय में सफलतापूर्वक पहुँचा data कहलाता है:
e: Throughput = asli (effective) data transfer rate; bandwidth = maximum capacity.
eh: Throughput = वास्तविक data rate; bandwidth = अधिकतम क्षमता।
n: Bandwidth nominal capacity hai, throughput actual.
nh: Bandwidth अधिकतम, Throughput वास्तविक।

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures) is related to which criteria of a network?
qh: MTBF network के किस criteria से संबंधित है?
e: Reliability failures ki frequency aur recovery se naapi jaati hai — MTBF isi ka measure hai.
eh: Reliability = विफलता दर + ठीक होना; MTBF उसी का माप।
n: Performance = throughput/latency.
nh: Performance = throughput/latency।

st: Section B - Characteristics (Delivery, Accuracy, Timeliness, Jitter) & Criteria (Performance, Reliability, Security)
q: Which of the following is a measure of network RELIABILITY (not performance)?
qh: निम्न में से कौन network की RELIABILITY (performance नहीं) का माप है?
e: Forouzan: reliability = failure ki frequency + recovery time; throughput, delay, jitter — sab performance criteria hain.
eh: reliability = failure की आवृत्ति + recovery time; throughput, delay, jitter — performance criteria हैं।
n: Performance = speed/quality of delivery; Reliability = kitni baar network toota aur kitni jaldi theek hua.
nh: Performance = गति; Reliability = टूटने की आवृत्ति और recovery।

st: Section C - Transmission Mode (Direction of Data Flow: Simplex, Half-Duplex, Full-Duplex)
q: In which mode can both stations transmit and receive at the same instant?
qh: किस mode में दोनों stations एक ही समय में भेज और पा सकते हैं?
e: Full-duplex = dono taraf ek saath (telephone).
eh: Full-duplex = दोनों तरफ़ एक साथ।
n: Half-duplex mein baari lagti hai.
nh: Half-duplex में बारी लगती है।

st: Section C - Transmission Mode (Direction of Data Flow: Simplex, Half-Duplex, Full-Duplex)
q: Which of the following works in simplex mode?
qh: निम्न में से कौन simplex mode में काम करता है?
e: Keyboard sirf bhejta hai, monitor sirf dikhata hai — ek hi direction.
eh: Keyboard सिर्फ़ भेजता है, monitor सिर्फ़ दिखाता है।
n: Telephone = full; walkie-talkie = half.
nh: Telephone = full; walkie-talkie = half।

st: Section C - Transmission Mode (Direction of Data Flow: Simplex, Half-Duplex, Full-Duplex)
q: In 100BASE-TX (Fast Ethernet over UTP), full-duplex operation is possible because:
qh: 100BASE-TX (UTP पर Fast Ethernet) में full-duplex संभव है क्योंकि:
o: UTP uses separate wire pairs for transmitting and receiving
oh: UTP में transmit और receive के लिए अलग wire pairs हैं
UTP में दो अलग frequencies हैं
दो UTP cables प्रयोग होती हैं
e: 100BASE-TX pairs 1-2 aur 3-6 — ek pair TX, doosra RX; isliye dono directions ek saath (full-duplex) chal sakte hain.
eh: pairs 1-2 और 3-6 — एक pair TX, दूसरा RX; दोनों दिशाएँ साथ चलती हैं।
n: Half-duplex mein ek hi pair dono directions ke liye hota (collision possible); alag pairs se collision hi nahi.
nh: half-duplex में एक pair दोनों काम करता है; अलग pairs से collision नहीं।

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: In a mesh topology with 6 devices, how many dedicated links are required?
qh: 6 devices की mesh topology में कितने dedicated links चाहिए?
n: 30 = n(n−1) full duplex links counting ulta.
nh: 30 = n(n−1) गिनती में गलती।

st: Section D - Network Structure / Topology (Physical: Mesh, Star, Bus, Ring, Others; Logical: IEEE 802)
q: If the central device of a star topology fails, the result is:
qh: यदि star topology का central device ख़राब हो जाए तो:
