st: Section A — OSI Model: Basics, Layer Order & Support Layers
q: OSI stands for:
qh: OSI का पूरा नाम (full form) क्या है?
e: OSI = Open Systems Interconnection — the reference model published by ISO in 1984 that standardises network communication into 7 layers.
eh: OSI = Open Systems Interconnection — ISO द्वारा 1984 में publish किया गया reference model जो network communication को 7 layers में बाँटता है।
n: OSI = Open Systems Interconnection (ISO, 1984, 7 layers). Ye sabse favourite one-liner hai.
nh: OSI = Open Systems Interconnection (ISO, 1984, 7 layers)। सबसे favourite one-liner।

st: Section A — OSI Model: Basics, Layer Order & Support Layers
q: The OSI model was developed by:
qh: OSI model किसने develop किया?
e: ISO (International Organization for Standardization) published the OSI reference model in 1984.
eh: ISO (International Organization for Standardization) ने OSI reference model 1984 में publish किया।
n: OSI = ISO ka (1984). TCP/IP = DoD/ARPA ka. IEEE = 802 LAN standards. IETF = TCP/IP standards.
nh: OSI = ISO का (1984)। TCP/IP = DoD/ARPA का। IEEE = 802 LAN standards। IETF = TCP/IP standards।

st: Section A — OSI Model: Basics, Layer Order & Support Layers
q: The OSI model has how many layers?
qh: OSI model में कितनी layers हैं?
e: The OSI reference model has exactly 7 layers: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application.
eh: OSI reference model में ठीक 7 layers हैं: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application।
n: Mnemonic: Please Do Not Throw Sausage Pizza Away (Physical, Data-link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application).
nh: Mnemonic: Please Do Not Throw Sausage Pizza Away (Physical, Data-link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application)।

st: Section A — OSI Model: Basics, Layer Order & Support Layers
q: Why was the OSI model developed?
qh: OSI model क्यों develop किया गया?
o: Manufacturers disliked the TCP/IP protocol suite
The rate of data transfer was increasing exponentially
Standards were needed to allow any two systems to communicate
oh: Manufacturers को TCP/IP protocol suite पसंद नहीं था
Data transfer की दर तेज़ी से बढ़ रही थी
किन्हीं भी दो systems के बीच communication के लिए standards चाहिए थे
e: OSI was developed to provide an international standard so that any two systems from different vendors could communicate (open systems interconnection).
eh: OSI एक international standard देने के लिए बना ताकि अलग vendors के कोई भी दो systems आपस में communicate कर सकें।
n: OSI = OPEN systems — matlab koi bhi do systems jud sakein. Isliye 'standards were needed' sahi jawab hai.
nh: OSI = OPEN systems — कोई भी दो systems जुड़ सकें। इसलिए 'standards were needed' सही उत्तर है।

st: Section A — OSI Model: Basics, Layer Order & Support Layers
q: In the OSI model, when data is sent from device A to device B, which is the 5th layer to receive data at B (counting from the bottom)?
qh: OSI model में जब data device A से device B को भेजा जाता है, तो B पर data पाने वाली 5वीं layer (नीचे से गिनती में) कौन-सी है?
e: Counting up at the receiver: 1 Physical, 2 Data Link, 3 Network, 4 Transport, 5 Session. So the 5th layer to receive is the Session layer.
eh: Receiver पर गिनती: 1 Physical, 2 Data Link, 3 Network, 4 Transport, 5 Session। इसलिए 5वीं layer Session है।
n: Layer order bottom-up: Physical(1), Data-link(2), Network(3), Transport(4), Session(5), Presentation(6), Application(7).
nh: Layer क्रम (bottom-up): Physical(1), Data-link(2), Network(3), Transport(4), Session(5), Presentation(6), Application(7)।

st: Section A — OSI Model: Basics, Layer Order & Support Layers
q: The session, presentation, and application layers are the ______ support layers.
qh: Session, Presentation और Application layers ______ support layers हैं।
e: Layers 5-6-7 (Session, Presentation, Application) are called USER support layers; layers 1-2-3 are NETWORK support layers; Transport (layer 4) joins both.
eh: Layers 5-6-7 (Session, Presentation, Application) USER support layers कहलाती हैं; layers 1-2-3 NETWORK support layers; Transport (layer 4) दोनों को जोड़ती है।
n: User support = 5,6,7. Network support = 1,2,3. Transport(4) = dono ka bridge.
nh: User support = 5,6,7। Network support = 1,2,3। Transport(4) = दोनों का bridge।

st: Section A — OSI Model: Basics, Layer Order & Support Layers
q: Which of the following is NOT a network support layer?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन network support layer नहीं है?
e: Network support layers = Physical(1), Data Link(2), Network(3). Transport(4) is the bridge between network and user support layers, so it is not counted as a network support layer.
eh: Network support layers = Physical(1), Data Link(2), Network(3)। Transport(4) network और user support layers के बीच bridge है।
n: Yaad rakho: NOT-network-support = Transport. (1,2,3 = network support; 5,6,7 = user support.)
nh: याद रखो: NOT-network-support = Transport। (1,2,3 = network support; 5,6,7 = user support.)

st: Section A — OSI Model: Basics, Layer Order & Support Layers
q: Network support layers are:
qh: Network support layers कौन-सी हैं?
e: Physical(1), Data Link(2) and Network(3) form the network support layers — they move data between the two end systems.
eh: Physical(1), Data Link(2) और Network(3) मिलकर network support layers बनाती हैं।
n: 1,2,3 = network support; 5,6,7 = user support; 4 = bridge. Exam mein ye grouping bar-bar aata hai.
nh: 1,2,3 = network support; 5,6,7 = user support; 4 = bridge।

st: Section A — OSI Model: Basics, Layer Order & Support Layers
q: Which layer connects the network support layers and the user support layers?
qh: कौन-सी layer network support layers और user support layers को जोड़ती है?
e: Transport (layer 4) sits between the network support layers (1-3) and user support layers (5-7) and joins them — it is often called the bridge layer.
eh: Transport (layer 4) network support layers (1-3) और user support layers (5-7) के बीच बैठकर दोनों को जोड़ती है — इसे bridge layer कहते हैं।
n: Transport = bridge layer (na upar wale, na neeche wale — dono se judta hai).
nh: Transport = bridge layer (ऊपर और नीचे दोनों से जुड़ती है)।

st: Section A — OSI Model: Basics, Layer Order & Support Layers
q: In the ISO-OSI reference model, the Session layer offers dialog control, token management and ______ as services.
qh: ISO-OSI reference model में Session layer dialog control, token management और ______ services देती है।
e: The Session layer's three classic services are dialog control, token management and synchronisation (checkpointing for recovery).
eh: Session layer की तीन classic services हैं: dialog control, token management और synchronization (recovery के लिए checkpointing)।
n: Session ki 3 services: Dialog control + Token management + Synchronization (checkpoint).
nh: Session की 3 services: Dialog control + Token management + Synchronization (checkpoint)।

st: Section A — OSI Model: Basics, Layer Order & Support Layers
q: How many address types (identifiers) are used from sender to receiver in OSI/TCP-IP communication?
qh: OSI/TCP-IP communication में sender से receiver तक कितने address types (identifiers) use होते हैं?
e: Forouzan: four levels of addresses are used — physical (link) address, logical (IP) address, port address and specific (user-friendly) address.
eh: Forouzan: चार levels के addresses use होते हैं — physical (link) address, logical (IP) address, port address और specific (user-friendly) address।
n: 4 addresses: Physical(48-bit) / IP(32-bit) / Port(16-bit) / Specific (user-friendly).
nh: 4 addresses: Physical(48-bit) / IP(32-bit) / Port(16-bit) / Specific।

st: Section A — OSI Model: Basics, Layer Order & Support Layers
q: Who developed the standards for the OSI reference model?
qh: OSI reference model के standards किसने develop किए?
o: IEEE - Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers
oh: IEEE - Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers
e: ISO (International Organization for Standardization) developed and published the OSI reference model standards.
eh: ISO (International Organization for Standardization) ने OSI reference model standards develop और publish किए।
n: OSI ke standards = ISO ke. ANSI/IEEE/ACM ke alag kaam hain (US standards / LAN / computing society).
nh: OSI के standards = ISO के। ANSI/IEEE/ACM के अलग काम हैं।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Fiber optic cables and coaxial cables function at which OSI layer?
qh: Fiber optic cables और coaxial cables किस OSI layer पर काम करती हैं?
e: Transmission media (fiber, coaxial, twisted pair) are used at the Physical layer — it transmits raw bits over the medium.
eh: Transmission media (fiber, coaxial, twisted pair) Physical layer पर use होती हैं — यह medium पर raw bits भेजती है।
n: Media (cable, fiber, radio) = Physical layer ka kaam.
nh: Media (cable, fiber, radio) = Physical layer का काम।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: The term 'Baud Rate' is associated with which layer?
qh: 'Baud Rate' शब्द किस layer से जुड़ा है?
e: Baud rate = number of signal changes per second — a Physical layer concept (signal/line encoding).
eh: Baud rate = प्रति सेकंड signal changes की संख्या — Physical layer की concept (signal/line encoding)।
n: Baud rate = signalling rate = Physical layer. Bit rate ≠ baud rate (bits per symbol yaad rakho).
nh: Baud rate = signalling rate = Physical layer। Bit rate ≠ baud rate।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: The layer used to deal with mechanical and electrical specifications is:
qh: Mechanical और electrical specifications से निपटने वाली layer कौन-सी है?
e: The Physical layer defines mechanical, electrical, functional and procedural specifications of the physical link (connectors, voltages, pin layout, signals).
eh: Physical layer physical link की mechanical, electrical, functional और procedural specifications define करती है (connectors, voltages, pin layout, signals)।
n: Mechanical + Electrical + Functional + Procedural = Physical layer ke 4 specifications.
nh: Mechanical + Electrical + Functional + Procedural = Physical layer की 4 specifications।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: The Physical layer deals with:
qh: Physical layer किससे निपटती है?
e: Physical layer = media, signals, line coding and bit (binary) transmission. Logical addressing = Network; error correction = Data Link/Transport; segmentation = Transport.
eh: Physical layer = media, signals, line coding और bit transmission। Logical addressing = Network; error correction = Data Link/Transport; segmentation = Transport।
n: Physical = bits + signals + media. Baaki sab upar ki layers ka kaam hai.
nh: Physical = bits + signals + media। बाकी ऊपर की layers का काम है।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: The Physical layer is responsible for which of the following operations?
qh: Physical layer निम्नलिखित में से किन operations के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
e: Line coding, channel coding and modulation are all Physical layer functions — they prepare the bits for transmission over the medium.
eh: Line coding, channel coding और modulation — तीनों Physical layer के functions हैं।
n: Physical layer = Line coding + Channel coding + Modulation + signals/media — 'All of the above' yaad rakho.
nh: Physical layer = Line coding + Channel coding + Modulation। 'All of the above' याद रखो।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Transmission data rate is decided by:
qh: Transmission data rate कौन तय करती है?
e: The data (bit) rate is a Physical layer property — it depends on the bandwidth of the medium and the encoding/modulation used.
eh: Data (bit) rate Physical layer की property है — यह medium की bandwidth और encoding/modulation पर निर्भर करती है।
n: Data rate = Physical layer. (Throughput/delay performance bhi isi layer ke signals par depend karti hai.)
nh: Data rate = Physical layer।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Repeaters function in:
qh: Repeaters किस layer पर काम करते हैं?
e: A repeater regenerates the electrical/optical signal — a Physical layer device (layer 1).
eh: Repeater electrical/optical signal regenerate करता है — Physical layer device (layer 1)।
n: Repeater/Hub = Physical (L1). Bridge/Switch = Data Link (L2). Router = Network (L3).
nh: Repeater/Hub = Physical (L1)। Bridge/Switch = Data Link (L2)। Router = Network (L3)।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: The physical layer is responsible for:
qh: Physical layer किसके लिए जिम्मेदार है?
e: Physical layer = transmission of individual bits over the link (bit-by-bit delivery). Port-to-port = Transport; process-to-process = Transport; application-to-application = Application. (Matches the official RPSC key.)
eh: Physical layer = link पर bit-by-bit delivery। Port-to-port = Transport; process-to-process = Transport; application-to-application = Application। (Official RPSC key से match.)
n: Bit-by-bit = Physical. Hop-to-hop = Data Link. Source-to-destination = Network. Process-to-process = Transport.
nh: Bit-by-bit = Physical। Hop-to-hop = Data Link। Source-to-destination = Network। Process-to-process = Transport।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: The sub-layer of the Physical layer which directly interfaces with the MAC sub-layer is called:
qh: Physical layer का वह sub-layer जो सीधे MAC sub-layer से जुड़ता है, कहलाता है:
e: In the IEEE 802 architecture the Physical Layer Signalling (PLS) sub-layer sits directly under the MAC sub-layer and passes frames to/from it.
eh: IEEE 802 architecture में Physical Layer Signalling (PLS) sub-layer सीधे MAC sub-layer के नीचे होता है और frames आदान-प्रदान करता है।
n: PLS (Physical Layer Signalling) = Physical layer ka upper sub-layer jo MAC se directly judta hai.
nh: PLS (Physical Layer Signalling) = Physical layer का upper sub-layer जो MAC से जुड़ता है।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: The physical layer translates logical communication requests from the ______ into hardware-specific operations.
qh: Physical layer, ______ के logical communication requests को hardware-specific operations में बदलता है।
e: The data link layer (directly above the physical layer) sends logical requests like 'transmit this frame'; the physical layer converts them into the electrical/optical hardware operations on the medium.
eh: Data link layer (physical layer के ठीक ऊपर) जैसे logical requests भेजती है — 'यह frame transmit करो'; physical layer उन्हें medium पर electrical/optical hardware operations में बदलती है।
n: Each layer serves the layer ABOVE it — physical serves data link. Exam banks sometimes mis-key this as 'network layer'; the correct neighbour is the data link layer.
nh: हर layer अपने ऊपर वाली layer की सेवा करती है — physical, data link की। कुछ exam banks इसे गलती से 'network layer' लिखते हैं; सही उत्तर data link layer है।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Which one of the following is a data link (Layer 2) protocol?
qh: निम्न में से कौन data link (Layer 2) protocol है?
e: PPP, HDLC and Ethernet are all data link layer (Layer 2) protocols — they frame packets and handle physical addressing/error detection at the link level.
eh: PPP, HDLC और Ethernet — तीनों data link layer (Layer 2) protocols हैं — ये packets को frame करते हैं और link level पर physical addressing/error detection करते हैं।
n: Layer 2 protocols = PPP, HDLC, Ethernet, Frame Relay, ATM (cell-based). Network layer = IP, ICMP, ARP.
nh: Layer 2 protocols = PPP, HDLC, Ethernet, Frame Relay, ATM (cell-based)। Network layer = IP, ICMP, ARP।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: The Application layer is implemented in:
qh: Application layer कहाँ implement होती है?
e: In the protocol stack, the application layer (like transport) is implemented in the end systems — the hosts (user's computer or the server) — not inside intermediate network devices.
eh: Protocol stack में application layer (transport की तरह) end systems में implement होती है — hosts (user का computer या server) में — बीच के network devices में नहीं।
n: End systems (hosts) implement layers up to the application; switches implement only Layers 1-2, routers only Layers 1-3.
nh: End systems (hosts) application तक की layers implement करते हैं; switches सिर्फ Layers 1-2, routers सिर्फ Layers 1-3।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Which layer of the OSI model is responsible for the transmission and reception of unstructured raw data between a device and a physical transmission medium?
qh: OSI model की कौन-सी layer device और physical transmission medium के बीच unstructured raw data के transmission और reception के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
e: Raw (unstructured) bit transmission over the medium is exactly the Physical layer's role.
eh: Medium पर raw (unstructured) bits भेजना Physical layer का ही काम है।
n: 'Raw data + physical medium' = Physical layer. SSC/Railway mein ye one-liner common hai.
nh: 'Raw data + physical medium' = Physical layer।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Which layer creates the 'collision domain'?
qh: 'Collision domain' कौन-सी layer बनाती है?
e: A collision domain exists on a shared medium — the shared physical connection created by hubs/repeaters (Physical layer devices). Switches/bridges (Data Link) SEPARATE collision domains; routers separate broadcast domains.
eh: Collision domain shared medium पर बनता है — hubs/repeaters (Physical layer devices) के shared connection से। Switches/bridges (Data Link) collision domains को अलग करते हैं; routers broadcast domains अलग करते हैं।
n: Hub network = ONE collision domain (Physical). Switch = per-port collision domain (Data Link). Router = broadcast domain boundary (Network).
nh: Hub network = एक collision domain (Physical)। Switch = per-port collision domain (Data Link)। Router = broadcast domain boundary (Network)।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Data Link Layer is divided into:
qh: Data Link Layer किनमें विभाजित है?
e: The IEEE 802 Data Link layer has two sub-layers: LLC (Logical Link Control, 802.2) and MAC (Media Access Control, e.g. 802.3).
eh: IEEE 802 Data Link layer के दो sub-layers हैं: LLC (Logical Link Control, 802.2) और MAC (Media Access Control, जैसे 802.3)।
n: Data Link = LLC (upper, 802.2) + MAC (lower, 802.3). Ye hamesha saath aate hain.
nh: Data Link = LLC (ऊपर, 802.2) + MAC (नीचे, 802.3)।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Which statement best describes the difference between the LLC and MAC sub-layers?
qh: LLC और MAC sub-layers के बीच अंतर सबसे अच्छा कौन बताता है?
o: LLC handles physical addressing, MAC handles flow control
LLC provides the service interface to the Network layer; MAC controls access to the medium
LLC works only in wireless networks, MAC only in wired networks
LLC performs framing, MAC performs routing
oh: LLC physical addressing करता है, MAC flow control करता है
LLC, Network layer को service interface देता है; MAC medium तक access control करता है
LLC सिर्फ wireless में, MAC सिर्फ wired में काम करता है
LLC framing करता है, MAC routing करता है
e: LLC (802.2) provides an interface to the Network layer (flow/error control over the link); MAC (802.3 etc.) handles physical addressing and media access (CSMA/CD etc.).
eh: LLC (802.2) Network layer को interface देता है; MAC (802.3 आदि) physical addressing और media access (CSMA/CD आदि) संभालता है।
n: LLC = upar wala sub-layer (network layer se link). MAC = neeche wala (medium access + physical address).
nh: LLC = ऊपर का sub-layer। MAC = नीचे का (medium access + physical address)।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Physical (hardware) addressing is added at:
qh: Physical (hardware) addressing किस layer पर जोड़ी जाती है?
e: The MAC/physical address (48-bit) is added to the frame header at the Data Link layer.
eh: MAC/physical address (48-bit) frame header में Data Link layer पर जोड़ी जाती है।
n: Physical/MAC address = Data Link. IP/Logical = Network. Port = Transport.
nh: Physical/MAC address = Data Link। IP/Logical = Network। Port = Transport।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: A frame is received at the Data Link layer with an incorrect FCS. What will happen?
qh: Data Link layer पर frame गलत FCS के साथ प्राप्त होता है। क्या होगा?
e: FCS (Frame Check Sequence, usually CRC) detects errors; a frame with a bad FCS is silently discarded by the receiver's Data Link layer (retransmission, if any, is a higher-level/ARQ decision).
eh: FCS (Frame Check Sequence, सामान्यतः CRC) errors detect करता है; गलत FCS वाला frame receiver की Data Link layer द्वारा discard कर दिया जाता है।
n: Bad FCS = frame drop (discard). Correction/Data Link khud re-transmit nahi karti — wo ARQ/higher layer ka decision hai.
nh: गलत FCS = frame discard।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: 'Transparent transmission' is the function of which layer?
qh: 'Transparent transmission' किस layer का काम है?
e: The Data Link layer makes the physical link look error-free/transparent to the Network layer — it hides all bit-level details.
eh: Data Link layer physical link को Network layer के लिए error-free/transparent बनाती है — सारी bit-level details छिपा देती है।
n: Data Link = 'transparent service' — Network layer ko pata hi nahi chalta ki neeche kitni mehnat hui.
nh: Data Link = 'transparent service' — Network layer को नीचे की मेहनत पता नहीं चलती।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Which layer handles 'hop-to-hop' flow control?
qh: 'Hop-to-hop' flow control कौन-सी layer संभालती है?
e: Hop-to-hop (node-to-node) flow control is done by the Data Link layer between two adjacent nodes; end-to-end flow control is Transport's job.
eh: Hop-to-hop (node-to-node) flow control Data Link layer करती है; end-to-end flow control Transport का काम है।
n: Hop-to-hop = Data Link. End-to-end = Transport. Dono flow control karte hain — scope alag hai.
nh: Hop-to-hop = Data Link। End-to-end = Transport।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: The ______ layer is responsible for delivering data units from one station to the next without errors.
qh: ______ layer data units को एक station से अगले station तक बिना errors पहुँचाने के लिए जिम्मेदार है।
e: Forouzan: the Data Link layer is responsible for delivering data units from one station to the NEXT without errors (hop-to-hop delivery).
eh: Forouzan: Data Link layer data units को एक station से अगले तक बिना errors पहुँचाती है (hop-to-hop delivery)।
n: 'Station to next station' = Data Link (hop-to-hop). 'Source to destination' = Network.
nh: 'Station to next station' = Data Link। 'Source to destination' = Network।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: ______ Layer is responsible for framing, error detection and physical addressing.
qh: ______ Layer framing, error detection और physical addressing के लिए जिम्मेदार है।
e: Framing, error detection (CRC/FCS) and physical (MAC) addressing — all three are classic Data Link layer responsibilities.
eh: Framing, error detection (CRC/FCS) और physical (MAC) addressing — तीनों Data Link layer की जिम्मेदारी हैं।
n: Framing + Error detection + MAC addressing = Data Link ka 'trio'.
nh: Framing + Error detection + MAC addressing = Data Link का trio।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Bridge works in which layer of the OSI model?
qh: Bridge OSI model की किस layer पर काम करता है?
e: A bridge connects two LAN segments and filters/forwards frames using MAC addresses — a Data Link layer (layer 2) device.
eh: Bridge दो LAN segments को जोड़ता है और MAC addresses से frames filter/forward करता है — Data Link layer (layer 2) device।
n: Bridge/Switch = L2. Router = L3. Hub/Repeater = L1. Gateway = L4+.
nh: Bridge/Switch = L2। Router = L3। Hub/Repeater = L1। Gateway = L4+।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: From which layer does the Data Link layer collect packets and encapsulate them into frames for transmission?
qh: Data Link layer किस layer से packets लेकर उन्हें transmission के लिए frames में encapsulate करती है?
e: The Data Link layer receives packets (datagrams) from the Network layer above and encapsulates them into frames.
eh: Data Link layer ऊपर की Network layer से packets (datagrams) लेती है और उन्हें frames में encapsulate करती है।
n: Encapsulation: Network packet -> Data Link frame -> Physical bits. Upar se neeche.
nh: Encapsulation: Network packet -> Data Link frame -> Physical bits।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Which OSI layer is responsible for logical addressing?
qh: Logical addressing के लिए कौन-सी OSI layer जिम्मेदार है?
e: Logical (IP) addressing and routing are Network layer functions (layer 3).
eh: Logical (IP) addressing और routing Network layer (layer 3) के functions हैं।
n: Logical address = IP = Network layer (L3). Physical address = MAC = Data Link (L2).
nh: Logical address = IP = Network layer (L3)। Physical address = MAC = Data Link (L2)।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: IPv4 and IPv6 work at which OSI layer?
qh: IPv4 और IPv6 किस OSI layer पर काम करते हैं?
e: IP (IPv4/IPv6) is the Network layer protocol of the Internet — layer 3.
eh: IP (IPv4/IPv6) Internet का Network layer protocol है — layer 3।
n: IP = Internet Protocol = Network/Internet layer (L3). Hamesha!
nh: IP = Network/Internet layer (L3)।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: The ______ layer is responsible for the source-to-destination delivery of a packet across multiple network links.
qh: ______ layer एक packet की multiple network links के बीच source-to-destination delivery के लिए जिम्मेदार है।
e: Forouzan: the Network layer handles source-to-destination (host-to-host) delivery of a packet across multiple links via routing.
eh: Forouzan: Network layer routing के जरिए packet की multiple links के बीच source-to-destination delivery करती है।
n: Source-to-destination = Network. Process-to-process = Transport. Station-to-station = Data Link.
nh: Source-to-destination = Network। Process-to-process = Transport। Station-to-station = Data Link।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Which layer performs segmentation?
qh: Segmentation कौन-सी layer करती है?
e: The Transport layer splits the message into segments and reassembles them at the destination (segmentation and reassembly).
eh: Transport layer message को segments में बाँटती है और destination पर जोड़ती है (segmentation and reassembly)।
n: Segmentation + Reassembly = Transport. (Packetisation Network ki, Framing Data Link ki.)
nh: Segmentation + Reassembly = Transport। (Packetisation Network की, Framing Data Link की।)

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Which layer provides end-to-end communication?
qh: End-to-end communication कौन-सी layer देती है?
e: Transport provides end-to-end (process-to-process) communication between the two end hosts.
eh: Transport दोनों end hosts के बीच end-to-end (process-to-process) communication देती है।
n: End-to-end = Transport. Source-to-destination = Network. Hop-to-hop = Data Link. Bit-by-bit = Physical.
nh: End-to-end = Transport। Source-to-destination = Network। Hop-to-hop = Data Link। Bit-by-bit = Physical।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: In the OSI model, which layer(s) participate in 'end-to-end' delivery? (1) Network (2) Transport (3) Session (4) Data link
qh: OSI model में 'end-to-end' delivery में कौन-सी layer(s) भाग लेती हैं? (1) Network (2) Transport (3) Session (4) Data link
e: In OSI terminology 'end-to-end' means between the two end TRANSPORT entities — that is the Transport layer (2 only). Network is source-to-destination; Data Link is hop-to-hop.
eh: OSI terminology में 'end-to-end' का अर्थ दोनों end TRANSPORT entities के बीच है — यानी सिर्फ Transport layer (2 only)।
n: End-to-end = Transport only. (Network = host-to-host, Data Link = hop-to-hop.)
nh: End-to-end = सिर्फ Transport।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Which layer performs 'service point addressing'?
qh: 'Service point addressing' कौन-सी layer करती है?
e: Service point addressing = using PORT addresses to reach the correct process on a host — a Transport layer function.
eh: Service point addressing = host पर सही process तक पहुँचने के लिए PORT addresses का उपयोग — Transport layer का काम।
n: Service point = Port. Port addressing = Transport (16-bit port numbers).
nh: Service point = Port। Port addressing = Transport (16-bit port numbers)।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Which OSI layer handles message boundaries (knowing where one message ends and the next begins)?
qh: कौन-सी OSI layer message boundaries संभालती है (एक message कहाँ समाप्त होता है और अगला कहाँ शुरू)?
e: Message boundaries are a Transport concern: message-oriented delivery (e.g. UDP/user datagrams) preserves each message as a separate unit at the destination.
eh: Message boundaries Transport की चिंता है: message-oriented delivery (जैसे UDP/user datagrams) हर message को अलग unit रूप में रखती है।
n: Message boundary = transport-level concept (UDP message = poora message).
nh: Message boundary = transport-level concept।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: The reliable data transfer is implemented by:
qh: Reliable data transfer कौन-सी layer implement करती है?
e: Reliability (acknowledgements, retransmission, in-order delivery) is implemented by the Transport layer (e.g. TCP). (Matches the official RPSC key.)
eh: Reliability (acknowledgements, retransmission, in-order delivery) Transport layer implement करती है (जैसे TCP)। (Official RPSC key से match.)
n: Reliable delivery = Transport (TCP). IP (Network) unreliable hai — best-effort only.
nh: Reliable delivery = Transport (TCP)। IP (Network) unreliable है।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Which layer is responsible for reliable delivery in the OSI model?
qh: OSI model में reliable delivery के लिए कौन-सी layer जिम्मेदार है?
e: The Transport layer ensures reliable (error-free, in-order) message delivery between processes.
eh: Transport layer processes के बीच reliable (error-free, in-order) message delivery सुनिश्चित करती है।
n: Reliable = Transport. (OSI Transport class 4 = error recovery wali service.)
nh: Reliable = Transport।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Which layer is responsible for process-to-process delivery?
qh: Process-to-process delivery के लिए कौन-सी layer जिम्मेदार है?
e: Process-to-process (end-to-end) delivery of the entire message is the Transport layer's responsibility, using port addresses.
eh: पूरे message की process-to-process (end-to-end) delivery Transport layer की जिम्मेदारी है, port addresses के साथ।
n: Process-to-process = Transport (ports ke saath). Host-to-host = Network (IP ke saath).
nh: Process-to-process = Transport। Host-to-host = Network।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: If a port number is 16 bits (2 bytes), what is the MINIMUM size of the transport-layer header needed to carry the port addresses?
qh: यदि port number 16 bits (2 bytes) का है, तो port addresses ले जाने के लिए transport-layer header की MINIMUM size कितनी होगी?
e: A transport header must carry at least two port numbers (source + destination) = 2 × 2 bytes = 4 bytes. (Real protocols add more: UDP header = 8 bytes, TCP header = 20 bytes.)
eh: Transport header में कम से कम दो port numbers (source + destination) होते हैं = 2 × 2 bytes = 4 bytes। (असली protocols में और fields होते हैं: UDP = 8 bytes, TCP = 20 bytes।)
n: Min transport header (ports only) = 4 bytes. UDP = 8, TCP = 20 — teeno numbers exam mein aate hain.
nh: Min transport header (ports only) = 4 bytes। UDP = 8, TCP = 20।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Determine the OSI layer responsible for dialogue control (half-duplex or full-duplex communication).
qh: Dialogue control (half-duplex या full-duplex communication) के लिए कौन-सी OSI layer जिम्मेदार है?
e: Dialog control — deciding whose turn it is to speak (half/full-duplex dialog) — is a Session layer service.
eh: Dialog control — किसकी बारी है (half/full-duplex dialog) — Session layer की service है।
n: Dialog control + Token management + Synchronization = Session layer ka kaam.
nh: Dialog control + Token management + Synchronization = Session layer का काम।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Which layer supports 'checkpointing' (synchronisation for recovery)?
qh: कौन-सी layer 'checkpointing' (recovery के लिए synchronization) support करती है?
e: The Session layer inserts checkpoints/synchronisation points in the data stream so a dialog can resume after a failure.
eh: Session layer data stream में checkpoints/synchronisation points लगाती है ताकि failure के बाद dialog जारी रह सके।
n: Checkpointing = Session (synchronization). Ye exam ka classic sawaal hai.
nh: Checkpointing = Session।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Which layer translates data from a format used by the application into a common format (e.g., ASCII to EBCDIC)?
qh: कौन-सी layer data को application के format से common format में बदलती है (जैसे ASCII से EBCDIC)?
e: Translation between data formats (ASCII/EBCDIC), encryption and compression are Presentation layer jobs.
eh: Data formats के बीच translation (ASCII/EBCDIC), encryption और compression Presentation layer का काम है।
n: Presentation = Translation + Encryption + Compression (TEC). ASCII<->EBCDIC isi layer ka classic example hai.
nh: Presentation = Translation + Encryption + Compression।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Which OSI layer ensures interoperability between different data formats?
qh: कौन-सी OSI layer अलग-अलग data formats के बीच interoperability सुनिश्चित करती है?
e: The Presentation layer provides a common data representation/translation so different systems understand each other's formats.
eh: Presentation layer एक common data representation/translation देती है ताकि अलग systems एक-दूसरे के formats समझ सकें।
n: Common format = Presentation. Isi liye ise 'syntax layer' bhi kehte hain.
nh: Common format = Presentation। इसे 'syntax layer' भी कहते हैं।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Which OSI layer decides the type of compression?
qh: कौन-सी OSI layer compression का प्रकार तय करती है?
e: Data compression (and its type) is a Presentation layer function.
eh: Data compression (और उसका प्रकार) Presentation layer का काम है।
n: Compression = Presentation. (Encryption aur translation bhi isi ke saath.)
nh: Compression = Presentation।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Which OSI layer is responsible for encryption and compression?
qh: Encryption और compression के लिए कौन-सी OSI layer जिम्मेदार है?
e: Both encryption and compression are Presentation layer functions (layer 6).
eh: Encryption और compression दोनों Presentation layer (layer 6) के functions हैं।
n: Trio yaad rakho: Translation, Encryption, Compression = Presentation.
nh: Trio: Translation, Encryption, Compression = Presentation।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Which layer helps to present data in one form on a host to another host in its native representation?
qh: कौन-सी layer एक host पर किसी form में data को दूसरे host पर उसकी native representation में प्रस्तुत करने में मदद करती है?
e: Converting between a host's internal representation and a common format is the Presentation layer's translation job.
eh: Host की internal representation और common format के बीच बदलना Presentation layer का translation काम है।
n: Native format <-> common format = Presentation (translation).
nh: Native format <-> common format = Presentation।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: ______ layer defines how data is formatted, presented, encoded, and converted for use on the network.
qh: ______ layer तय करती है कि data network में उपयोग के लिए कैसे format, present, encode और convert होता है।
e: This is the textbook definition of the Presentation layer — formatting, encoding and conversion of data.
eh: यह Presentation layer की textbook definition है — data का formatting, encoding और conversion।
n: 'Formatted, presented, encoded, converted' = Presentation ke liye mnemonic-type line.
nh: 'Formatted, presented, encoded, converted' = Presentation।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Which layer provides services to the user?
qh: कौन-सी layer user को services देती है?
e: The Application layer (layer 7) provides network services directly to user applications (HTTP, FTP, SMTP, DNS...).
eh: Application layer (layer 7) user applications को सीधे network services देती है (HTTP, FTP, SMTP, DNS...)।
n: User ke sabse kareeb = Application layer (L7).
nh: User के सबसे करीब = Application layer (L7)।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: A server at a company is using TCP/IP to connect to the network and is running multiple applications. At which OSI layer is this server operating?
qh: एक company का server network से जुड़ने के लिए TCP/IP use कर रहा है और अनेक applications चला रहा है। यह server किस OSI layer पर काम कर रहा है?
e: Running multiple applications that serve users = Application layer work (the applications use the lower layers for delivery).
eh: users के लिए अनेक applications चलाना = Application layer का काम (applications नीचे की layers use करती हैं)।
n: Server + running applications = Application layer.
nh: Server + applications = Application layer।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) runs on:
qh: Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) किस layer पर चलता है?
e: SNMP is an Application layer protocol (it uses UDP at the transport layer to manage network devices).
eh: SNMP एक Application layer protocol है (network devices manage करने के लिए यह UDP use करता है)।
n: SNMP/DNS/HTTP/FTP/SMTP = Application layer protocols. UDP/TCP = Transport. IP = Network.
nh: SNMP/DNS/HTTP/FTP/SMTP = Application layer protocols।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Application layer protocol defines:
qh: Application layer protocol क्या define करता है?
o: Rules for when and how processes send and respond to messages
oh: processes messages कब और कैसे भेजें/जवाब दें — इसके rules
e: An application-layer protocol defines the message types, the rules for when/how processes send and respond, and the message format (syntax + semantics) — all of the above.
eh: Application-layer protocol message types, भेजने/जवाब के rules, और message format (syntax + semantics) — सब define करता है।
n: Application protocol = Message types + Rules + Format. 'All of the above' hi jawab hai.
nh: Application protocol = Message types + Rules + Format।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: SMTP, FTP and DNS are the protocols of which layer of the OSI model?
qh: SMTP, FTP और DNS OSI model की किस layer के protocols हैं?
e: SMTP (e-mail), FTP (file transfer) and DNS (name resolution) are all Application layer protocols (layer 7).
eh: SMTP (e-mail), FTP (file transfer) और DNS (name resolution) — तीनों Application layer protocols (layer 7) हैं।
n: User-facing protocols (HTTP, FTP, SMTP, DNS, POP3, IMAP) = Application layer.
nh: User-facing protocols = Application layer।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q:
Consider the statements:
S1: Network layer handles both logical addressing and routing.
S2: Transport layer handles segmentation and reassembly.
Which is correct?
qh:
Statements देखिए:
S1: Network layer logical addressing और routing दोनों संभालती है।
S2: Transport layer segmentation और reassembly संभालती है।
कौन सा सही है?
e: Both statements are textbook-correct: Network = logical addressing + routing; Transport = segmentation + reassembly.
eh: दोनों statements textbook-correct हैं: Network = logical addressing + routing; Transport = segmentation + reassembly।
n: Network = IP addressing + Routing. Transport = Segmentation + Reassembly. Dono sahi.
nh: Network = IP addressing + Routing। Transport = Segmentation + Reassembly।

st: Section C — TCP/IP Model
q: TCP/IP model does not have ______ layer but the OSI model has it.
qh: TCP/IP model में ______ layer नहीं है पर OSI model में है।
e: TCP/IP has no separate Session or Presentation layers — their functions are absorbed by the TCP/IP Application layer. (OSI = 7 layers; TCP/IP = 4 layers.)
eh: TCP/IP में Session या Presentation की अलग layer नहीं है — उनके काम TCP/IP की Application layer में आ जाते हैं।
n: TCP/IP mein Session + Presentation nahi hoti — dono Application mein merge ho jaati hain.
nh: TCP/IP में Session + Presentation नहीं होती — दोनों Application में merge होती हैं।

st: Section C — TCP/IP Model
q: The TCP/IP model was developed ______ the OSI model.
qh: TCP/IP model, OSI model के ______ develop हुआ।
e: TCP/IP was developed in the 1970s (by Cerf & Kahn for ARPANET/DoD) — BEFORE the OSI model (published by ISO in 1984).
eh: TCP/IP 1970s में develop हुआ (Cerf & Kahn ने ARPANET/DoD के लिए) — OSI model (1984) से पहले।
n: TCP/IP (1970s, adopted 1983) PEHLE; OSI (1984) BAAD mein. 'Prior to' yaad rakho.
nh: TCP/IP (1970s) पहले; OSI (1984) बाद में।

st: Section C — TCP/IP Model
q: The TCP/IP ______ layer is equivalent to the combined Session, Presentation and Application layers of the OSI model.
qh: TCP/IP की ______ layer, OSI model की Session, Presentation और Application layers के समकक्ष है।
e: The TCP/IP Application layer covers what OSI layers 5 + 6 + 7 do (application + presentation + session).
eh: TCP/IP Application layer वही करती है जो OSI की layers 5 + 6 + 7 करती हैं।
n: Mapping: TCP/IP Application = OSI Session+Presentation+Application; TCP/IP Internet = OSI Network; TCP/IP Network Access = OSI Data Link+Physical.
nh: Mapping: TCP/IP Application = OSI 5+6+7; Internet = Network; Network Access = Data Link+Physical।

st: Section C — TCP/IP Model
q: Which of the following is NOT a part of the TCP/IP model?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन TCP/IP model का हिस्सा नहीं है?
e: TCP/IP (4-layer) = Application, Transport, Internet, Network Access. Session is an OSI layer with no separate TCP/IP layer.
eh: TCP/IP (4-layer) = Application, Transport, Internet, Network Access। Session OSI की layer है, TCP/IP में अलग नहीं।
n: TCP/IP ke 4 layers: Application, Transport, Internet, Network Access. Session sirf OSI mein.
nh: TCP/IP की 4 layers: Application, Transport, Internet, Network Access। Session सिर्फ OSI में।

st: Section C — TCP/IP Model
q: The number of layers in the Internet protocol stack (reference model) is:
qh: Internet protocol stack (reference model) में layers की संख्या कितनी है?
e: The TCP/IP Internet reference (protocol) stack has 5 layers: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Application. (The original TCP/IP suite has 4 — Network Access merges Physical+Data Link.)
eh: TCP/IP Internet reference stack में 5 layers हैं: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Application। (मूल TCP/IP suite में 4 — Network Access में Physical+Data Link मिले हुए।)
n: 5-layer Internet stack vs 4-layer TCP/IP suite vs 7-layer OSI — teeno numbers exam mein aate hain!
nh: 5-layer Internet stack, 4-layer TCP/IP suite, 7-layer OSI — तीनों numbers याद रखो!

st: Section C — TCP/IP Model
q: How many layers are there in the TCP/IP model (original 4-layer suite)?
qh: TCP/IP model (मूल 4-layer suite) में कितनी layers हैं?
e: The original TCP/IP model has 4 layers: Network Access, Internet, Host-to-Host (Transport), Application.
eh: मूल TCP/IP model में 4 layers हैं: Network Access, Internet, Host-to-Host (Transport), Application।
n: 4-layer TCP/IP: Network Access + Internet + Transport (Host-to-Host) + Application.
nh: 4-layer TCP/IP: Network Access + Internet + Transport + Application।

st: Section C — TCP/IP Model
q: Which of the following is NOT a layer of the TCP/IP model? (Host-to-Host / Internet / Network Access / Physical)
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन TCP/IP model की layer नहीं है? (Host-to-Host / Internet / Network Access / Physical)
e: The 4-layer TCP/IP suite has no separate Physical layer — physical functions are part of Network Access.
eh: 4-layer TCP/IP suite में अलग Physical layer नहीं है — physical functions Network Access का हिस्सा हैं।
n: TCP/IP ki 4 layers: Network Access, Internet, Host-to-Host, Application. 'Physical' alag layer nahi hai.
nh: TCP/IP की 4 layers: Network Access, Internet, Host-to-Host, Application।

st: Section C — TCP/IP Model
q: The Data Link layer and Physical layer of the OSI model combine to form the ______ layer of the TCP/IP model.
qh: OSI model की Data Link और Physical layers मिलकर TCP/IP model की ______ layer बनाती हैं।
e: OSI layers 1 + 2 (Physical + Data Link) map to the single TCP/IP Network Access layer.
eh: OSI की layers 1 + 2 (Physical + Data Link) मिलकर TCP/IP की Network Access layer बनाती हैं।
n: OSI 1+2 = TCP/IP Network Access. OSI 5+6+7 = TCP/IP Application. Bas ye 2 mappings yaad rakho.
nh: OSI 1+2 = Network Access। OSI 5+6+7 = Application।

st: Section C — TCP/IP Model
q: IP (Internet Protocol) is a protocol of the ______ layer of the TCP/IP model.
qh: IP (Internet Protocol) TCP/IP model की ______ layer का protocol है.
e: IP, ICMP, ARP work at the Internet layer of TCP/IP (equivalent to the OSI Network layer).
eh: IP, ICMP, ARP TCP/IP की Internet layer पर काम करते हैं (OSI Network layer के समकक्ष)।
n: IP = Internet layer. TCP/UDP = Transport. Ethernet = Network Access.
nh: IP = Internet layer। TCP/UDP = Transport। Ethernet = Network Access।

st: Section C — TCP/IP Model
q: In TCP/IP, which layer uses specific (user-friendly) addresses — e.g. a URL like example.com?
qh: TCP/IP में कौन-सी layer specific (user-friendly) addresses use करती है — जैसे example.com जैसी URL?
e: Forouzan's four address levels: specific/user-friendly addresses (URLs, domain names) are used at the Application layer; port addresses at Transport; IP at Network; physical (MAC) at Data Link.
eh: Forouzan के चार address levels: specific/user-friendly addresses (URL, domain name) Application layer पर; port addresses Transport पर; IP Network पर; MAC Data Link पर।
n: Address levels: Application = specific (URL), Transport = port (16-bit), Network = IP (32/128-bit), Data Link = MAC (48-bit).
nh: Address levels: Application = specific, Transport = port, Network = IP, Data Link = MAC।

st: Section C — TCP/IP Model
q: In the TCP/IP model, a link-layer switch operates at which layers?
qh: TCP/IP model में link-layer switch किन layers पर काम करता है?
e: A link-layer switch reads MAC addresses and regenerates signals — it works at the Physical and Data Link layers (the TCP/IP Network Access layer).
eh: link-layer switch MAC addresses पढ़ता है और signals regenerate करता है — यह Physical और Data Link layers (Network Access) पर काम करता है।
n: Switch = L1+L2 (Network Access). Router = L3 tak. Gateway = L4+.
nh: Switch = L1+L2। Router = L3 तक। Gateway = L4+।

st: Section C — TCP/IP Model
q: Which is the standard protocol suite of the Internet?
qh: Internet की मानक protocol suite कौन-सी है?
e: TCP/IP ही Internet की standard protocol suite है — इसी पर पूरा Internet चलता है.
eh: TCP/IP ही Internet की standard protocol suite है — इसी पर पूरा Internet चलता है.
n: UDP/FTP इसी suite के अंदर के protocols हैं; WWW तो सेवा है, protocol नहीं.
nh: UDP/FTP इसी suite के अंदर के protocols हैं; WWW तो सेवा है, protocol नहीं.

st: Section D — Comparison, Encapsulation & PDUs
q: Identify the correct order of data encapsulation from Layer 7 to Layer 1:
qh: Layer 7 से Layer 1 तक data encapsulation का सही क्रम पहचानिए:
e: Going down the OSI stack: Application data → Transport segment → Network packet → Data Link frame → Physical bits.
eh: OSI stack में नीचे जाते हुए: Application data → Transport segment → Network packet → Data Link frame → Physical bits।
n: Encapsulation order: Data -> Segment -> Packet -> Frame -> Bits. Mnemonic: 'Do Some People Fear Barking?'
nh: Encapsulation: Data -> Segment -> Packet -> Frame -> Bits।

st: Section D — Comparison, Encapsulation & PDUs
q: Encapsulation happens from:
qh: Encapsulation किस दिशा में होती है?
e: At the sender, each layer adds its header going DOWN the stack (top to bottom); the receiver removes headers going UP (bottom to top).
eh: Sender पर हर layer नीचे जाते हुए अपना header जोड़ती है (top to bottom); receiver पर ऊपर जाते हुए headers हटते हैं (bottom to top)।
n: Sender = encapsulation (top->bottom, headers add). Receiver = de-encapsulation (bottom->top, headers remove).
nh: Sender = encapsulation (top->bottom)। Receiver = de-encapsulation (bottom->top)।

st: Section D — Comparison, Encapsulation & PDUs
q: In the layer hierarchy, as the data packet moves from the upper to the lower layers, headers are:
qh: Layer hierarchy में, जब data packet ऊपर से नीचे की layers की ओर जाता है, तो headers:
e: Each lower layer ADDS its own header (and sometimes a trailer) to the data unit received from above — that is encapsulation.
eh: हर नीचे की layer ऊपर से आए data unit में अपना header (कभी-कभी trailer) जोड़ती है — यही encapsulation है।
n: Down the stack = headers ADD. Up the stack = headers REMOVE.
nh: नीचे की ओर = headers ADD। ऊपर की ओर = headers REMOVE।

st: Section D — Comparison, Encapsulation & PDUs
q: A source S and destination D are connected through ONE intermediate router R. How many times does a packet visit the Network layer and the Data Link layer during the journey?
qh: Source S और destination D के बीच एक intermediate router R है। यात्रा के दौरान packet Network layer और Data Link layer को कितनी बार visit करता है?
o: Network layer - 4 times, Data link layer - 4 times
Network layer - 4 times, Data link layer - 6 times
Network layer - 2 times, Data link layer - 4 times
Network layer - 3 times, Data link layer - 4 times
oh: Network layer - 4 times, Data link layer - 4 times
Network layer - 4 times, Data link layer - 6 times
Network layer - 2 times, Data link layer - 4 times
Network layer - 3 times, Data link layer - 4 times
e: Network layer: once at S (send), once at R (forward), once at D (receive) = 3. Data Link: 2 links (S→R, R→D), each visited twice (send + receive) = 4.
eh: Network layer: S पर 1, R पर 1, D पर 1 = 3 बार। Data Link: 2 links (S→R, R→D), हर link 2 बार (send + receive) = 4 बार।
n: Formula: n routers -> Network layer visits = n+2, Data Link visits = 2(n+1). Yahan n=1 -> NL=3, DL=4.
nh: Formula: n routers -> Network layer = n+2, Data Link = 2(n+1)। यहाँ n=1 -> NL=3, DL=4।

st: Section D — Comparison, Encapsulation & PDUs
q: In TCP/IP, which data unit is encapsulated INSIDE a frame?
qh: TCP/IP में कौन-सा data unit frame के अंदर encapsulate होता है?
e: The Data Link layer encapsulates the Network layer's packet (datagram) inside a frame (frame = header + datagram + trailer).
eh: Data Link layer Network layer के packet (datagram) को frame के अंदर encapsulate करती है (frame = header + datagram + trailer)।
n: Frame ke andar DATAGRAM hota hai. Segment -> Datagram -> Frame -> Bits.
nh: Frame के अंदर DATAGRAM होता है।

st: Section D — Comparison, Encapsulation & PDUs
q: In the TCP/IP model, the unit of data at the transport layer is called a:
qh: TCP/IP model में transport layer पर data की unit कहलाती है:
e: Transport layer data unit = segment (TCP) or user datagram (UDP); Network = datagram/packet; Data Link = frame; Physical = bits.
eh: Transport layer की data unit = segment (TCP) या user datagram (UDP); Network = datagram/packet; Data Link = frame; Physical = bits।
n: PDU pairs: Transport = Segment, Network = Datagram/Packet, Data Link = Frame, Physical = Bits.
nh: PDU: Transport = Segment, Network = Datagram, Data Link = Frame, Physical = Bits।

st: Section D — Comparison, Encapsulation & PDUs
q: A system uses five protocol layers. The application creates a 100-byte message and EVERY layer (including the 5th and the 1st) adds a 10-byte header. What is the efficiency (application bytes / total transmitted bytes)?
qh: एक system में पाँच protocol layers हैं। Application 100-byte message बनाती है और हर layer (5वीं और 1वीं सहित) 10-byte header जोड़ती है। Efficiency कितनी होगी (application bytes / कुल transmitted bytes)?
e: Total bytes = 100 (message) + 5 × 10 (headers) = 150. Efficiency = 100/150 = 2/3 ≈ 66.7%.
eh: कुल bytes = 100 (message) + 5 × 10 (headers) = 150। Efficiency = 100/150 = 2/3 ≈ 66.7%।
n: Encapsulation overhead numerical: efficiency = data / (data + headers). 100/(100+50) = 66.7%.
nh: Efficiency = data / (data + headers) = 100/150 = 66.7%।

st: Section A — OSI Model: Basics, Layer Order & Support Layers
q: In the OSI model, layers 5, 6 and 7 are mainly called:
qh: OSI model में layers 5, 6, 7 को मुख्यतः कहा जाता है:
e: Layers 1–4 support (transport) layers; 5–7 user support layers.
eh: Layers 1–4 support; 5–7 user support।
n: Support layers 1–4 hoti hain.
nh: Support layers 1–4।

st: Section A — OSI Model: Basics, Layer Order & Support Layers
q: Two communicating hosts exchange data between the same layers using:
qh: दो hosts एक ही layers के बीच data किससे बदलते हैं?
e: Same layer ka communication = peer-to-peer protocol; different layers ka apna interface.
eh: एक ही layer = peer protocol; अलग layers = interface।
n: Interface upar/neeche ki layer se hota hai.
nh: Interface ऊपर/नीचे की layer से।

st: Section A — OSI Model: Basics, Layer Order & Support Layers
q: In the OSI model, error control as well as flow control are performed by which TWO layers?
qh: OSI model में error control और flow control दोनों किन दो layers में होते हैं?
e: Data link = link (node-to-node) par flow+error control; transport = end-to-end par flow+error control — dono layers ye dono kaam karti hain.
eh: Data link = link पर; transport = end-to-end — दोनों layers ये काम करती हैं।
n: Network layer sirf routing/forwarding; session = dialog control.
nh: Network layer सिर्फ routing; session = dialog control।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Which layer adds a trailer (FCS) to the frame?
qh: कौन-सी layer frame में trailer (FCS) जोड़ती है?
e: Data link layer frame mein header + trailer (FCS) dono lagati hai.
eh: Data link layer header + trailer (FCS) दोनों लगाती है।
n: Baaki layers sirf header.
nh: बाक़ी सिर्फ़ header।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: A router operates at which layer of the OSI model?
qh: Router OSI model की किस layer पर काम करता है?
e: Router = layer 3 (Network) — IP addresses par decision.
eh: Router = layer 3 — IP पर निर्णय।
n: Switch layer 2 par.
nh: Switch layer 2 पर।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Encryption and compression of data are the responsibilities of:
qh: Data का encryption और compression किसकी ज़िम्मेदारी है?
e: Presentation layer = translate, encrypt, compress.
eh: Presentation = translate, encrypt, compress।
n: Session dialog control karti hai.
nh: Session dialog control करती है।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Establishing, managing and terminating sessions is done by:
qh: Sessions की स्थापना, प्रबंधन और समाप्ति किसका काम है?
e: Session layer = dialog control + synchronization.
eh: Session layer = dialog control + synchronization।
n: Transport end-to-end delivery deta hai.
nh: Transport end-to-end देता है।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: The PDU of the network layer is called:
qh: Network layer की PDU कहलाती है:
e: Network layer PDU = packet/datagram; data link = frame; transport = segment.
eh: Network = packet; Data link = frame; Transport = segment।
n: Frame data link ki; bits physical ki.
nh: Frame data link; bits physical।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Converting the outgoing data into signals is the job of:
qh: जाते data को signals में बदलना किसका काम है?
e: Physical layer bits ko electrical/optical/wireless signals mein badalti hai.
eh: Physical layer bits को signals में बदलती है।
n: Baaki layers data-level par kaam karti hain.
nh: बाक़ी data-level पर।

st: Section B — OSI Layer Functions (Layer 1 → Layer 7)
q: Dialog control and synchronization of data exchange between two applications is the responsibility of which OSI layer?
qh: दो applications के बीच dialog control और data exchange का synchronization किस OSI layer का काम है?
e: Session layer dialogue manage karti hai — kaun kab bolega (dialog control), sync points lagakar recovery possible karti hai.
eh: Session layer dialogue manage करती है — कौन कब बोलेगा, sync points लगाती है।
n: Transport = end-to-end delivery; presentation = format/encryption; application = user services.
nh: Transport = delivery; presentation = format; application = user services।

st: Section C — TCP/IP Model
q: The TCP/IP model is also known as:
qh: TCP/IP model को और क्या कहा जाता है?
e: TCP/IP ko DoD model bhi kehte hain (US Defense of Defense se).
eh: TCP/IP = DoD model (US Defense)।
n: OSI model ISO ka hai.
nh: OSI, ISO का है।

st: Section C — TCP/IP Model
q: Which layer of the TCP/IP model has the protocols IP, ARP and ICMP?
qh: TCP/IP model की किस layer में IP, ARP, ICMP protocols hote hain?
e: Internet layer = IP, ARP, ICMP, IGMP.
eh: Internet layer = IP, ARP, ICMP, IGMP।
n: Transport mein TCP/UDP.
nh: Transport में TCP/UDP।

st: Section C — TCP/IP Model
q: Which TCP/IP layer combines the functions of OSI's session, presentation and application layers?
qh: TCP/IP की कौन-सी layer OSI की session, presentation और application का काम करती है?
e: TCP/IP ki Application layer OSI ke top-3 layers ka kaam leti hai.
eh: TCP/IP की Application layer ऊपर की 3 layers का काम लेती है।
n: Network Access = OSI ke bottom-2.
nh: Network Access = नीचे की 2।

st: Section C — TCP/IP Model
q: In the TCP/IP model, process-to-process (program-to-program) communication is provided by the:
qh: TCP/IP model में process-to-process (program-to-program) संवाद किसके द्वारा होता है?
e: Transport (TCP/UDP) ports ke through processes ko jodta hai; Internet layer sirf host-to-host (best-effort) delivery karti hai.
eh: Transport (TCP/UDP) ports से processes जोड़ता है; Internet layer host-to-host delivery।
n: Yaad rakho: Network/Internet = host-to-host; Transport = process-to-process.
nh: Network/Internet = host-to-host; Transport = process-to-process।

st: Section D — Comparison, Encapsulation & PDUs
q: The process of adding headers (and a trailer) as data moves down the layers is called:
qh: Layers से नीचे जाते समय headers जोड़ने की प्रक्रिया है:
e: Sender par header add = encapsulation; receiver par utarna = de-encapsulation.
eh: Sender पर जोड़ना = encapsulation; receiver पर उतारना = de-encapsulation।
n: Fragmentation network layer ki activity hai.
nh: Fragmentation network layer का काम।

st: Section D — Comparison, Encapsulation & PDUs
q: At the receiver, the correct order of removing overheads is:
qh: Receiver पर overheads हटाने का सही क्रम है:
e: De-encapsulation neeche se upar: bits → frame → packet → segment → data.
eh: De-encapsulation नीचे से ऊपर: bits → frame → packet → segment।
n: Ultа kram galat hai.
nh: उल्टा क्रम गलत।

st: Section D — Comparison, Encapsulation & PDUs

e: TCP/IP communication uses all four levels of addresses: physical (MAC), logical (IP), port, and specific (socket = MAC+IP+port) — depending on the layer.
eh: TCP/IP communication में चारों levels के addresses लगते हैं: physical (MAC), logical (IP), port, और specific (socket = MAC+IP+port) — layer के अनुसार।

st: Section A — Address Levels & MAC Address (Physical Address)
q: What is the size (length) of a MAC address?
qh: MAC address का size (लंबाई) कितना होता है?
e: A MAC (Media Access Control) address is 48 bits (6 bytes) long, usually written as 12 hex digits like 00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E.
eh: MAC (Media Access Control) address 48 bits (6 bytes) का होता है, जिसे आमतौर पर 12 hex digits में लिखा जाता है — जैसे 00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E।
n: MAC = 48 bits (6 bytes / 12 hex digits). IPv4 = 32 bits, IPv6 = 128 bits, Port = 16 bits. Ye char sizes exam में बार-बार आते हैं।
nh: MAC = 48 bits (6 bytes / 12 hex digits)। IPv4 = 32 bits, IPv6 = 128 bits, Port = 16 bits। ये चार sizes exam में बार-बार आते हैं।

st: Section A — Address Levels & MAC Address (Physical Address)
q: A MAC address is also called a ______ address.

e: The MAC address is permanently burned into the NIC — it is the physical (hardware) address of the device, unlike the logical IP address which is configured by software.
eh: MAC address NIC में permanently burn होता है — यह device का physical (hardware) address है, logical IP address के विपरीत जो software से configure होता है।
n: MAC = physical/hardware address (burned-in, 48-bit). IP = logical address (configured). Both change hands at different layers.
nh: MAC = physical/hardware address (burned-in, 48-bit)। IP = logical address (configured)।

eh: Data link layer local link पर frame delivery के लिए MAC (physical/hardware) address उपयोग करती है।
