e: A file server is a specialised computer (with large storage) that stores and serves files to clients in a client-server network.
eh: File server एक विशेष computer (बड़े storage के साथ) है जो client-server network में clients को files संग्रहित करके देता है।
n: Servers (file/print/mail/web) = specialised computers. Modem = signal converter, Router = packet forwarder, Transponder = satellite relay.
nh: Servers (file/print/mail/web) = विशेष computers। Modem = signal converter, Router = packet forwarder, Transponder = satellite relay।

st: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
q: In a data-entry office, computer centres on the 1st and 4th floors are connected by LANs, but signals take time to travel. Which hardware can improve the data transmission?
qh: एक data-entry office में 1वीं और 4वीं मंज़िल के computer centres LAN से जुड़े हैं, पर signals में समय लगता है. बेहतर transmission के लिए कौन-सा hardware लगाएँ?
e: A repeater regenerates (amplifies and reshapes) the weakening signal — that is why it is what we install for distance problems.
eh: Repeater कमज़ोर होते signal को दोबारा ताक़तवर बनाता (regenerate करता) है — इसलिए दूरी की समस्या में यही लगता है.
n: संकेत कमज़ोर → Repeater; रास्ता चाहिए → Router; analog↔digital → Modem.
nh: संकेत कमज़ोर → Repeater; रास्ता चाहिए → Router; analog↔digital → Modem.

st: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
q: A device that operates at the physical layer of the OSI model is:
qh: OSI model की physical layer पर काम करने वाला device है:
e: Repeater physical layer (Layer 1) का device है — यह signal regenerate करता है. Bridge Layer 2, Router Layer 3 पर.
eh: Repeater physical layer (Layer 1) का device है — यह signal regenerate करता है. Bridge Layer 2, Router Layer 3 पर.
n: Layer-device जोड़ी: L1 = Repeater/Hub, L2 = Bridge/Switch, L3 = Router, L4+ = Gateway.
nh: Layer-device जोड़ी: L1 = Repeater/Hub, L2 = Bridge/Switch, L3 = Router, L4+ = Gateway.

st: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
q: Which device reduces collision domains (each port has its own collision domain) but does NOT break broadcast domains?
qh: कौन-सा device collision domains को कम करता है (हर port का अपना collision domain) लेकिन broadcast domains को तोड़ता नहीं?
e: A switch gives every port a separate collision domain (full-duplex = no collisions) but ALL its ports share ONE broadcast domain (unless VLANs are used).
eh: Switch हर port को अलग collision domain देता है (full-duplex = कोई collision नहीं) लेकिन सभी ports एक ही broadcast domain share करते हैं (जब तक VLAN न हो)।
n: Switch = collision domains many, broadcast 1. Router = broadcast domains many. Hub = 1 collision + 1 broadcast. VLAN = splits broadcast on a switch.
nh: Switch = collision domains कई, broadcast 1। Router = broadcast domains कई। Hub = 1 collision + 1 broadcast। VLAN = switch पर broadcast तोड़ता है।

st: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
q: Which device stores MAC addresses in a CAM table?
qh: कौन-सा device MAC addresses को CAM table में संग्रहित करता है?
e: A switch learns source MAC addresses and stores them in its CAM (Content Addressable Memory) table to forward frames only to the right port.
eh: Switch source MAC addresses सीखकर उन्हें अपने CAM (Content Addressable Memory) table में रखता है ताकि frames सही port पर ही भेजे जाएँ।
n: Switch = MAC table (CAM). Router = routing table (IP). Hub = no table (floods). ARP cache = IP→MAC mapping (host).
nh: Switch = MAC table (CAM)। Router = routing table (IP)। Hub = कोई table नहीं (floods)। ARP cache = IP→MAC mapping (host)।

st: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
q: A switch receives a frame whose destination MAC is NOT in its MAC table. What does the switch do?
qh: एक switch को frame मिलता है जिसका destination MAC उसके MAC table में नहीं है। Switch क्या करेगा?
o: Send the frame to the router only
Flood the frame out of all its ports (same broadcast domain)
Broadcast it on the entire internet
oh: Send the frame to the router only
Flood the frame out of all its ports (same broadcast domain)
Broadcast it on the entire internet
e: On an unknown unicast destination, the switch floods the frame out of every port (except the source port) within the broadcast domain — this is how it learns.
eh: अज्ञात unicast destination पर switch frame को हर port (source port को छोड़कर) से broadcast domain के भीतर flood करता है — इसी तरह वह सीखता है।
n: Unknown unicast → flood. Known unicast → single port. Broadcast FF:FF:... → flood. Source MAC → learn/refresh in CAM.
nh: Unknown unicast → flood। Known unicast → एक port। Broadcast FF:FF:... → flood। Source MAC → CAM में learn/refresh।

st: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
q: A router is connected between two switches. If a broadcast frame is sent on Switch-A, what will Switch-B receive?
qh: दो switches के बीच एक router जुड़ा है। यदि Switch-A पर broadcast frame भेजा जाए, तो Switch-B क्या प्राप्त करेगा?
e: Routers do not forward broadcast traffic — each side of the router is a separate broadcast domain, so Switch-B receives nothing.
eh: Router broadcast traffic को आगे नहीं भेजते — router के दोनों ओर अलग broadcast domains होते हैं, इसलिए Switch-B कुछ भी प्राप्त नहीं करेगा।
n: Router = broadcast firewall. This is why routers split broadcast domains and switches don't.
nh: Router = broadcast firewall। इसीलिए router broadcast domains तोड़ते हैं और switches नहीं।

st: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
q: A switch has 4 VLANs configured. How many broadcast domains exist?
qh: एक switch पर 4 VLANs configure हैं। कितने broadcast domains होंगे?
e: Each VLAN is its own broadcast domain — 4 VLANs = 4 broadcast domains on that switch.
eh: हर VLAN अपना अलग broadcast domain है — उस switch पर 4 VLANs = 4 broadcast domains।
n: VLAN = virtual switch = its own broadcast domain. Inter-VLAN communication needs a router (or L3 switch).
nh: VLAN = virtual switch = अपना broadcast domain। Inter-VLAN संचार के लिए router (या L3 switch) चाहिए।

st: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
q: In a router-on-a-stick setup with VLANs, which device handles VLAN tagging and which handles inter-VLAN routing?
qh: VLANs वाले router-on-a-stick setup में VLAN tagging कौन करता है और inter-VLAN routing कौन?
o: Both switch and router do VLAN tagging
oh: Both switch and router do VLAN tagging
e: The switch carries VLAN-tagged (802.1Q) frames on the trunk, and the router (sub-interfaces) routes between the VLANs.
eh: Switch trunk पर VLAN-tagged (802.1Q) frames ले जाता है, और router (sub-interfaces) VLANs के बीच routing करता है।
n: 802.1Q tagging = switch trunk job. Inter-VLAN routing = router (router-on-a-stick) or L3 switch.
nh: 802.1Q tagging = switch trunk का काम। Inter-VLAN routing = router (router-on-a-stick) या L3 switch।

st: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
q: A packet travels: wired PC → Switch → Access Point → Wireless laptop. Which devices operate at Layer 2 only?
qh: एक packet यात्रा करता है: wired PC → Switch → Access Point → Wireless laptop। कौन-से devices केवल Layer 2 पर काम करते हैं?
e: A switch is a Layer-2 device and an access point acts as a wireless bridge — also Layer-2 (it bridges 802.3 frames to 802.11 frames).
eh: Switch एक Layer-2 device है और access point एक wireless bridge की तरह काम करता है — वह भी Layer-2 (यह 802.3 frames को 802.11 frames में बदलता है)।
n: AP = wireless bridge (L2). Switch = L2. Router = L3. WAPs don't route unless configured as routers.
nh: AP = wireless bridge (L2)। Switch = L2। Router = L3। WAPs routing नहीं करते (जब तक router mode में न हों)।

st: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
q: What does a MAC address represent?
qh: MAC address किसका प्रतिनिधित्व करता है?
o: The location of the device in the network
The unique identity of the NIC
oh: The location of the device in the network
The unique identity of the NIC
e: The MAC address is the unique hardware identity of the NIC (Network Interface Card) — burned in by the manufacturer.
eh: MAC address, NIC (Network Interface Card) की unique hardware पहचान है — manufacturer द्वारा burn की गई।
n: MAC = NIC identity (who). IP = location in network (where). Routing path = router's job.
nh: MAC = NIC identity (कौन)। IP = network में स्थान (कहाँ)। Routing path = router का काम।

st: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
q: Which of the following component is responsible for network communication in a computer system?
qh: कंप्यूटर सिस्टम में network communication के लिए कौन-सा component ज़िम्मेदार होता है?
e: Ethernet card यानी NIC (Network Interface Card) ही computer को network से जोड़ता है और frames भेजने-पाने का काम करता है.
eh: Ethernet card यानी NIC (Network Interface Card) ही computer को network से जोड़ता है और frames भेजने-पाने का काम करता है.
n: NIC = computer का network वाला हाथ — इसी पर MAC address बसा होता है.
nh: NIC = computer का network वाला हाथ — इसी पर MAC address बसा होता है.

st: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
q: LANs can be connected by which of the following devices that operate on the data link layer?
qh: LANs को data link layer पर काम करने वाले निम्न में से किस device से जोड़ा जा सकता है?
e: Bridges LANs को data link layer (Layer 2) पर जोड़ते हैं और MAC addresses देखकर frames आगे भेजते हैं.
eh: Bridges LANs को data link layer (Layer 2) पर जोड़ते हैं और MAC addresses देखकर frames आगे भेजते हैं.
n: Hub = L1, Bridge/Switch = L2, Router = L3, Gateway = L4+.
nh: Hub = L1, Bridge/Switch = L2, Router = L3, Gateway = L4+.

st: Section C — Router / Brouter
q: Which hardware forwards data packets between computer networks?
qh: कौन-सा hardware computer networks के बीच data packets को आगे भेजता है?
e: A router forwards packets between DIFFERENT networks using the routing information (IP addresses) in the packet.
eh: Router packet के भीतर routing information (IP addresses) का उपयोग करके विभिन्न networks के बीच packets को आगे भेजता है।
n: Official KVS key. Router = between networks (L3). Switch = within a network (L2). Cable = medium. Nibble = 4 bits!
nh: Official KVS key। Router = networks के बीच (L3)। Switch = network के भीतर (L2)। Cable = medium। Nibble = 4 bits!

st: Section C — Router / Brouter
q: Which device operates at Layer 3 of the OSI model?
qh: OSI model की Layer 3 पर कौन-सा device काम करता है?
e: The router works at the Network layer (Layer 3) — it forwards packets using logical IP addresses and routing tables.
eh: Router Network layer (Layer 3) पर काम करता है — यह logical IP addresses और routing tables का उपयोग करके packets भेजता है।
n: Device-layer ladder: Repeater/Hub 1, Switch/Bridge/NIC 2, Router 3, Gateway 7.
nh: Device-layer ladder: Repeater/Hub 1, Switch/Bridge/NIC 2, Router 3, Gateway 7।

st: Section C — Router / Brouter
q: Among these network devices — i. Repeater  ii. Hub  iii. Switch  iv. Router — which are considered intelligent devices?
qh: इन network devices में — i. Repeater  ii. Hub  iii. Switch  iv. Router — कौन-से intelligent devices माने जाते हैं?
e: Switch and router are intelligent — they read addresses (MAC/IP) and make forwarding decisions; repeater and hub blindly repeat/forward signals.
eh: Switch और router intelligent हैं — ये addresses (MAC/IP) पढ़कर forwarding decisions लेते हैं; repeater और hub अंधों की तरह signals दोहराते/भेजते हैं।
n: Intelligent = reads addresses + filters/forwards selectively (switch, router, bridge, gateway). Dumb = hub, repeater.
nh: Intelligent = addresses पढ़ता है + selectively filter/forward करता है (switch, router, bridge, gateway)। Dumb = hub, repeater।

st: Section C — Router / Brouter
q: A router performs which of the following? (1) Packet forwarding  (2) Logical addressing  (3) Collision detection  (4) Routing decision
qh: Router निम्न में से कौन-सा कार्य करता है? (1) Packet forwarding  (2) Logical addressing  (3) Collision detection  (4) Routing decision
e: A router forwards packets, uses logical (IP) addressing and makes routing decisions — but collision detection is a Layer-2 (CSMA/CD) function, not a router's.
eh: Router packets भेजता है, logical (IP) addressing उपयोग करता है और routing decisions लेता है — लेकिन collision detection Layer-2 (CSMA/CD) का काम है, router का नहीं।
n: Router = forward + route + logical addressing. NOT collision detection (that's Ethernet L2 on switches/NICs).
nh: Router = forward + route + logical addressing। Collision detection नहीं (वह switches/NICs पर Ethernet L2 का काम है)।

st: Section C — Router / Brouter
q: Consider: S1: The TTL field decreases at each router. S2: The MAC address changes at each hop. Which is correct?
qh: देखिए: S1: TTL field हर router पर घटती है। S2: MAC address हर hop पर बदलता है। कौन-सा सही है?
e: At every router hop the TTL is decremented (and header checksum recomputed) AND a new frame with new source/destination MAC addresses is built. Both statements are true.
eh: हर router hop पर TTL घटती है (और header checksum फिर से बनता है) और नए source/destination MAC addresses वाला नया frame बनता है। दोनों कथन सही हैं।
n: Per-hop changes: TTL↓ + MAC rewritten. End-to-end: IP addresses unchanged (except NAT).
nh: Per-hop बदलाव: TTL↓ + MAC फिर से लिखा जाता है। End-to-end: IP addresses अपरिवर्तित (NAP को छोड़कर)।

st: Section C — Router / Brouter
q: A router drops some packets deliberately due to congestion. What is this technique called?
qh: Router congestion के कारण कुछ packets जानबूझकर छोड़ देता है। इस तकनीक को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Random Early Detection (RED) proactively drops (or marks) packets before the queue is full, signalling senders to slow down — a congestion-avoidance technique.
eh: Random Early Detection (RED) queue भरने से पहले ही packets छोड़ (या mark) देता है, जिससे senders धीमे हो जाएँ — यह एक congestion-avoidance तकनीक है।
n: Congestion tools: RED (early random drops), Queuing (FIFO/PQ), Traffic shaping. Dropping ALL at overflow = tail drop.
nh: Congestion tools: RED (early random drops), Queuing (FIFO/PQ), Traffic shaping। Overflow पर सब छोड़ना = tail drop।

st: Section C — Router / Brouter
q: Which device creates a separate broadcast domain?
qh: कौन-सा device अलग broadcast domain बनाता है?
e: Each router interface belongs to a different broadcast domain — the router is the boundary between them.
eh: हर router interface अलग broadcast domain से संबंधित होता है — router उनके बीच की सीमा है।
n: Broadcast domain boundary = router (or VLAN). Collision domain boundary = switch port/bridge.
nh: Broadcast domain सीमा = router (या VLAN)। Collision domain सीमा = switch port/bridge।

st: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
q: If two systems use DIFFERENT protocols, which device is used to link them?
qh: यदि दो systems भिन्न protocols उपयोग करते हैं, तो उन्हें जोड़ने के लिए कौन-सा device उपयोग होता है?
e: A gateway is a protocol converter — it translates between different protocols/architectures so dissimilar systems can communicate.
eh: Gateway एक protocol converter है — यह विभिन्न protocols/architectures के बीच अनुवाद करता है ताकि भिन्न systems संवाद कर सकें।
n: Gateway = protocol converter (L7). Bridge = similar LANs, same protocols (L2). Repeater/Hub = signal level (L1).
nh: Gateway = protocol converter (L7)। Bridge = समान LANs, समान protocols (L2)। Repeater/Hub = signal level (L1)।

st: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
q: Which device can operate across all 7 layers of the OSI model?
qh: कौन-सा device OSI model की सभी 7 layers पर काम कर सकता है?
e: A gateway (protocol converter) works at the application layer and may involve all layers to translate between different protocol stacks.
eh: Gateway (protocol converter) application layer पर काम करता है और भिन्न protocol stacks के बीच अनुवाद के लिए सभी layers को शामिल कर सकता है।
n: Gateway = 'all 7 layers' device. Hub 1, switch/bridge 2, router 3 — exam one-liner.
nh: Gateway = 'सभी 7 layers' वाला device। Hub 1, switch/bridge 2, router 3 — exam one-liner।

st: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
q: Devices on one network can communicate with devices on another network via:
qh: एक network के devices दूसरे network के devices से किसके माध्यम से संवाद कर सकते हैं?
e: A gateway connects different networks (often with different protocols) and lets their devices communicate — the entry/exit point between networks.
eh: Gateway विभिन्न networks (अक्सर भिन्न protocols वाले) को जोड़ता है और उनके devices को संवाद करने देता है — networks के बीच प्रवेश/निकास बिंदु।
n: Gateway = network-to-network doorway (also default gateway = router IP used to exit the LAN).
nh: Gateway = network-to-network दरवाज़ा (default gateway भी = LAN से बाहर निकलने के लिए router IP)।

st: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
q: Which type of firewall inspects packets at the network layer and decides based on IP addresses?
qh: कौन-सी firewall network layer पर packets की जाँच करके IP addresses के आधार पर निर्णय लेती है?
e: A packet-filtering firewall works at the network layer — it allows/denies packets by source/destination IP (and ports) using ACL rules.
eh: Packet-filtering firewall network layer पर काम करती है — यह ACL rules से source/destination IP (और ports) के आधार पर packets को allow/deny करती है।
n: Firewall types: Packet filtering (L3/L4, stateless) → Stateful (tracks sessions) → Proxy/Application gateway (L7) → Circuit-level gateway (L5).
nh: Firewall types: Packet filtering (L3/L4, stateless) → Stateful (sessions याद रखती है) → Proxy/Application gateway (L7) → Circuit-level gateway (L5)।

st: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
q: Which firewall acts as an intermediary between the client and server at the application layer?
qh: कौन-सी firewall application layer पर client और server के बीच मध्यस्थ (intermediary) के रूप में काम करती है?
e: A proxy (application) firewall terminates the client connection and opens a separate connection to the server — hiding the internal client completely.
eh: Proxy (application) firewall client connection समाप्त करके server के लिए अलग connection खोलती है — internal client को पूरी तरह छिपाती है।
n: Proxy = L7 intermediary (deep inspection, hides internals). Circuit gateway = L5 (session/relay).
nh: Proxy = L7 intermediary (गहरी जाँच, internals छिपाती है)। Circuit gateway = L5 (session/relay)।

st: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
q: What is the role of a firewall in computer networks?
qh: Computer networks में firewall की भूमिका क्या है?
e: A firewall monitors and filters incoming/outgoing traffic according to security rules — protecting the trusted network from unauthorised access.
eh: Firewall security rules के अनुसार आने-जाने वाले traffic की निगरानी और छँटनी करता है — trusted network को unauthorised access से बचाता है।
n: Firewall = traffic filter between trusted & untrusted networks (screening router, DMZ...). DHCP = IP management; DNS = names.
nh: Firewall = trusted और untrusted networks के बीच traffic filter (screening router, DMZ...)। DHCP = IP management; DNS = names।

st: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
q: What is the purpose of a proxy server in networking?
qh: Networking में proxy server का उद्देश्य क्या है?
e: A proxy server sits between clients and the internet — it filters requests (policy, caching) and forwards them, hiding the client's identity.
eh: Proxy server clients और internet के बीच बैठता है — यह requests को filter (policy, caching) करके आगे भेजता है, client की पहचान छिपाता है।
n: Proxy = filter + forward + cache + hide client. Firewall = block/allow by rules. Both are security/traffic devices.
nh: Proxy = filter + forward + cache + client छिपाना। Firewall = rules से block/allow। दोनों security/traffic devices हैं।

st: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
q: Which is a network security system designed to protect a trusted private network from an untrusted outside network to which it is connected?
qh: कौन-सी network security system trusted private network को उस जुड़े हुए untrusted outside network से बचाने के लिए बनी है?
e: A firewall is the security system placed between a trusted internal network and an untrusted external network (like the Internet).
eh: Firewall एक security system है जो trusted internal network और untrusted external network (जैसे Internet) के बीच लगाया जाता है।
n: Rajasthan PYQ (verified key: C) — the classic firewall definition. Compare: bridge = L2 link, cookie = web state, SSL = encryption.
nh: Rajasthan PYQ (verified key: C) — firewall की classic परिभाषा। तुलना: bridge = L2 link, cookie = web state, SSL = encryption।

st: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
q: What kind of NAT maps one private IP to exactly one public IP?
qh: किस प्रकार का NAT एक private IP को ठीक एक public IP से जोड़ता है?
e: Static NAT creates a permanent one-to-one mapping between a private and a public IP address (used for servers).
eh: Static NAT एक private और एक public IP address के बीच स्थायी one-to-one mapping बनाता है (servers के लिए उपयोग)।
n: NAT types: Static = 1↔1 permanent. Dynamic = pool mapping. PAT/NAT-overload = many↔1 using ports.
nh: NAT types: Static = 1↔1 स्थायी। Dynamic = pool mapping। PAT/NAT-overload = ports से many↔1।

st: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
q: Which of the following is NOT a networking device?
qh: निम्न में से कौन-सा networking device नहीं है?
e: Linux is an operating system, not a networking device — gateway, router and firewall are all network devices/functions.
eh: Linux एक operating system है, networking device नहीं — gateway, router और firewall सब network devices/functions हैं।
n: Device vs OS: hardware devices (hub/switch/router) vs software (OS, antivirus) vs firmware-based security devices (firewall).
nh: Device बनाम OS: hardware devices (hub/switch/router) बनाम software (OS, antivirus) बनाम firmware-based security devices (firewall)।

st: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
q: Which of the following is NOT a networking device? (Hub / Switch / Bridge / None of these)
qh: निम्न में से कौन-सा networking device नहीं है? (Hub / Switch / Bridge / इनमें से कोई नहीं)
e: Hub, switch and bridge are ALL networking devices — so the answer is 'None of these'.
eh: Hub, switch और bridge — तीनों networking devices हैं — इसलिए उत्तर 'इनमें से कोई नहीं' है।
n: Mirror question of the 'Linux' variant — read the option SET carefully: here everything listed IS a device.
nh: 'Linux' वाले प्रश्न का दर्पण — option SET ध्यान से पढ़ें: यहाँ सूचीबद्ध सब devices हैं।

st: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
q: All ports of a hub belong to how many collision domains?
qh: Hub के सभी ports कितने collision domains में आते हैं?
e: Hub ek shared medium hai — sab ports ek hi collision domain.
eh: Hub में सब ports एक collision domain।
n: Switch mein har port alag.
nh: Switch में हर port अलग।

st: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
q: A device that regenerates a weak signal bit-by-bit to its original strength is a:
qh: कमज़ोर signal को bit-by-bit पुनः मूल शक्ति तक लाने वाला उपकरण है:
e: Repeater signal copy karke regenerate karta hai — amplify nahi.
eh: Repeater regenerate करता है — amplify नहीं।
n: Amplifier shor ke saath badhata hai.
nh: Amplifier शोर भी बढ़ाता है।

st: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
q: A 24-port hub creates how many collision domains?
qh: 24-port hub कितने collision domains बनाता है?
e: Hub ek shared segment hai — saare ports ek hi collision domain mein hain (switch hota to har port apna collision domain).

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: 'Manchester Encoding' and 'Differential Manchester Encoding' are signal encoding techniques used at which layer?
qh: 'Manchester Encoding' और 'Differential Manchester Encoding' signal encoding techniques किस layer पर उपयोग होती हैं?
e: Line coding (Manchester, differential Manchester, NRZ, AMI) converts bits into signals — a Physical layer job.
eh: Line coding (Manchester, differential Manchester, NRZ, AMI) bits को signals में बदलती है — यह Physical layer का काम है।
n: Physical layer = signalling & encoding (Manchester = mid-bit transition, self-clocking).
nh: Physical layer = signalling और encoding (Manchester = mid-bit transition, self-clocking)।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: A channel has high bandwidth but suffers from high noise. Which encoding scheme gives better error resistance?
qh: एक channel की bandwidth अधिक है लेकिन noise बहुत है। कौन-सी encoding scheme बेहतर error resistance देगी?
e: Manchester encoding has a transition in every bit period — the receiver resynchronises quickly and detects errors easily, giving strong noise resilience.
eh: Manchester encoding में हर bit period में transition होता है — receiver जल्दी resynchronise होता है और errors आसानी से पकड़ लेता है, इसलिए noise resilience मज़बूत है।
n: Manchester = self-clocking + DC-free + strong error visibility. NRZ = long runs → clock loss in noise.
nh: Manchester = self-clocking + DC-free + मज़बूत error visibility। NRZ = लंबे runs → noise में clock loss।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: Which of the following Ethernet encodings has the highest redundancy?
qh: निम्न में से कौन-सी Ethernet encoding की redundancy सबसे अधिक है?
e: 1B2B encodes every 1 bit as 2 bits — 100% redundancy, the highest of the four (4B5B = 25%, 5B6B = 20%, 8B10B = 25%).
eh: 1B2B हर 1 bit को 2 bits के रूप में encode करती है — 100% redundancy, चारों में सबसे अधिक (4B5B = 25%, 5B6B = 20%, 8B10B = 25%)।
n: Redundancy (overhead): 1B2B 100% > 4B5B/8B10B 25% > 5B6B 20%. More redundancy = better clocking/error properties, more bandwidth.
nh: Redundancy (overhead): 1B2B 100% > 4B5B/8B10B 25% > 5B6B 20%। ज़्यादा redundancy = बेहतर clocking/error properties, ज़्यादा bandwidth।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: Which encoding technique is used to transmit signals in Gigabit Ethernet over fiber optic medium?
qh: Fiber optic medium पर Gigabit Ethernet में signal भेजने के लिए कौन-सी encoding technique उपयोग होती है?
e: Gigabit Ethernet (1000BASE-X over fiber) uses 8B/10B encoding — 8 data bits are carried as 10 code bits for clocking and DC balance.
eh: Gigabit Ethernet (fiber पर 1000BASE-X) 8B/10B encoding उपयोग करता है — 8 data bits को 10 code bits के रूप में भेजा जाता है (clocking और DC balance के लिए)।
n: 100BASE-TX uses 4B/5B + MLT-3; 1000BASE-X uses 8B/10B; 10GBASE-R uses 64B/66B. Ye exam favourite ladder hai.
nh: 100BASE-TX में 4B/5B + MLT-3; 1000BASE-X में 8B/10B; 10GBASE-R में 64B/66B। यह exam favourite ladder है।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: The primary use of scramblers in line coding schemes is to:
qh: Line coding schemes में scramblers का मुख्य उपयोग क्या है?
e: A scrambler randomises the transmitted bit pattern (breaks long runs of 0s/1s) so the receiver recovers the clock easily — it does NOT compress or change bandwidth.
eh: Scrambler transmitted bit pattern को randomise करता है (लंबे 0s/1s के runs तोड़ता है) ताकि receiver आसानी से clock recover कर सके — यह compress या bandwidth नहीं बदलता।
n: Official RPSC 2024 key. Scrambler = random-looking line signal (clock recovery). Not compression, not encryption.
nh: Official RPSC 2024 key। Scrambler = random-looking line signal (clock recovery)। Compression नहीं, encryption नहीं।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: Reduction in signal strength over distance is called:
qh: दूरी के साथ signal strength में कमी को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Attenuation is the gradual loss of signal strength (amplitude) as it travels along a medium — measured in dB/km (or dB/100 ft).
eh: Attenuation medium के साथ यात्रा करते समय signal strength (amplitude) का क्रमिक नुकसान है — इसे dB/km (या dB/100 ft) में मापा जाता है।
n: Impairments: Attenuation (strength loss), Distortion (shape change), Noise (unwanted signals). Attenuation ↑ with distance & frequency.
nh: Impairments: Attenuation (strength loss), Distortion (shape change), Noise (unwanted signals)। Attenuation ↑ distance और frequency के साथ।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: In a copper cable, attenuation increases with frequency. Which change will REDUCE attenuation?
qh: Copper cable में attenuation frequency के साथ बढ़ता है। कौन-सा बदलाव attenuation घटाएगा?
e: A thicker copper core has lower electrical resistance — so the signal loses less strength over distance.
eh: मोटे copper core का electrical resistance कम होता है — इसलिए signal को दूरी पर कम strength गँवानी पड़ती है।
n: Reduce attenuation: shorter cable, thicker/better copper, higher category cable, lower frequency, or add repeaters/amplifiers.
nh: Attenuation घटाना: छोटी cable, मोटा/बेहतर copper, उच्च श्रेणी cable, कम frequency, या repeaters/amplifiers जोड़ें।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: Which noise is caused by electromagnetic coupling between nearby cables?
qh: पास की cables के बीच electromagnetic coupling से कौन-सा noise होता है?
e: Crosstalk is the unwanted signal leakage from one wire pair to a neighbouring pair caused by electromagnetic coupling.
eh: Crosstalk एक wire pair से पास की दूसरी pair में electromagnetic coupling के कारण होने वाला unwanted signal leakage है।
n: Noise types: Thermal (random electron motion), Crosstalk (pair-to-pair coupling), Impulse (sudden spikes), Quantization (PCM sampling).
nh: Noise types: Thermal (random electron motion), Crosstalk (pair-to-pair coupling), Impulse (sudden spikes), Quantization (PCM sampling)।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: Which impairment cannot be completely eliminated but only minimised?
qh: कौन-सा impairment पूरी तरह समाप्त नहीं किया जा सकता, केवल कम किया जा सकता है?
e: Noise can never be fully eliminated — it can only be minimised (shielding, better cable, lower power, error control).
eh: Noise कभी पूरी तरह समाप्त नहीं हो सकती — केवल कम की जा सकती है (shielding, बेहतर cable, कम power, error control)।
n: Attenuation/distortion can be fixed with repeaters/equalisers; noise is fundamental (thermal floor) — only minimised.
nh: Attenuation/distortion repeaters/equalisers से ठीक हो सकते हैं; noise मूलभूत है (thermal floor) — केवल कम होती है।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: Which parameter of an analog signal represents the number of cycles per second?
qh: Analog signal का कौन-सा parameter प्रति सेकंड cycles की संख्या दर्शाता है?
e: Frequency is the number of signal cycles completed per second, measured in Hertz (Hz).
eh: Frequency प्रति सेकंड पूरे होने वाले signal cycles की संख्या है, जिसे Hertz (Hz) में मापा जाता है।
n: Signal parameters: Amplitude (height), Frequency (cycles/sec), Phase (start position), Wavelength (distance/cycle = speed/frequency).
nh: Signal parameters: Amplitude (ऊँचाई), Frequency (cycles/sec), Phase (शुरुआती स्थिति), Wavelength (दूरी/cycle = speed/frequency)।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: The period of a signal is 100 ms. What is its frequency in kilohertz?
qh: एक signal की period 100 ms है। इसकी frequency kilohertz में कितनी होगी?
e: Frequency f = 1/T = 1/0.1 s = 10 Hz = 0.01 kHz = 10⁻² kHz.
eh: Frequency f = 1/T = 1/0.1 s = 10 Hz = 0.01 kHz = 10⁻² kHz।
n: f = 1/T. 100 ms = 0.1 s → 10 Hz. Convert Hz→kHz by dividing by 1000.
nh: f = 1/T। 100 ms = 0.1 s → 10 Hz। Hz→kHz के लिए 1000 से भाग दें।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: ______ signals are discrete and are generated by digital modulation.
qh: ______ signals discrete होते हैं और digital modulation से बनते हैं।
e: Digital signals are discrete (defined only at instants) and are produced by digital modulation techniques.
eh: Digital signals discrete होते हैं (केवल कुछ क्षणों पर परिभाषित) और digital modulation techniques से बनते हैं।
n: Rajasthan PYQ verified key (B). Analog = continuous; Digital = discrete. Ye sabse basic signal distinction hai.
nh: Rajasthan PYQ verified key (B)। Analog = continuous; Digital = discrete। यह signal का सबसे बुनियादी भेद है।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: Quantizing noise occurs in:
qh: Quantizing noise किसमें होती है?
e: Quantizing noise is the small error introduced when an analog sample is rounded to the nearest discrete level in PCM.
eh: Quantizing noise वह छोटी त्रुटि है जो PCM में analog sample को निकटतम discrete level पर गोल करने से आती है।
n: Rajasthan PYQ verified key (A). PCM = sampling + quantizing + encoding → quantizing error = quantization noise.
nh: Rajasthan PYQ verified key (A)। PCM = sampling + quantizing + encoding → quantizing error = quantization noise।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: If the channel bandwidth is limited to 6 kHz and the signal-to-noise ratio is 16, what is the channel capacity?
qh: यदि channel bandwidth 6 kHz सीमित है और signal-to-noise ratio 16 है, तो channel capacity कितनी होगी?
e: By Shannon's capacity formula C = B × log₂(1 + SNR) = 6000 × log₂(17) ≈ 6000 × 4.09 ≈ 24.5-24.7 kbps — matching 24.74 kbps.
eh: Shannon capacity सूत्र से C = B × log₂(1 + SNR) = 6000 × log₂(17) ≈ 6000 × 4.09 ≈ 24.5-24.7 kbps — 24.74 kbps से मेल खाता है।
n: Rajasthan PYQ verified key (B). Shannon: C = B log₂(1+SNR). Nyquist: C = 2B log₂(L) (noiseless).
nh: Rajasthan PYQ verified key (B)। Shannon: C = B log₂(1+SNR)। Nyquist: C = 2B log₂(L) (noiseless)।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: Given a bit rate of b bits/sec, the time required to send 16 bits is:
qh: यदि bit rate b bits/sec है, तो 16 bits भेजने में कितना समय लगेगा?
e: Time = number of bits ÷ bit rate = 16 ÷ b = 16/b seconds.
eh: Time = bits की संख्या ÷ bit rate = 16 ÷ b = 16/b seconds।
n: Time = size/rate. 1000 bits at 100 bps = 10 s. Units: bits ÷ (bits/sec) = sec.
nh: Time = size/rate। 1000 bits at 100 bps = 10 s। Units: bits ÷ (bits/sec) = sec।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: The effective bandwidth of a communication channel is primarily limited by:
qh: Communication channel की effective bandwidth मुख्य रूप से किससे सीमित होती है?
e: Noise (with attenuation) limits how much data can be reliably pushed through a channel — Shannon's law shows capacity grows with bandwidth and SNR but is capped by noise.
eh: Noise (attenuation के साथ) तय करती है कि channel से कितना data भरोसेमंद तरीके से भेजा जा सकता है — Shannon का नियम दिखाता है कि capacity bandwidth और SNR के साथ बढ़ती है पर noise से सीमित रहती है।
n: Effective bandwidth is a physics/SNR limit. Protocol overhead reduces goodput but is not the channel's fundamental limit.
nh: Effective bandwidth एक physics/SNR सीमा है। Protocol overhead goodput घटाता है पर channel की मूल सीमा नहीं।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: What technique allows multiple signals to share the same communication channel?
qh: कौन-सी technique कई signals को एक ही communication channel share करने देती है?
e: Multiplexing combines multiple signals onto one shared medium (FDM/TDM/WDM/CDM) — a demultiplexer separates them at the receiving end.
eh: Multiplexing कई signals को एक shared medium पर जोड़ती है (FDM/TDM/WDM/CDM) — receiving end पर demultiplexer उन्हें अलग करता है।
n: Multiplexing = many share one channel. FDM = frequency bands, TDM = time slots, WDM = light wavelengths, CDM = codes.
nh: Multiplexing = कई एक channel share करें। FDM = frequency bands, TDM = time slots, WDM = light wavelengths, CDM = codes।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: Communication using a modulated carrier to apply a data signal to a transmission medium in analog form is:
qh: Modulated carrier का उपयोग करके data signal को analog रूप में transmission medium पर डालना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Broadband networking sends data as a modulated analog carrier; baseband sends digital signals directly on the medium.
eh: Broadband networking data को modulated analog carrier के रूप में भेजता है; baseband digital signals सीधे medium पर भेजता है।
n: Baseband = digital signalling (Manchester etc.). Broadband = analog carriers + modulation (FDM channels).
nh: Baseband = digital signalling (Manchester आदि)। Broadband = analog carriers + modulation (FDM channels)।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: The amount of data transmitted in a fixed amount of time is called:
qh: निश्चित समय में भेजे गए data की मात्रा को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Bandwidth (in this exam phrasing) is the data transmitted per unit time — the communication channel's capacity (bps).
eh: इस exam शैली में Bandwidth प्रति इकाई समय भेजा गया data है — communication channel की capacity (bps)।
n: Strictly: THROUGHPUT = data actually sent per second; BANDWIDTH = maximum capacity. Banks often call throughput 'bandwidth' — read options carefully.
nh: कठोरता से: THROUGHPUT = वास्तव में प्रति सेकंड भेजा data; BANDWIDTH = अधिकतम capacity। Banks अक्सर throughput को 'bandwidth' कहते हैं — options ध्यान से पढ़ें।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: Consider a noiseless channel with a bandwidth of 5000 Hz transmitting a signal with two signal levels. The maximum bit rate is:
qh: एक noiseless channel जिसकी bandwidth 5000 Hz है, दो signal levels के साथ transmission कर रहा है. अधिकतम bit rate होगी:
e: Nyquist के सूत्र से: Max data rate = 2 × B × log₂(L) = 2 × 5000 × log₂(2) = 10000 bps.
eh: Nyquist के सूत्र से: Max data rate = 2 × B × log₂(L) = 2 × 5000 × log₂(2) = 10000 bps.
n: UGC NET Jan 2025 official key (ii). याद रखो: 2B log₂L (noiseless) और B log₂(1+S/N) (noisy — Shannon).
nh: UGC NET Jan 2025 official key (ii). याद रखो: 2B log₂L (noiseless) और B log₂(1+S/N) (noisy — Shannon).

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: Communication using a modulated carrier to apply a data signal to a transmission medium in analog form is called:
qh: Modulated carrier का उपयोग करके data signal को analog रूप में transmission medium पर भेजना कहलाता है:
e: Broadband में data को modulated carrier (analog) के ऊपर भेजा जाता है; baseband में digital signal सीधे medium पर जाता है.
eh: Broadband में data को modulated carrier (analog) के ऊपर भेजा जाता है; baseband में digital signal सीधे medium पर जाता है.
n: Baseband = digital, सीधा; Broadband = analog, modulated. यह जोड़ी परीक्षा में बार-बार.
nh: Baseband = digital, सीधा; Broadband = analog, modulated. यह जोड़ी परीक्षा में बार-बार.

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: Identify the odd one out: Optical fibre, Twisted pair wire, Microwaves, Hertz
qh: असंगत वस्तु पहचानें: Optical fibre, Twisted pair wire, Microwaves, Hertz
e: Optical fibre, Twisted pair और Microwaves — तीनों transmission media हैं; Hertz आवृत्ति की इकाई है — medium नहीं.
eh: Optical fibre, Twisted pair और Microwaves — तीनों transmission media हैं; Hertz आवृत्ति की इकाई है — medium नहीं.
n: Media = रास्ता; Hertz = गति/आवृत्ति माप. यही अंतर पूछा गया है.
nh: Media = रास्ता; Hertz = गति/आवृत्ति माप. यही अंतर पूछा गया है.

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: Which of the following is NOT a type of broadband internet connection?
qh: निम्न में से कौन-सा broadband internet connection का प्रकार नहीं है?
e: Dial-up पुरानी सुस्त (कम bandwidth) तकनीक है — broadband नहीं. Cable, DSL और Satellite broadband हैं.
eh: Dial-up पुरानी सुस्त (कम bandwidth) तकनीक है — broadband नहीं. Cable, DSL और Satellite broadband हैं.
n: Broadband = fast internet (Cable/DSL/Fibre/Satellite); Dial-up = टेलीफ़ोन वाला पुराना संस्करण.
nh: Broadband = fast internet (Cable/DSL/Fibre/Satellite); Dial-up = टेलीफ़ोन वाला पुराना संस्करण.

st: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
q: Assertion (A): Fiber optic cable is immune to electromagnetic interference (EMI). Reason (R): It transmits data in the form of light pulses rather than electrical signals. Which option is correct?
qh: Assertion (A): Fiber optic cable electromagnetic interference (EMI) से मुक्त है। Reason (R): यह data electrical signals के बजाय light pulses के रूप में भेजती है। कौन-सा विकल्प सही है?
o: Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is NOT the correct explanation
oh: Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is NOT the correct explanation
e: Fiber is immune to EMI (A is true) precisely BECAUSE it carries light, not electrical current (R is true and explains A).
eh: Fiber EMI से मुक्त है (A सही) क्योंकि यह electrical current नहीं, प्रकाश ले जाता है (R सही और A की व्याख्या करता है)।
n: Fiber = light pulses → EMI-proof + tap-proof + huge bandwidth. Copper = electrical → EMI/crosstalk prone.
nh: Fiber = light pulses → EMI-proof + tap-proof + विशाल bandwidth। Copper = electrical → EMI/crosstalk प्रवण।

st: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
q: Which statements are TRUE for fiber optic cables? I. Immune to tapping  II. High bandwidth  III. Requires electrical grounding  IV. Works using total internal reflection
qh: Fiber optic cables के लिए कौन-से कथन सही हैं? I. Tapping से मुक्त  II. उच्च bandwidth  III. Electrical grounding चाहिए  IV. Total internal reflection से काम करती है
e: Fiber carries light (hard to tap, huge bandwidth, works on total internal reflection) and being glass/dielectric it needs NO electrical grounding.
eh: Fiber प्रकाश ले जाती है (tapping कठिन, विशाल bandwidth, total internal reflection पर काम) और काँच/dielectric होने से इसे electrical grounding की आवश्यकता नहीं।
n: Fiber truths: immune to tapping & EMI, highest bandwidth, TIR propagation. Myths: grounding (NO), affected by lightning (NO).
nh: Fiber truths: tapping और EMI से मुक्त, सर्वोच्च bandwidth, TIR propagation। Myths: grounding (नहीं), lightning (नहीं)।

st: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
q: Optical fiber uses reflection to guide light through a channel. At total internal reflection, the angle of incidence is ______ the critical angle.
qh: Optical fiber प्रकाश को channel में भेजने के लिए reflection उपयोग करती है। Total internal reflection में angle of incidence, critical angle से ______ होता है।
e: Total internal reflection happens only when the angle of incidence is GREATER than the critical angle — then light stays inside the core.
eh: Total internal reflection केवल तब होती है जब angle of incidence critical angle से अधिक हो — तब प्रकाश core के भीतर ही रहता है।
n: TIR rule: angle of incidence > critical angle (denser → rarer medium). Ye fiber propagation ka base hai.
nh: TIR rule: angle of incidence > critical angle (denser → rarer medium)। यह fiber propagation का आधार है।

st: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
q: A company needs long-distance communication (5-10 km), high data rate and immunity from electromagnetic interference. Which medium is best?
qh: एक कंपनी को लंबी दूरी (5-10 km) संचार, उच्च data rate और EMI से मुक्ति चाहिए। कौन-सा medium सर्वोत्तम है?
e: Single-mode fiber carries one light ray tens of kilometres with very high data rates and is completely immune to EMI.
eh: Single-mode fiber एक light ray को दसियों किलोमीटर तक बहुत उच्च data rates के साथ ले जाती है और पूरी तरह EMI से मुक्त है।
n: Fiber choices: Multi-mode = short (LANs, few hundred m). Single-mode = long haul (km) + highest rate. Copper = short & EMI-prone.
nh: Fiber विकल्प: Multi-mode = छोटी दूरी (LANs, कुछ सौ m)। Single-mode = लंबी (km) + उच्चतम rate। Copper = छोटी और EMI-प्रवण।

st: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
q: A network uses coaxial cable but suffers from signal reflection. What is the most likely cause?
qh: एक network coaxial cable उपयोग करता है लेकिन signal reflection से पीड़ित है। सबसे संभावित कारण क्या है?
e: Coaxial cable must be terminated with its characteristic impedance (e.g., 50Ω/75Ω); a mismatch causes signal reflections back down the cable.
eh: Coaxial cable को उसकी characteristic impedance (जैसे 50Ω/75Ω) से terminate करना अनिवार्य है; mismatch होने पर signal cable में वापस reflect होते हैं।
n: Coax rule: proper termination (BNC/terminator) prevents reflections. Un-terminated bus = standing waves & echoes.
nh: Coax rule: सही termination (BNC/terminator) reflections रोकता है। Un-terminated bus = standing waves और echoes।

st: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
q: A UTP cable used in Gigabit Ethernet shows high delay skew. What is the cause?
qh: Gigabit Ethernet में उपयोग UTP cable में delay skew अधिक है। कारण क्या है?
o: Different twist rates in the cable pairs
oh: Different twist rates in the cable pairs
e: Each pair in a UTP cable is twisted at a slightly different rate (to reduce crosstalk) — so signals arrive with small timing differences, called delay skew.
eh: UTP cable में हर pair थोड़ी अलग दर से twisted होता है (crosstalk घटाने के लिए) — इसलिए signals थोड़े अलग समय पर पहुँचते हैं, इसे delay skew कहते हैं।
n: Delay skew = pair-to-pair propagation time difference (tight twist → shorter wire → less skew). Cat6 has tighter specs for Gigabit.
nh: Delay skew = pair-to-pair propagation time अंतर (tight twist → छोटी wire → कम skew)। Cat6 में Gigabit के लिए कड़े specs हैं।

st: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
q: Which of the following best explains why fiber optic cables have a lower bit error rate than copper cables?
qh: Fiber optic cables की copper cables की तुलना में कम bit error rate की सबसे अच्छी व्याख्या कौन-सी है?
e: Fiber carries light and is immune to EMI/crosstalk/impulse noise — the main causes of bit errors in copper — so its BER is far lower.
eh: Fiber प्रकाश ले जाती है और EMI/crosstalk/impulse noise से मुक्त है — जो copper में bit errors के मुख्य कारण हैं — इसलिए इसका BER बहुत कम होता है।
n: Fiber wins on: EMI immunity, low attenuation, huge bandwidth, tap security.
nh: Fiber में श्रेष्ठता: EMI immunity, कम attenuation, विशाल bandwidth, tap security।

st: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
q: Which transmission medium works on the principle of total internal reflection?
qh: कौन-सा transmission medium total internal reflection के सिद्धांत पर काम करता है?
e: In optical fiber, light stays inside the glass core by total internal reflection (angle of incidence > critical angle).
eh: Optical fiber में प्रकाश total internal reflection के कारण glass core के भीतर रहता है (angle of incidence > critical angle)।
n: Fiber = TIR. Copper media use electrical signals (electromagnetic fields), not light reflection.
nh: Fiber = TIR। Copper media electrical signals (electromagnetic fields) उपयोग करते हैं, प्रकाश reflection नहीं।

st: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
q: Crosstalk in twisted pair cables is typically minimised by:
qh: Twisted pair cables में crosstalk आमतौर पर किससे कम होता है?
e: Tightening the twists equalises coupling and cancels interference between pairs — higher categories (Cat6/6a) use tighter twists.
eh: Tight twists coupling को संतुलित करते हैं और pairs के बीच interference रद्द करते हैं — उच्च श्रेणियों (Cat6/6a) में tighter twists होते हैं।
n: Anti-crosstalk tricks: tighter twists, pair separation, shielding (STP), lower power.
nh: Anti-crosstalk tricks: tighter twists, pair separation, shielding (STP), कम power।

st: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
q: What is the typical maximum length of a UTP cable in Ethernet before signal degradation?
qh: Signal degradation से पहले Ethernet में UTP cable की सामान्य अधिकतम लंबाई कितनी होती है?
e: Standard Ethernet UTP runs are limited to 100 metres (about 90 m of solid cable + 10 m of patch cords).
eh: Standard Ethernet UTP runs 100 मीटर तक सीमित हैं (लगभग 90 m solid cable + 10 m patch cords)।
n: Copper distance limits: UTP Ethernet 100 m, Thinnet 185 m, Thicknet 500 m, Fiber (multi-mode) ~550 m-2 km, (single-mode) tens of km.
nh: Copper distance limits: UTP Ethernet 100 m, Thinnet 185 m, Thicknet 500 m, Fiber (multi-mode) ~550 m-2 km, (single-mode) दसियों km।

st: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
q: Which connector is commonly used for coaxial cable in physical networks?
qh: Physical networks में coaxial cable के लिए सामान्यतः कौन-सा connector उपयोग होता है?
e: Coaxial networks use BNC connectors (with a terminator at the ends); RJ-45 is for twisted pair, HDMI for displays, USB-C for peripherals.
eh: Coaxial networks BNC connectors उपयोग करते हैं (छोर पर terminator के साथ); RJ-45 twisted pair के लिए, HDMI display के लिए, USB-C peripherals के लिए।
n: Connectors: RJ-45 (UTP Ethernet), BNC (coax/Thinnet), SC/ST/LC (fiber), RJ-11 (telephone).
nh: Connectors: RJ-45 (UTP Ethernet), BNC (coax/Thinnet), SC/ST/LC (fiber), RJ-11 (telephone)।

st: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
q: Which transmission medium is primarily used in modern internet backbone networks?
qh: आधुनिक internet backbone networks में मुख्य रूप से कौन-सा transmission medium उपयोग होता है?
e: Modern backbones use single-mode fiber — huge bandwidth over very long distances with low loss.
eh: आधुनिक backbones single mode fiber उपयोग करते हैं — लंबी दूरी पर कम loss के साथ विशाल bandwidth।
n: Backbone = single-mode fiber (undersea/terrestrial cables). LAN = UTP. Old cable TV = coax. Remote areas = microwave/satellite.
nh: Backbone = single-mode fiber (undersea/terrestrial cables)। LAN = UTP। पुराना cable TV = coax। दूरस्थ क्षेत्र = microwave/satellite।

st: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
q: Which transmission medium is best for a network exposed to heavy electrical interference?
qh: भारी electrical interference वाले network के लिए कौन-सा transmission medium सर्वोत्तम है?
e: Optical fiber is immune to electrical/EMI interference because it transmits light, not electrical signals.
eh: Optical fiber electrical/EMI interference से मुक्त है क्योंकि यह electrical signals नहीं, प्रकाश भेजती है।
n: EMI-heavy areas (factories, power plants) → fiber. 'Immune to EMI' = keyword for fiber.
nh: EMI-भारी क्षेत्र (कारखाने, power plants) → fiber। 'Immune to EMI' = fiber के लिए keyword।

st: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
q: Which of the following CANNOT be used as a medium for 802.3 Ethernet?
qh: निम्न में से कौन-सा 802.3 Ethernet के लिए medium उपयोग नहीं किया जा सकता?
e: 802.3 Ethernet is a wired standard — it runs on coax, twisted pair and fiber, but NOT on microwave (that is 802.11/wireless).
eh: 802.3 Ethernet एक wired standard है — यह coax, twisted pair और fiber पर चलता है, लेकिन microwave पर नहीं (वह 802.11/wireless है)।
n: 802.3 = Ethernet (wired: 10Base2/5, 10Base-T, 100Base-TX, 1000Base-X...). 802.11 = Wi-Fi (wireless).
nh: 802.3 = Ethernet (wired: 10Base2/5, 10Base-T, 100Base-TX, 1000Base-X...)। 802.11 = Wi-Fi (wireless)।

st: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
q: Which of the following is NOT a type of transmission medium?
qh: निम्न में से कौन-सा transmission medium का प्रकार नहीं है?
e: A NIC (Network Interface Card) is a hardware adapter — a device, not a transmission medium.
eh: NIC (Network Interface Card) एक hardware adapter है — एक device है, transmission medium नहीं।
n: Media = guided (twisted pair, coax, fiber) + unguided (radio, microwave, satellite, infrared). NIC = adapter.
nh: Media = guided (twisted pair, coax, fiber) + unguided (radio, microwave, satellite, infrared)। NIC = adapter।

st: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
q: Which cable has the maximum bandwidth?
qh: किस cable की bandwidth अधिकतम होती है?
e: Optical fiber offers the highest bandwidth — hundreds of Gbps to Tbps over long distances.
eh: Optical fiber सर्वोच्च bandwidth देती है — लंबी दूरी पर सैकड़ों Gbps से Tbps तक।
n: Bandwidth order: Fiber >> Coax > Twisted pair. USB is a peripheral bus, not a network cable type here.
nh: Bandwidth क्रम: Fiber >> Coax > Twisted pair। USB peripheral bus है, यहाँ network cable type नहीं।

st: Section C — Unguided Media (Wireless)
q: Which of the following is a wireless networking technology?
qh: निम्न में से कौन-सी wireless networking technology है?
e: Wi-Fi (IEEE 802.11) is a wireless LAN technology; Ethernet (802.3), fiber and DSL are all wired.
eh: Wi-Fi (IEEE 802.11) एक wireless LAN technology है; Ethernet (802.3), fiber और DSL सब wired हैं।
n: Wireless family: Wi-Fi (802.11), Bluetooth (802.15), WiMAX (802.16), mobile (GSM/LTE/5G).
nh: Wireless family: Wi-Fi (802.11), Bluetooth (802.15), WiMAX (802.16), mobile (GSM/LTE/5G)।

st: Section C — Unguided Media (Wireless)
q: Which wireless standard provides the highest data rate?
qh: कौन-सा wireless standard सर्वोच्च data rate देता है?
e: 802.11ac (Wi-Fi 5) offers the highest rate among these — up to multi-Gbps (5 GHz, MU-MIMO, wide channels).
eh: 802.11ac (Wi-Fi 5) इनमें सर्वोच्च rate देता है — तक मल्टी-Gbps (5 GHz, MU-MIMO, wide channels)।
n: Wi-Fi rates: b = 11 Mbps, g = 54 Mbps, n = 600 Mbps, ac = multi-Gbps. Order: b < g < n < ac.
nh: Wi-Fi rates: b = 11 Mbps, g = 54 Mbps, n = 600 Mbps, ac = multi-Gbps। क्रम: b < g < n < ac।

st: Section C — Unguided Media (Wireless)
q: Which type of wireless transmission requires line-of-sight?
qh: किस प्रकार की wireless transmission के लिए line-of-sight आवश्यक है?
e: Infrared transmission needs a direct line-of-sight (or reflection) between transmitter and receiver — it cannot pass through walls.
eh: Infrared transmission के लिए transmitter और receiver के बीच सीधी line-of-sight (या reflection) चाहिए — यह दीवारों से नहीं गुजरती।
n: IR = line-of-sight (TV remotes, IrDA). Radio/RF (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth) passes through walls (with loss).
nh: IR = line-of-sight (TV remotes, IrDA)। Radio/RF (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth) दीवारों से गुजरते हैं (loss के साथ)।

st: Section C — Unguided Media (Wireless)
q: Which of the following statements is NOT true about microwaves?
qh: Microwaves के बारे में निम्न में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: They are electromagnetic waves with frequencies from 300 GHz to 400 THz
Very high-frequency waves cannot penetrate walls
Use of certain portions of the band requires permission from authorities
oh: They are electromagnetic waves with frequencies from 300 GHz to 400 THz
Very high-frequency waves cannot penetrate walls
Use of certain portions of the band requires permission from authorities
e: Microwaves range roughly 300 MHz to 300 GHz — '300 GHz to 400 THz' is the infrared region, so this statement is false.
eh: Microwaves की range लगभग 300 MHz से 300 GHz है — '300 GHz से 400 THz' infrared क्षेत्र है, इसलिए यह कथन गलत है।
n: Microwaves: 300 MHz-300 GHz, line-of-sight, no wall penetration, licensed bands. Exam asks the odd range out.
nh: Microwaves: 300 MHz-300 GHz, line-of-sight, दीवार नहीं भेदते, licensed bands। Exam गलत range पूछता है।

st: Section C — Unguided Media (Wireless)
q: Which transmission medium is used in Bluetooth technology?
qh: Bluetooth technology में कौन-सा transmission medium उपयोग होता है?
e: Bluetooth (IEEE 802.15.1) uses short-range radio links in the 2.4 GHz ISM band.
eh: Bluetooth (IEEE 802.15.1) 2.4 GHz ISM band में short-range radio links उपयोग करता है।
n: Bluetooth = 2.4 GHz radio, WPAN (802.15), ~10-100 m range, frequency hopping.
nh: Bluetooth = 2.4 GHz radio, WPAN (802.15), ~10-100 m range, frequency hopping।

st: Section C — Unguided Media (Wireless)
q: Which physical-layer technique allows multiple users to share the same bandwidth simultaneously?
qh: कौन-सी physical-layer technique कई users को एक ही bandwidth साथ-साथ share करने देती है?
e: In CDMA every user transmits over the SAME bandwidth at the SAME time, separated by unique codes.
eh: CDMA में हर user एक ही bandwidth पर एक ही समय में transmit करता है, अलग-अलग codes से अलग किया जाता है।
n: Sharing methods: FDMA = frequency bands, TDMA = time slots, CDMA = codes (same band+time).
nh: Sharing methods: FDMA = frequency bands, TDMA = time slots, CDMA = codes (same band+time)।

st: Section C — Unguided Media (Wireless)
q: Select the FALSE statement about CDMA technology: I. CDMA optimises the use of available bandwidth as it transmits over the entire frequency range. II. Each user in a CDMA system uses a different code to modulate their signal. III. CDMA offers less security compared to GSM technology. IV. A SIM card is always required for a CDMA device to work.
qh: CDMA technology के बारे में गलत कथन चुनिए: I. CDMA उपलब्ध bandwidth के उपयोग को अनुकूलित करता है क्योंकि यह पूरी frequency range पर transmit करता है। II. CDMA system में हर user अपने signal को modulate करने के लिए अलग code उपयोग करता है। III. CDMA, GSM की तुलना में कम security देता है। IV. CDMA device के काम करने के लिए SIM card हमेशा आवश्यक है।
e: Statements III and IV are false: CDMA offers STRONGER security than GSM (spread spectrum + codes), and CDMA devices can work without a SIM (older CDMA handsets).
eh: कथन III और IV गलत हैं: CDMA, GSM से मज़बूत security देता है (spread spectrum + codes), और CDMA devices बिना SIM के भी चल सकते हैं (पुराने CDMA handsets)।
n: Rajasthan PYQ verified key (D). True: I (spread over full band) and II (unique codes per user). False: III (CDMA more secure) and IV (SIM not mandatory).
nh: Rajasthan PYQ verified key (D)। सही: I (पूरे band पर spread) और II (हर user का unique code)। गलत: III (CDMA अधिक सुरक्षित) और IV (SIM अनिवार्य नहीं)।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: According to Nyquist, the maximum bit rate of a noiseless channel with bandwidth 3000 Hz and 4 signal levels is:
qh: Nyquist के अनुसार 3000 Hz bandwidth, 4 signal levels वाले noiseless channel की अधिकतम bit rate है:
n: 6000 log₂L bhool kar; 24000 double-count.

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: A signal-to-noise ratio of 1000 corresponds to how many dB?
qh: Signal-to-noise ratio 1000 कितने dB है?
e: SNR(dB) = 10 log₁₀(1000) = 30 dB.
n: 10 dB = ratio 10.
nh: 10 dB = ratio 10।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: Which encoding has a transition in the middle of every bit and is self-synchronizing?
qh: कौन-सी encoding में हर bit के बीच transition होता है और वह self-synchronizing है?
e: Manchester: bit ke beech transition — clock recovery aasan.
eh: Manchester: bit के बीच transition।
n: NRZ level constant rakhta hai.
nh: NRZ level constant।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: Attenuation of a signal means:
qh: Signal का attenuation अर्थ है:
e: Attenuation = signal weak hona distance ke saath; repeater se restore.
eh: Attenuation = दूरी से कमज़ोरी।
n: Frequency ka badalna distortion kehlata hai.
nh: आवृत्ति बदलना distortion।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: Crosstalk is a type of:
qh: Crosstalk किसका प्रकार है?
e: Crosstalk = ek wire ka signal doosre mein interfere karna — ek noise.
eh: Crosstalk = एक wire का signal दूसरे में — एक noise।
n: Encoding data ka format hai.
nh: Encoding format है।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: According to Shannon's capacity theorem, a 1 MHz channel with SNR = 30 dB has a capacity of approximately:
qh: Shannon के सूत्र से 1 MHz channel जिसका SNR = 30 dB हो, की capacity लगभग होगी:
n: Shannon mein SNR linear value lagti hai, dB nahi — pehle convert karo.
nh: Shannon में SNR linear value लगती है, dB नहीं।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: In NRZ-I encoding, a binary 1 is represented by:
qh: NRZ-I encoding में binary 1 को दर्शाया जाता है:
o: A transition at the beginning of the bit interval
A transition in the middle of the bit
oh: Bit interval की शुरुआत में transition
e: NRZ-I (Invert): 1 = signal invert (transition) at start of bit; 0 = no transition. Consecutive 1s ke liye clock sync rehti hai.
eh: NRZ-I: 1 = bit की शुरुआत में invert/transition; 0 = बिना transition।
n: Middle transition = Manchester (har bit mein); NRZ-I mein middle nahi.
nh: बीच का transition = Manchester; NRZ-I में नहीं।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: A noiseless channel has a bandwidth of 4 kHz and uses 16 signal levels. Per Nyquist's theorem, the maximum bit rate is:
qh: एक noiseless channel की bandwidth 4 kHz है और वह 16 signal levels प्रयोग करती है। Nyquist के अनुसार अधिकतम bit rate होगी:
e: Nyquist: C = 2 × B × log2(L) = 2 × 4000 × log2(16) = 2 × 4000 × 4 = 32 kbps. Pattern: RPSC Programmer/DD + GATE-style signal numerics.
eh: Nyquist: C = 2 × 4000 × log2(16) = 32 kbps। Pattern: RPSC Programmer/DD + GATE-style।
n: Shannon (noise wala) = B log2(1+SNR); Nyquist (noiseless) = 2B log2(L) — mix mat karna.
nh: Shannon = B log2(1+SNR); Nyquist = 2B log2(L)।

st: Section A — Signals & Performance (Encoding, Noise, Bandwidth, Data Rate)
q: An analog voice signal is sampled 8000 times per second with 8 bits per sample. The resulting digital bit rate is:
qh: एक analog voice signal को प्रति सेकंड 8000 बार sample किया जाता है, हर sample 8 bits का। बनी digital bit rate होगी:
e: 8000 samples/s × 8 bits = 64,000 bps = 64 kbps — yahi classic PCM/DS0 voice channel hai (telephony standard). Pattern: SSC CGL/IBPS + technical exams.
eh: 8000 × 8 = 64 kbps — यही PCM/DS0 voice channel है। Pattern: SSC CGL/IBPS।
n: Nyquist: voice ke liye 8 kHz sampling enough (4 kHz bandwidth × 2).
nh: Voice के लिए 8 kHz sampling पर्याप्त (4 kHz × 2)।

st: Section B — Guided Media (UTP, Coaxial, Fiber Optic)
q: Which fiber type is used for long-distance communication?
qh: लंबी दूरी के संचार के लिए कौन-सी fiber प्रयोग होती है?
e: Single-mode: ek light ray, kam dispersion — lambi doori.
eh: Single-mode: एक ray — लंबी दूरी।
n: Multimode chhoti doori ke liye.
nh: Multimode छोटी दूरी।

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: Which sub-layer of the Data Link Layer is responsible for flow control and error control?
qh: Data Link Layer का कौन-सा sub-layer flow control और error control के लिए ज़िम्मेदार होता है?
e: LLC (Logical Link Control) sub-layer flow control, error control और Network layer को service interface देता है; MAC sub-layer physical addressing और channel access संभालता है.
eh: LLC (Logical Link Control) sub-layer flow control, error control और Network layer को service interface देता है; MAC sub-layer physical addressing और channel access संभालता है.
n: DLL = MAC + LLC — याद रखो: MAC = addressing + medium access, LLC = flow + error + interface.
nh: DLL = MAC + LLC — याद रखो: MAC = addressing + medium access, LLC = flow + error + interface.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: Which of the following functions are performed by the Data Link Layer? (1) Framing (2) Error Detection (3) Flow Control (4) Path Determination
qh: निम्न में से कौन-से कार्य Data Link Layer करता है? (1) Framing (2) Error Detection (3) Flow Control (4) Path Determination
e: Framing, Error Detection और Flow Control — तीनों Data Link Layer के काम हैं. Path Determination यानी routing Network Layer का काम है.
eh: Framing, Error Detection और Flow Control — तीनों Data Link Layer के काम हैं. Path Determination यानी routing Network Layer का काम है.
n: याद रखो: DLL में F-E-F (Framing, Error, Flow) + addressing; रास्ता चुनना (routing) Network Layer का.
nh: याद रखो: DLL में F-E-F (Framing, Error, Flow) + addressing; रास्ता चुनना (routing) Network Layer का.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: Which of the following statements about MAC and LLC sublayers is TRUE? (1) MAC sublayer handles physical addressing (2) LLC sublayer provides error control and flow control (3) MAC sublayer performs routing
qh: MAC और LLC sub-layers के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सही है? (1) MAC sub-layer physical addressing संभालता है (2) LLC sub-layer error control और flow control देता है (3) MAC sub-layer routing करता है
e: (1) सही — MAC physical (MAC) addressing संभालता है; (2) सही — LLC में flow और error control होता है; (3) गलत — MAC में routing नहीं होती, routing Network Layer का काम है.
eh: (1) सही — MAC physical (MAC) addressing संभालता है; (2) सही — LLC में flow और error control होता है; (3) गलत — MAC में routing नहीं होती, routing Network Layer का काम है.
n: MAC = addressing + channel access; LLC = flow + error + interface; routing = Network Layer.
nh: MAC = addressing + channel access; LLC = flow + error + interface; routing = Network Layer.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: Which of the following is NOT a responsibility of the LLC sublayer?
qh: निम्न में से कौन-सा LLC sub-layer की ज़िम्मेदारी नहीं है?
e: Physical addressing (MAC address) MAC sub-layer का काम है — LLC नहीं. LLC flow control, error control और Network layer को interface देता है.
eh: Physical addressing (MAC address) MAC sub-layer का काम है — LLC नहीं. LLC flow control, error control और Network layer को interface देता है.
n: MAC = Media Access Control = addressing; LLC = Logical Link Control = flow/error.
nh: MAC = Media Access Control = addressing; LLC = Logical Link Control = flow/error.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: Which of the following is NOT a function of the Data Link Layer?
qh: निम्न में से कौन-सा Data Link Layer का function नहीं है?
e: Routing (रास्ता तय करना) Network Layer का function है. Data Link Layer framing, error detection/correction और flow control करता है.
eh: Routing (रास्ता तय करना) Network Layer का function है. Data Link Layer framing, error detection/correction और flow control करता है.
n: DLL = next-hop delivery (frame); Network = end-to-end delivery (packet + route).
nh: DLL = next-hop delivery (frame); Network = end-to-end delivery (packet + route).

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: The Frame Check Sequence (FCS) field in an Ethernet frame is used for:
qh: Ethernet frame में Frame Check Sequence (FCS) field किस काम आता है?
e: FCS field में CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) का result होता है जिससे receiver frame की errors detect करता है.
eh: FCS field में CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) का result होता है जिससे receiver frame की errors detect करता है.
n: FCS = CRC = error detection. Ethernet error correct नहीं करता, बस detect करके frame drop करता है.
nh: FCS = CRC = error detection. Ethernet error correct नहीं करता, बस detect करके frame drop करता है.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control

e: Stop-and-Wait, Go-Back-N और Selective Repeat — तीनों ARQ protocols sequence numbers और acknowledgments दोनों उपयोग करते हैं.
eh: Stop-and-Wait, Go-Back-N और Selective Repeat — तीनों ARQ protocols sequence numbers और acknowledgments दोनों उपयोग करते हैं.
n: ARQ = Automatic Repeat reQuest — बिना sequence/ack के कोई ARQ चल ही नहीं सकता.
nh: ARQ = Automatic Repeat reQuest — बिना sequence/ack के कोई ARQ चल ही नहीं सकता.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: Error control is the process of detecting and correcting errors, while ______ is a mechanism to ensure the efficient delivery of data.
qh: Error control, errors को detect और correct करने की प्रक्रिया है, जबकि ______ data के कुशल delivery का mechanism है.
e: पहला blank Error control (errors detect+correct), दूसरा Flow control (sender की speed receiver के हिसाब से) — दोनों Data Link/Transport layers में मिलते हैं.
eh: पहला blank Error control (errors detect+correct), दूसरा Flow control (sender की speed receiver के हिसाब से) — दोनों Data Link/Transport layers में मिलते हैं.
n: Error = putting right; Flow = maintaining balance. Both are separate jobs.
nh: Error = सही करना; Flow = संतुलन बनाना. दोनों अलग-अलग काम हैं.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: ______ control refers to a set of procedures used to restrict the amount of data that the sender can send before waiting for acknowledgment.
qh: ______ control उन procedures का समूह है जो sender द्वारा acknowledgment की प्रतीक्षा से पहले भेजे जाने वाले data की मात्रा सीमित करते हैं.
e: Flow control sender को रोकता है ताकि receiver का buffer न भरे — इसलिए acknowledgment आने तक data सीमित रहता है.
eh: Flow control sender को रोकता है ताकि receiver का buffer न भरे — इसलिए acknowledgment आने तक data सीमित रहता है.
n: Flow control = the balance between sender and receiver; this definition is asked again and again in exams.
nh: Flow control = sender↔receiver के बीच का संतुलन; यही definition परीक्षा में बार-बार आती है.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: What is the main purpose of the Sliding Window in TCP?
qh: TCP में Sliding Window का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
e: Sliding window से receiver बताता है कि वह कितना data ले सकता है — यही flow control है.
eh: Sliding window से receiver बताता है कि वह कितना data ले सकता है — यही flow control है.
n: TCP window = receiver की capacity का advertisement; इसीलिए इसे flow control कहते हैं.
nh: TCP window = receiver की capacity का advertisement; इसीलिए इसे flow control कहते हैं.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: Flow control prevents which of the following issues?
qh: Flow control निम्न में से किस समस्या को रोकता है?
e: Flow control receiver के buffer को overflow होने से बचाता है — sender उतना ही भेजता है जितना receiver संभाल सके.
eh: Flow control receiver के buffer को overflow होने से बचाता है — sender उतना ही भेजता है जितना receiver संभाल सके.
n: Flow control = दोनों के बीच; Congestion control = पूरे network के लिए.
nh: Flow control = दोनों के बीच; Congestion control = पूरे network के लिए.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: In the TCP header, the acknowledgment field value represents:
qh: TCP header में acknowledgment field का मान किसे दर्शाता है?
o: Total number of bytes to receive
Sequence number of the next byte expected
oh: Total number of bytes to receive
Sequence number of the next byte expected
e: TCP का ACK number अगली expected byte का sequence number है — यानी अब तक सब कुछ उससे पहले मिल चुका है (cumulative acknowledgment).
eh: TCP का ACK number अगली expected byte का sequence number है — यानी अब तक सब कुछ उससे पहले मिल चुका है (cumulative acknowledgment).
n: TCP bytes गिनता है, packets नहीं — ACK = 'next byte भेजो'.
nh: TCP bytes गिनता है, packets नहीं — ACK = 'next byte भेजो'.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: In Stop-and-Wait ARQ, after sending one frame, the sender:
qh: Stop-and-Wait ARQ में एक frame भेजने के बाद sender:
e: Stop-and-Wait में sender एक frame भेजकर उसके acknowledgment का इंतज़ार करता है.
eh: Stop-and-Wait में sender एक frame भेजकर उसके acknowledgment का इंतज़ार करता है.
n: Because of this waiting, its name became 'Stop-and-Wait'.
nh: इसी waiting के कारण इसका नाम 'Stop-and-Wait' पड़ा.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: In Stop-and-Wait protocol, the sender sends:
qh: Stop-and-Wait protocol में sender भेजता है:
e: Stop-and-Wait में एक समय में सिर्फ एक frame outstanding रहता है.
eh: Stop-and-Wait में एक समय में सिर्फ एक frame outstanding रहता है.
n: Window size = 1 — इसीलिए एक-एक frame.
nh: Window size = 1 — इसीलिए एक-एक frame.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: What is the window size in Stop-and-Wait ARQ?
qh: Stop-and-Wait ARQ में window size कितनी होती है?
e: Stop-and-Wait has window size 1 — only one frame can be out without an ACK.
eh: Stop-and-Wait की window size 1 होती है — एक ही frame बिना ACK के भेजा जा सकता है.
n: Window = 1 ↔ एक frame at a time — दोनों एक ही बात हैं.
nh: Window = 1 ↔ एक frame at a time — दोनों एक ही बात हैं.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: What is the main disadvantage of Stop-and-Wait flow control?
qh: Stop-and-Wait flow control की मुख्य कमी क्या है?
e: Waiting after every frame leaves the line idle — efficiency drops sharply, especially on long-distance links.
eh: हर frame के बाद इंतज़ार करने से line बेकार खाली रहती है — खासकर long-distance links पर efficiency बहुत गिर जाती है.
n: Waiting = idle time = कम utilization. इसीलिए Sliding Window आया.
nh: Waiting = idle time = कम utilization. इसीलिए Sliding Window आया.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: A Stop-and-Wait ARQ channel has high latency and large bandwidth. What problem occurs?
qh: Stop-and-Wait ARQ channel पर latency ज़्यादा और bandwidth बड़ी हो तो क्या समस्या होती है?
e: High latency में ACK देर से आता है और बड़ी bandwidth खाली रह जाती है — channel utilization बहुत कम हो जाता है. इसीलिए high-BDP links पर Sliding Window protocols उपयोग होते हैं.
eh: High latency में ACK देर से आता है और बड़ी bandwidth खाली रह जाती है — channel utilization बहुत कम हो जाता है. इसीलिए high-BDP links पर Sliding Window protocols उपयोग होते हैं.
n: Bandwidth × Delay (BDP) जितना बड़ा, Stop-and-Wait उतना बेकार.
nh: Bandwidth × Delay (BDP) जितना बड़ा, Stop-and-Wait उतना बेकार.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: In Stop-and-Wait ARQ, what happens when a frame is lost?
qh: Stop-and-Wait ARQ में frame खो जाए तो क्या होता है?
e: If the ACK does not arrive, the sender's timeout timer fires and it retransmits that frame.
eh: ACK न आने पर sender का timeout timer बजता है और वह frame दोबारा भेजता है.
n: Lost frame + timeout = retransmission. Receiver कभी retransmit नहीं करता.
nh: Lost frame + timeout = retransmission. Receiver कभी retransmit नहीं करता.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: For Stop-and-Wait ARQ, for 10 data packets sent, ............ acknowledgements are needed.
qh: Stop-and-Wait ARQ में 10 data packets भेजने पर ............ acknowledgements चाहिए होते हैं.
e: हर packet का अपना ACK चाहिए — 10 packets → 10 ACKs.
eh: हर packet का अपना ACK चाहिए — 10 packets → 10 ACKs.
n: RPSC official key (d) — Stop-and-Wait में ack:packet अनुपात 1:1.
nh: RPSC official key (d) — Stop-and-Wait में ack:packet अनुपात 1:1.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: In Go-Back-N ARQ, if an error is detected in a frame:
qh: Go-Back-N ARQ में किसी frame में error मिले तो:
o: That frame and all subsequent outstanding frames are retransmitted
oh: That frame and all subsequent outstanding frames are retransmitted
e: Go-Back-N में receiver केवल in-order frames रखता है; गलत frame के बाद के सारे frames छोड़ देता है और sender उस frame से आगे के सभी outstanding frames दोबारा भेजता है.
eh: Go-Back-N में receiver केवल in-order frames रखता है; गलत frame के बाद के सारे frames छोड़ देता है और sender उस frame से आगे के सभी outstanding frames दोबारा भेजता है.
n: GBN = 'from where you slipped, start again' — in Selective Repeat only the wrong frame is resent.
nh: GBN = 'जहाँ चूक, वहाँ से फिर से' — Selective Repeat में सिर्फ गलत frame दोबारा जाता है.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: In the ______ protocol, if no acknowledgment for a frame has arrived, we resend all outstanding frames.
qh: ______ protocol में, किसी frame का acknowledgment न आए तो हम सभी outstanding frames दोबारा भेजते हैं.
e: 'सभी outstanding frames दोबारा भेजना' Go-Back-N की पहचान है.
eh: 'सभी outstanding frames दोबारा भेजना' Go-Back-N की पहचान है.
n: GBN = Go Back N — everything up to N is resent; SR = only the wrong one.
nh: GBN = Go Back N — Nवें तक सब दोबारा; SR = सिर्फ गलत वाला.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: A Go-Back-N sender uses window size 4. Frame 2 is lost. What happens after the receiver receives frames 3 and 4?
qh: Go-Back-N sender window size 4 उपयोग करता है. Frame 2 खो जाता है. Receiver को frames 3 और 4 मिलने के बाद क्या होता है?
o: Receiver stores frames 3 and 4 in buffer
oh: Receiver stores frames 3 and 4 in buffer
e: A GBN receiver wants only the next in-order frame — when frame 2 is lost, 3 and 4 are out-of-order, so they are discarded.
eh: GBN receiver सिर्फ अगली in-order frame चाहता है — frame 2 खोने पर 3 और 4 out-of-order हैं, इसलिए उन्हें discard कर दिया जाता है.
n: GBN receiver dumb होता है (buffer नहीं रखता); SR receiver smart (buffer रखता है).
nh: GBN receiver dumb होता है (buffer नहीं रखता); SR receiver smart (buffer रखता है).

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: In Go-Back-N ARQ, if 6 is the number of bits for the sequence number, then the maximum size of the send window must be:
qh: Go-Back-N ARQ में sequence number के 6 bits हों तो send window का अधिकतम आकार कितना होगा?
e: GBN में maximum window = 2ⁿ − 1 = 2⁶ − 1 = 63.
eh: GBN में maximum window = 2ⁿ − 1 = 2⁶ − 1 = 63.
n: GBN/SW का window formula अलग है SR से — GBN: 2ⁿ−1, SR: 2ⁿ⁻¹.
nh: GBN/SW का window formula अलग है SR से — GBN: 2ⁿ−1, SR: 2ⁿ⁻¹.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: In a Go-Back-N protocol, if the window size = 63, how many sequence number bits are required?
qh: Go-Back-N protocol में window size = 63 हो तो sequence number के कितने bits चाहिए?
e: Window = 2ⁿ − 1 → 63 = 2⁶ − 1, इसलिए n = 6 bits.
eh: Window = 2ⁿ − 1 → 63 = 2⁶ − 1, इसलिए n = 6 bits.
n: The reverse of the question above — memorise the formula both ways.
nh: उपर वाले प्रश्न का उल्टा — यही formula दोनों तरफ से याद रखो.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: The maximum number of outstanding frames in Selective Repeat (with N sequence numbers) is:
qh: Selective Repeat में outstanding frames की अधिकतम संख्या (N sequence numbers के साथ) होती है:
e: Selective Repeat में sender और receiver दोनों की windows अलग-अलग होती हैं, इसलिए window ≤ N/2 — यानी अधिकतम N/2 frames outstanding.
eh: Selective Repeat में sender और receiver दोनों की windows अलग-अलग होती हैं, इसलिए window ≤ N/2 — यानी अधिकतम N/2 frames outstanding.
n: SR: window N/2 (दो windows), GBN: window N−1 (एक window).
nh: SR: window N/2 (दो windows), GBN: window N−1 (एक window).

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: A Selective Repeat sliding window protocol uses a window size of 7 with 3-bit sequence numbers. Is it valid?
qh: Selective Repeat sliding window protocol में 3-bit sequence numbers के साथ window size 7 क्या वैध है?
o: Invalid – violates the maximum window rule
oh: Invalid – violates the maximum window rule
e: 3-bit sequence numbers पर SR की maximum window = 2³⁻¹ = 4 होती है; 7 > 4 होने से receiver new और old frames में फ़र्क नहीं कर पाएगा — इसलिए अवैध.
eh: 3-bit sequence numbers पर SR की maximum window = 2³⁻¹ = 4 होती है; 7 > 4 होने से receiver new और old frames में फ़र्क नहीं कर पाएगा — इसलिए अवैध.
n: SR window ≤ 2ⁿ⁻¹; GBN window ≤ 2ⁿ − 1. यही फ़र्क याद रखो.
nh: SR window ≤ 2ⁿ⁻¹; GBN window ≤ 2ⁿ − 1. यही फ़र्क याद रखो.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: Which protocol has better bandwidth utilization?
qh: किस protocol का bandwidth utilization बेहतर होता है?
e: Selective Repeat resends only the lost frames and also buffers out-of-order frames — bandwidth utilisation is the highest.
eh: Selective Repeat सिर्फ खोए frames दोबारा भेजता है और out-of-order frames भी buffer कर लेता है — bandwidth सबसे ज़्यादा उपयोग होती है.
n: Efficiency क्रम: Selective Repeat > Go-Back-N > Stop-and-Wait.
nh: Efficiency क्रम: Selective Repeat > Go-Back-N > Stop-and-Wait.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: A noisy channel uses a Hamming code with minimum distance 3. What can it guarantee?
qh: एक noisy channel पर minimum distance 3 वाला Hamming code क्या guarantee दे सकता है?
e: Minimum distance d = 3 वाला code 2 errors detect या 1 error correct कर सकता है (d ≥ t + 1 for detection, d ≥ 2t + 1 for correction).
eh: Minimum distance d = 3 वाला code 2 errors detect या 1 error correct कर सकता है (d ≥ t + 1 for detection, d ≥ 2t + 1 for correction).
n: d=3 → detect 2 या correct 1 — 'correct 2' के लिए d ≥ 5 चाहिए.
nh: d=3 → detect 2 या correct 1 — 'correct 2' के लिए d ≥ 5 चाहिए.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: What is the Hamming distance between the two codes 10010010 and 11011001?
qh: दो codes 10010010 और 11011001 के बीच Hamming distance कितनी है?
e: Align the two codes and count differing bits: positions 2, 5, 7 and 8 differ — 4 differences in all. Hamming distance = number of differing bits = 4.
eh: दोनों codes को align करके अलग-अलग bits गिनो: positions 2, 5, 7 और 8 बदलती हैं — कुल 4 अंतर. Hamming distance = अलग bits की संख्या = 4.
n: Hamming distance = XOR के बाद 1s की गिनती.
nh: Hamming distance = XOR के बाद 1s की गिनती.

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
