e: S1 sahi: har node poora SPF/Dijkstra chalata hai. S3 sahi: flooding se LS topology turant jaanti hai. S2 galat: link state shortest-path tree loop-free hota hai — loops ki samasya distance vector ki hai.
eh: S1 सही: हर node पूरा SPF चलाता है। S3 सही: flooding से तेज़ converge। S2 गलत: link state tree loop-free होता है।
n: S2 ulta hai — split horizon count-to-infinity se poora bachata bhi nahi.
nh: S2 उल्टा — split horizon count-to-infinity से पूरा बचाता भी नहीं।

st: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
q: Which one of the following is TRUE about the interior gateway routing protocols RIP (Routing Information Protocol) and OSPF (Open Shortest Path First)?
qh: Interior gateway routing protocols RIP (Routing Information Protocol) और OSPF (Open Shortest Path First) के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सही है?
o: RIP uses distance vector routing and OSPF uses link state routing
OSPF uses distance vector routing and RIP uses link state routing
Both RIP and OSPF use link state routing
Both RIP and OSPF use distance vector routing
oh: RIP distance vector और OSPF link state routing प्रयोग करता है
OSPF distance vector और RIP link state routing प्रयोग करता है
दोनों link state routing प्रयोग करते हैं
दोनों distance vector routing प्रयोग करते हैं
e: RIP neighbours ko apni distance vector bhejta hai (distance vector family); OSPF poora topology map flood kar Dijkstra chalata hai (link state) — yeh standard classification hai.
eh: RIP अपनी distance vector भेजता है; OSPF topology flood कर Dijkstra चलाता है (link state) — यही मानक भेद है।
n: Dono ko ek hi category mein daalna common galti hai.
nh: दोनों को एक श्रेणी में डालना आम गलती।

st: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
q:
Consider the following statements about the functionality of an IP based router:
I. A router does not modify the IP packets during forwarding.
II. It is not necessary for a router to implement any routing protocol.
III. A router should reassemble IP fragments if the MTU of the outgoing link is larger than the size of the incoming IP packet.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are TRUE?
qh:
IP आधारित router की कार्यप्रणाली के बारे में विचार:
I. Router forwarding के दौरान IP packets को संशोधित नहीं करता।
II. Router के लिए कोई routing protocol लागू करना आवश्यक नहीं है।
III. यदि outgoing link का MTU आने वाले packet से बड़ा हो तो router को fragments जोड़ने चाहिए।
इनमें कौन-सा कथन सही है?
e: I galat: router TTL ghatata hai aur checksum badalta hai. II sahi: static routes se bhi router chal sakta hai. III galat: reassembly sirf destination host karta hai, router kabhi nahi.
eh: I गलत: router TTL/checksum बदलता है। II सही: static routes से भी चलेगा। III गलत: reassembly सिर्फ़ destination करता है।
n: Fragmentation ke baad re-fragmentation ka kaam router ka hai, jodna nahi.
nh: Router re-fragment कर सकता है, जोड़ता नहीं।

st: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
q:
Host A (on TCP/IPv4 network A) sends an IP datagram D to host B (on TCP/IPv4 network B) with no transmission error. When D reaches B, which of the following IP header field(s) may be different from that of the original datagram D?
I. TTL    II. Checksum    III. Fragment Offset
qh:
Host A ने (TCP/IPv4 network A से) बिना किसी त्रुटि के IP datagram D, host B को भेजा। D के B पर पहुँचने पर निम्न में से कौन-से IP header fields मूल datagram से भिन्न हो सकते हैं?
I. TTL    II. Checksum    III. Fragment Offset
e: Har router par TTL ghat-ta hai aur checksum naya hota hai; raaste mein fragmentation hui to fragment offset bhi lag sakta hai — teeno badal sakte hain (GATE 2014 key).
eh: हर router पर TTL घटता है, checksum नया; रास्ते में fragmentation हुई तो offset भी — तीनों बदल सकते हैं।
n: Offset ko 'sirf fragmentation ke time' samajh kar chhod dena galti hai — puchha hai 'ho sakta hai'.
nh: Offset को छोड़ देना गलती — पूछा है 'हो सकता है'।

st: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer
q: The functionalities of the presentation layer include:
qh: Presentation layer के कार्यों में शामिल हैं:
e: Presentation layer data का रूप संभालती है — compression, encryption और translation (जैसे ASCII/EBCDIC) — तीनों.
eh: Presentation layer data का रूप संभालती है — compression, encryption और translation (जैसे ASCII/EBCDIC) — तीनों.
n: Presentation = data का मेकअप (रूप, रंग, सुरक्षा); Application = सेवाएँ.
nh: Presentation = data का मेकअप (रूप, रंग, सुरक्षा); Application = सेवाएँ.

st: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer
q: The structure or format of data is called:
qh: Data का structure या format कहलाता है:
e: Forouzan के अनुसार: Syntax = data का structure/format; Semantics = sections का अर्थ.
eh: Forouzan के अनुसार: Syntax = data का structure/format; Semantics = sections का अर्थ.
n: Rule: Syntax = how it looks; Semantics = what it means. Both must be agreed for communication.
nh: नियम: Syntax = कैसा दिखे; Semantics = क्या अर्थ हो. Communication में दोनों तय होने चाहिए.

st: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer
q: Which protocol layer uses protocols such as WWW, HTTP, FTP, SMTP and e-mail?
qh: कौन-सी protocol layer WWW, HTTP, FTP, SMTP और e-mail जैसे protocols उपयोग करती है?
e: HTTP, FTP, SMTP, e-mail आदि Application layer के protocols हैं — यही उपयोगकर्ता की सेवाएँ देती हैं.
eh: HTTP, FTP, SMTP, e-mail आदि Application layer के protocols हैं — यही उपयोगकर्ता की सेवाएँ देती हैं.
n: याद रखो: Layer 7 = सेवाएँ (HTTP/FTP/SMTP/DNS); Layer 4 = TCP/UDP; Layer 3 = IP.
nh: याद रखो: Layer 7 = सेवाएँ (HTTP/FTP/SMTP/DNS); Layer 4 = TCP/UDP; Layer 3 = IP.

st: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer
q: Which layer protocols provide user and application programme support such as passwords, resource sharing and file transfer?
qh: किस layer के protocols उपयोगकर्ता और application programme को passwords, resource sharing और file transfer जैसी सहायता देते हैं?
e: Layer 7 (Application) ही users की सेवाएँ संभालती है — passwords, file transfer, resource sharing आदि.
eh: Layer 7 (Application) ही users की सेवाएँ संभालती है — passwords, file transfer, resource sharing आदि.
n: OSI has exactly 7 layers — there can be no 'Layer 10'.
nh: OSI में 7 layers ही हैं — 'Layer 10' तो हो ही नहीं सकती.

st: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer
q: Which of the following protocols is primarily used for secure web browsing?
qh: निम्न में से कौन-सा protocol मुख्य रूप से सुरक्षित web browsing के लिए उपयोग होता है?
e: HTTPS = HTTP + TLS/SSL encryption — browser और server के बीच सारा व्यवहार encrypted रहता है.
eh: HTTPS = HTTP + TLS/SSL encryption — browser और server के बीच सारा व्यवहार encrypted रहता है.
n: HTTPS का port 443; HTTP का 80. ताला (lock) वाली site = HTTPS.
nh: HTTPS का port 443; HTTP का 80. ताला (lock) वाली site = HTTPS.

st: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer
q: A server receives a packet with destination port 443. This implies:
qh: एक server को destination port 443 वाला packet मिलता है. इसका अर्थ है:
e: Port 443 HTTPS (सुरक्षित web) का standard port है.
eh: Port 443 HTTPS (सुरक्षित web) का standard port है.
n: Ports: 80=HTTP, 443=HTTPS, 21/20=FTP, 22=SSH, 23=Telnet, 25=SMTP, 53=DNS, 67/68=DHCP.
nh: Ports: 80=HTTP, 443=HTTPS, 21/20=FTP, 22=SSH, 23=Telnet, 25=SMTP, 53=DNS, 67/68=DHCP.

st: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer
q: Which protocol is generally used to encrypt data between a web browser and a web server?
qh: Web browser और web server के बीच data encrypt करने के लिए आमतौर पर कौन-सा protocol उपयोग होता है?
e: SSL/TLS (आजकल TLS) browser-server के बीच encryption देता है — इसी पर HTTPS चलता है.

st: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer

e: (1) सही — non-persistent HTTP हर object के लिए नया connection; (2) सही — FTP में control + data connections; (3) गलत — ऐसी 'केवल दो' सीमा नहीं.
eh: (1) सही — non-persistent HTTP हर object के लिए नया connection; (2) सही — FTP में control + data connections; (3) गलत — ऐसी 'केवल दो' सीमा नहीं.

st: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer

st: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer

st: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer
q: Consider a long-lived TCP session with an end-to-end bandwidth of 1 Gbps (= 10⁹ bits/second). The session starts with a sequence number of 1234. The minimum time (in seconds, rounded to the closest integer) before this sequence number can be used again is ______.
qh: एक लंबी TCP session की bandwidth 1 Gbps (= 10⁹ bits/second) है और वह sequence number 1234 से शुरू होती है। इस sequence number के पुनः प्रयोग से पहले न्यूनतम समय (seconds में, निकटतम पूर्णांक) कितना है?
e: TCP sequence numbers bytes count karte hain: 2³² bytes ka space; 1 Gbps = 1.25×10⁸ bytes/sec → 2³² ÷ 1.25×10⁸ = 34.36 s → 34 second.
eh: TCP sequence numbers bytes गिनते हैं: 2³² bytes; 1 Gbps = 1.25×10⁸ B/s → 34.36 s → 34 second.
n: Bits mein hisaab karke 4 s; ya 2³² bits samajh kar galat number — bytes ka chakkar hai.
nh: Bits में हिसाब लगाना (4 s) या 2³² bits मानना गलत।

st: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer
q: In the TCP three-way handshake, host P sends a connection request to Q with SYN = 1, SEQ = X, ACK = 0. Q accepts the connection. Which of the following represents the information in the TCP segment header sent by Q to P?
qh: TCP three-way handshake में host P, Q को connection request भेजता है: SYN = 1, SEQ = X, ACK = 0। Q connection स्वीकार करता है। Q द्वारा P को भेजे segment header में क्या होगा?
e: Q apna random sequence number Y bhejta hai, SYN=1 rakhta hai (apna SYN), aur acknowledge karta hai X ka — agla byte X+1 (GATE 2021 key: III).
eh: Q अपना sequence number Y भेजता है, SYN=1, और X का ack = X+1 (GATE 2021 key: III)।
n: ACK = X galat (yeh khud ko X+1 expect karna hua); SYN=0 second segment jaisa hota.
nh: ACK = X गलत (X+1 अपेक्षित); SYN=0 दूसरे जैसा।

st: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer
q: Consider data transfer using TCP over a 1 Gbps link. Assuming that the maximum segment lifetime (MSL) is set to 60 seconds, the minimum number of bits required for the sequence number field of the TCP header, to prevent the sequence number space from wrapping around during the MSL, is ______.
qh: 1 Gbps link पर TCP से data transfer हो रहा है। Maximum segment lifetime (MSL) 60 seconds है। MSL के दौरान sequence number space के wrap होने से बचने के लिए TCP header के sequence number field में न्यूनतम कितने bits चाहिए?
e: 1 Gbps = 1.25×10⁸ bytes/sec; 60 s में 7.5×10⁹ bytes; 2³² = 4.29×10⁹ < 7.5×10⁹ < 2³³ = 8.59×10⁹ — इसलिए कम से कम 33 bits (GATE 2022 key).
n: 32 bits mein space 60 s के लिए kam padta hai; 34/36 zyada hain (minimum pucha hai).
nh: 32 कम पड़ता; 34/36 ज़्यादा (न्यूनतम पूछा है)।

st: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer
q: A TCP client and server complete data transfer. The client calls close; a FIN segment is sent to the server, which responds with an ACK received by the client. As per the TCP connection state diagram (RFC 793), in which state does the client-side TCP connection wait for the FIN from the server?
qh: TCP client-server का data transfer पूरा हुआ। Client close करता है; server को FIN जाता है; server का ACK client को मिलता है। RFC 793 की state diagram के अनुसार client-side connection server के FIN की प्रतीक्षा किस state में करती है?
e: Client: FIN_WAIT_1 (FIN bheja) → ACK mila → FIN_WAIT_2 (server ke FIN ka intezar) → phir TIME_WAIT. CLOSE_WAIT server-side hoti hai.
eh: Client: FIN_WAIT_1 (FIN भेजा) → ACK मिला → FIN_WAIT_2 (server के FIN का इंतज़ार) → फिर TIME_WAIT. CLOSE_WAIT server-side।
n: TIME_WAIT aakhri state hai (dono FIN ke baad); CLOSE_WAIT server ki hoti hai.
nh: TIME_WAIT अंत में; CLOSE_WAIT server की।

st: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer
q: In the TCP three-way handshake, let the three packets exchanged during connection establishment be P1, P2 and P3 in order. Which of the following is TRUE about the TCP header flags set in these packets?
qh: TCP three-way handshake में connection establishment के दौरान तीन packets P1, P2 और P3 (इसी क्रम में) बदले जाते हैं। इनमें सेट TCP header flags के बारे में क्या सही है?
o: P1: SYN; P2: SYN, ACK; P3: ACK
P1: SYN, ACK; P2: ACK; P3: FIN
P1: SYN; P2: ACK; P3: FIN
P1: ACK; P2: SYN; P3: ACK
oh: P1: SYN; P2: SYN, ACK; P3: ACK
P1: SYN, ACK; P2: ACK; P3: FIN
P1: SYN; P2: ACK; P3: FIN
P1: ACK; P2: SYN; P3: ACK
e: Classic handshake: P1 SYN (request), P2 SYN+ACK (server ka SYN + acknowledgement), P3 ACK (final) — flags ka yehi standard pattern hai (GATE 2025).
eh: क्लासिक handshake: P1 SYN, P2 SYN+ACK, P3 ACK — यही मानक पैटर्न (GATE 2025)।
n: FIN connection release ka flag hai; pehle packet par ACK kabhi nahi hota.
nh: FIN release का flag है; पहले packet पर ACK नहीं होता।

st: Section E — Session, Presentation & Application Layer
q: The World Wide Web (WWW) is:
qh: World Wide Web (WWW) क्या है?
o: a collection of linked information residing on computers connected by the Internet
oh: Internet से जुड़े कंप्यूटरों पर रखी link की गई सूचनाओं का संग्रह
e: WWW Internet par hosted linked documents (web pages) ka sangrah hai — Internet khud network infrastructure hai, WWW uspar chalne wali information service.
eh: WWW, Internet पर hosted linked documents का संग्रह है — Internet खुद network है, WWW उसकी information service।
n: Internet aur WWW ko same bolna sabse common galti hai; 'connection of computers' to network ki paribhasha hai.
nh: Internet और WWW को एक मानना सबसे आम गलती; 'connection' तो network है।

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: The minimum Hamming distance required to detect 2 bit errors is:
qh: 2 bit errors detect करने के लिए न्यूनतम Hamming distance चाहिए:
e: Detect e errors: d ≥ e+1 → 2+1 = 3.
eh: Detect: d ≥ e+1 → 3।
n: Correct 2 errors ke liye d ≥ 2e+1 = 5.
nh: Correct करने के लिए d ≥ 5।

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: In CRC, if the received codeword is divided by the generator and the remainder is zero, the receiver concludes:
qh: CRC में यदि remainder शून्य हो, तो receiver निष्कर्ष निकालता है:
e: Remainder 0 = error nahi mila (probability of undetected error kam).
eh: Remainder 0 = त्रुटि नहीं मिली।
n: Non-zero remainder = error.
nh: ग़ैर-शून्य remainder = त्रुटि।

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: In Selective Repeat ARQ, when a frame is corrupted, the sender retransmits:
qh: Selective Repeat ARQ में frame ख़राब होने पर दोबारा भेजता है:
e: Selective Repeat = sirf galat frame; Go-Back-N = uske aage ke sab.
eh: Selective Repeat = सिर्फ़ ख़राब; Go-Back-N = आगे के सब।
n: Go-Back-N sab dobara bhejta hai.
nh: Go-Back-N सब दोबारा।

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: Parity check can detect which type of errors?
qh: Parity check कौन-सी errors detect कर सकता है?
e: Single parity bit odd-bit errors detect karta hai; even ko miss.
eh: Parity bit विषम-bit errors detect करती है।
n: CRC burst errors ke liye behtar.
nh: CRC burst के लिए बेहतर।

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: Forward Error Correction (FEC) differs from ARQ in that:
qh: Forward Error Correction (FEC), ARQ से भिन्न है क्योंकि:
o: The receiver corrects errors without retransmission
oh: Receiver बिना retransmission errors ठीक करता है
यह सिर्फ़ LAN पर चलता है
e: FEC receiver par hi error correction karta hai — retransmission nahi.
eh: FEC receiver पर ही ठीक करता है।
n: ARQ mein retransmission hota hai.
nh: ARQ में retransmission।

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: In Go-Back-N ARQ, the receiver's window size is:
qh: Go-Back-N ARQ में receiver की window size होती है:
e: GBN receiver sirf agla expected frame accept karta hai (window=1); isliye out-of-order frame aaye to use phenk kar pura Go-Back-N retransmission hota hai.
eh: GBN में receiver सिर्फ अगला expected frame लेता है (window=1); out-of-order आने पर पूरा Go-Back-N।
n: Selective Repeat mein receiver ki window badi hoti hai — wahi out-of-order frames buffer karta hai.
nh: Selective Repeat में receiver window बड़ी — out-of-order buffer होते हैं।

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: Delaying an acknowledgement so that it can be attached to the next outgoing data frame in the reverse direction is called:
qh: Acknowledgement को रोककर विपरीत दिशा में जाने वाले अगले data frame के साथ जोड़ना कहलाता है:
e: Piggybacking: bidirectional link par ack ko data frame ke saath chipka do — alag ack frame bachta hai, bandwidth bachti hai.
eh: Piggybacking: bidirectional link पर ack को data frame के साथ जोड़ना — bandwidth बचती है।
n: Piggybacking mein ack ke liye timer hota hai, taaki der zyada na ho.
nh: Piggybacking में ack timer होता है, ताकि देर न हो।

st: Section A — Data Link Layer: Flow & Error Control
q: Network congestion occurs when:
qh: Network congestion तब होता है जब:
o: The offered traffic exceeds the network's capacity
Two hosts use the same port
A frame is corrupted by noise
oh: Offered traffic network की क्षमता से अधिक हो
दो hosts एक ही port प्रयोग करें
e: Congestion = queues bhar jaate hain kyunki demand capacity se zyada hai — delay/loss badhte hain. Isi ko sambhalne ke liye congestion control hota hai.
eh: Congestion = demand क्षमता से अधिक; queues भरती हैं, delay/loss बढ़ता है।
n: Flow control = receiver ki speed; congestion = network ki capacity.
nh: Flow control = receiver; congestion = network की क्षमता।

st: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer
q: In bit stuffing, after how many consecutive 1-bits is a 0 inserted?
qh: Bit stuffing में कितने लगातार 1-bits के बाद 0 जोड़ा जाता है?
e: Paanch 1s ke baad stuffed 0 (HDLC).
eh: पाँच 1s के बाद 0 (HDLC)।
n: 6 wale pattern mein flag hota hai.
nh: 6 वाला pattern flag है।

st: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer
q: CSMA/CD is used in:
qh: CSMA/CD प्रयोग होता है:
e: Wired Ethernet mein collision detect possible — CSMA/CD.
eh: Wired Ethernet में CSMA/CD।
n: Wireless mein CSMA/CA.
nh: Wireless में CSMA/CA।

st: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer
q: In which access method does a station wait for a free time slot before transmitting?
qh: किस access method में station भेजने से पहले ख़ाली time slot की प्रतीक्षा करता है?
e: Slotted ALOHA mein sirf slot ke shuruaat par bhej sakte hain.
eh: Slotted ALOHA में slot की शुरुआत पर।
n: Pure ALOHA jab mann kare.
nh: Pure ALOHA जब मन।

st: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer
q: Token passing is an example of which access method?
qh: Token passing किस access method का उदाहरण है?
e: Token = controlled access — collision nahi.
eh: Token = controlled access।
n: ALOHA/CSMA random hain.
nh: ALOHA/CSMA random।

st: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer
q: Which field of the Ethernet frame is used for error detection?
qh: Ethernet frame का कौन-सा field error detection के लिए है?
e: FCS (Frame Check Sequence) CRC carry karta hai.
eh: FCS CRC ले जाता है।
n: Preamble synchronisation ke liye.
nh: Preamble synchronisation के लिए।

st: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer
q: Gigabit Ethernet over optical fiber is defined by which IEEE standard?
qh: Optical fiber पर Gigabit Ethernet किस IEEE standard में परिभाषित है?
e: 802.3z = 1000BASE-X (fiber/STP); 802.3ab = 1000BASE-T (UTP); 802.3u = Fast Ethernet (100 Mbps); 802.3ae = 10 Gbps Ethernet.
eh: 802.3z = 1000BASE-X (fiber); 802.3ab = 1000BASE-T (UTP); 802.3u = Fast Ethernet; 802.3ae = 10 GbE।
n: Suffix -T = twisted pair, -X = fiber — standard numbers yaad rakho.
nh: -T = twisted pair, -X = fiber।

st: Section B — Data Link Layer: Framing & MAC Sub-layer
q: CSMA/CD (collision detection) can be used only when the link operates in:
qh: CSMA/CD (collision detection) तभी प्रयोग हो सकता है जब link चलती हो:
e: Collision tabhi detect hoti hai jab ek shared medium par dono taraf se traffic aa sake (half-duplex). Full-duplex (alag pairs) mein collisions hote hi nahi — modern Ethernet mein CSMA/CD off hota hai. Pattern: SSC CGL/IBPS + CCNA.
eh: Collision shared medium (half-duplex) पर ही होती है। Full-duplex में CSMA/CD बंद। Pattern: SSC CGL + CCNA।
n: Full-duplex = collision-free, isliye minimum frame size ka constraint bhi nahi.
nh: Full-duplex = collision-free।

st: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
q: Why is the TTL field decremented at each router?
qh: हर router पर TTL field क्यों घटाया जाता है?
o: To prevent infinite looping of packets
oh: Packets के अनंत चक्कर रोकने के लिए
e: TTL khatam = packet drop (loop prevention).
eh: TTL ख़त्म = packet drop (loop prevention)।
n: Encryption/compression ka alag kaam.
nh: अलग काम।

st: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
q: An IP datagram of 1000 bytes (20-byte header) is fragmented on a link with MTU 200 bytes. The number of data bytes in the FIRST fragment is:
qh: 1000 bytes का datagram (20-byte header), MTU 200 link पर टूटा। पहले fragment में data bytes होंगे:
e: MTU 200 = 20 header + 180 data; offset 8 ke multiple mein (180 = 22.5×8 → 176 practical; par standard question mein 180 liya jaata hai — GATE style options 180 hi hote hain).
eh: MTU 200 − 20 = 180 data पहले fragment में।
n: 200 poora frame hai.
nh: 200 पूरा frame है।

st: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
q: Which routing protocol uses hop count as its metric with a maximum of 15?
qh: कौन-सा routing protocol hop count metric रखता है (अधिकतम 15)?
e: RIP: hop count, max 15 (16 = infinity).
eh: RIP: hop count, अधिकतम 15।
n: OSPF cost use karta hai.
nh: OSPF cost।

st: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
q: Ping utility uses which ICMP messages?
qh: Ping utility किस ICMP messages का प्रयोग करती है?
e: Ping = Echo Request (type 8) + Echo Reply (type 0).
eh: Ping = Echo Request + Echo Reply।
n: Time exceeded traceroute mein.
nh: Time exceeded traceroute में।

st: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
q: BGP is used for:
qh: BGP प्रयोग होता है:
oh: एक LAN के अंदर routing के लिए
Autonomous systems के बीच routing के लिए
e: BGP = inter-AS routing (Internet backbone).
eh: BGP = inter-AS routing।
n: RIP/OSPF intra-AS.
nh: RIP/OSPF intra-AS।

st: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
q: Congestion control in the network layer is mainly concerned with:
qh: Network layer का congestion control मुख्यतः संबंधित है:
o: Too many packets in the network
oh: Network में बहुत अधिक packets से
e: Congestion = network ke andar traffic overload; flow control = slow receiver.
eh: Congestion = network overload; flow control = धीमा receiver।
n: Slow receiver flow control ki samasya hai.
nh: धीमा receiver = flow control।

st: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
q: OSPF exchanges routing information directly over IP using IP protocol number:
qh: OSPF routing information IP पर सीधे भेजता है — IP protocol number होता है:
e: OSPF = IP protocol 89 (na TCP na UDP); BGP = TCP 179; RIP = UDP 520; protocol 6 = TCP.
eh: OSPF = IP protocol 89 (न TCP न UDP); BGP = TCP 179; RIP = UDP 520।
n: Ye teen (89/179/520) worldwide exams ke favourite hain.
nh: ये तीनों (89/179/520) exams के प्रिय प्रश्न हैं।

st: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
q: BGP, the protocol that routes between autonomous systems on the Internet, uses:
qh: BGP — जो Internet पर autonomous systems के बीच routing करता है — प्रयोग करता है:
e: BGP = TCP port 179 — reliable transport chahiye Internet-scale routing ke liye.
eh: BGP = TCP port 179 — Internet-scale routing के लिए reliable transport।
n: 89 = OSPF; 520 = RIP; 23 = Telnet.
nh: 89 = OSPF; 520 = RIP; 23 = Telnet।

st: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
q: The RIP routing protocol uses which transport protocol and port number?
qh: RIP routing protocol कौन-सा transport protocol और port number प्रयोग करता है?
e: RIP = UDP 520 (chhote periodic updates, reliable transport ki zaroorat nahi).
eh: RIP = UDP 520 (छोटे periodic updates)।
n: 161 = SNMP; TCP 89 kuch nahi (OSPF TCP par nahi chalta).
nh: 161 = SNMP; TCP 89 — कुछ नहीं (OSPF TCP पर नहीं चलता)।

st: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
q: A router receives a datagram whose TTL becomes 0 after it decrements the field. The router will:
qh: एक router को datagram मिला जिसका TTL घटाने पर 0 हो गया। router क्या करेगा?
o: Discard the datagram and send an ICMP Time Exceeded message to the source
Send it back to the previous router
oh: Datagram नष्ट करके source को ICMP Time Exceeded भेजेगा
e: TTL = routing loops rokne ke liye; har hop par −1, zero hote hi packet gira kar ICMP Time Exceeded (type 11) source ko jaata hai — traceroute isi par chalta hai. Pattern: GATE + RPSC Programmer dono ka favourite.
eh: TTL हर hop पर −1; 0 होते ही packet गिरकर ICMP Time Exceeded (type 11) जाता है — traceroute इसी पर। Pattern: GATE + RPSC Programmer।
n: traceroute = TTL 1, 2, 3... karke Time Exceeded ke source routers ka pata.
nh: traceroute = TTL 1,2,3... से Time Exceeded से routers का पता।

st: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
q: In OSPF, on a multiaccess network the Designated Router (DR) is the router with:
qh: OSPF में multiaccess network पर Designated Router (DR) होता है वह router जिसके पास:
o: The highest OSPF interface priority (tie → highest router ID)
oh: सबसे अधिक OSPF interface priority (बराबरी पर → सबसे बड़ा router ID)
e: DR election: pehle highest priority (default 1; 0 = kabhi DR nahi), tie par highest router ID. DR adjacency kam karke flooding reduce karta hai. Pattern: CCNA + RPSC ACP/Programmer level.
eh: DR election: सर्वोच्च priority (default 1), बराबरी पर सबसे बड़ा router ID। Pattern: CCNA + RPSC ACP/Programmer।
n: OSPF mein 2-way state ke baad DR/BDR election hoti hai.
nh: OSPF में 2-way के बाद DR/BDR election।

st: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
q: Two OSPF routers are stuck in the EXSTART/EXCHANGE neighbour state. The most likely cause is:
qh: दो OSPF routers EXSTART/EXCHANGE neighbour state में अटके हैं। सबसे संभावित कारण है:
o: An MTU mismatch on the connecting interfaces
oh: जोड़ने वाले interfaces पर MTU का अंतर
e: Database description (DBD) exchange mein MTU mismatch ke routers EXSTART/EXCHANGE se aage nahi badhte. Process IDs locally significant hote hain — match karne ki zaroorat nahi. Pattern: CCNA troubleshooting + RPSC ACP.
eh: MTU mismatch से routers EXSTART/EXCHANGE में अटकते हैं। Process IDs locally significant होते हैं। Pattern: CCNA + RPSC ACP।
n: OSPF states: Down → Init → 2-Way → ExStart → Exchange → Loading → Full.
nh: OSPF states: Down → Init → 2-Way → ExStart → Exchange → Loading → Full।

st: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
q: The administrative distance of a static route, an EIGRP route and an OSPF route are respectively:
qh: Static route, EIGRP route और OSPF route का administrative distance क्रमशः होता है:
e: AD = route ki 'trustworthiness' (kam = zyada trusted): connected 0, static 1, EIGRP 90, OSPF 110, RIP 120. Pattern: CCNA 200-301 + RPSC ACP/DD.
eh: AD (कम = अधिक trusted): connected 0, static 1, EIGRP 90, OSPF 110, RIP 120। Pattern: CCNA + RPSC ACP/DD।
n: AD aur metric alag cheez hain — AD protocols ko compare karti hai.
nh: AD और metric अलग हैं — AD protocols की तुलना करती है।

st: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
q: If the Protocol field of an IPv4 header is 17, the transport-layer protocol carried in the datagram is:
qh: यदि IPv4 header का Protocol field 17 हो, तो datagram में लिया गया transport-layer protocol है:
e: Protocol numbers: 1 = ICMP, 2 = IGMP, 6 = TCP, 17 = UDP, 89 = OSPF. Ye field fragmentation ke saath-saath next-header ki pehchaan deta hai.
eh: Protocol numbers: 1=ICMP, 2=IGMP, 6=TCP, 17=UDP, 89=OSPF।
n: 6 TCP, 17 UDP — dono sabse zyada puche jaate hain.
nh: 6 TCP, 17 UDP — सबसे अधिक पूछे जाते हैं।

st: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
q: In IPv4 fragmentation, the LAST fragment has the More Fragments (MF) flag set to:
qh: IPv4 fragmentation में, अंतिम fragment का More Fragments (MF) flag होता है:
o: The same as the first fragment
e: MF = 1 matlab 'aur fragments aane hain'; aakhri fragment par MF = 0. Har fragment ka offset alag hota hai.
eh: MF=1 = 'और fragments आने हैं'; अंतिम पर MF=0।
n: Dono fields (MF flag + offset) milkar reassembly karte hain.
nh: MF flag + offset मिलकर reassembly करते हैं।

st: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
q: The Fragment Offset field in the IPv4 header is used to:
qh: IPv4 header का Fragment Offset field प्रयोग होता है:
o: Place the fragment at its correct position in the original datagram during reassembly
Count the total number of fragments
oh: Reassembly के दौरान fragment को मूल datagram में सही स्थान पर रखने के लिए
Fragment payloads encrypt करने के लिए
Fragment का जीवन-काल तय करने के लिए
e: Offset (8-byte units mein) batata hai fragment original datagram mein kahan baitha hai — destination sirf offset se hi sahi order bana sakta hai.

st: Section C — Network Layer: IP, ICMP, ARP & Routing Protocols
q: RSVP (Resource ReSerVation Protocol) is used by hosts to:
qh: RSVP (Resource ReSerVation Protocol) का उपयोग hosts करते हैं:
o: Request reservation of network resources (bandwidth) along a path for QoS flows
oh: QoS flows के लिए रास्ते में network संसाधन (bandwidth) आरक्षित करने के अनुरोध हेतु
स्वतः IP addresses देने के लिए
Domain names हल करने के लिए
Routers के बीच routing tables बाँटने के लिए
e: RSVP = signalling protocol jo routers se kehta hai ki flow ke liye resources reserve karo (IntServ/QoS). IP assignment = DHCP; routing = OSPF/BGP; names = DNS.
eh: RSVP = routers से संसाधन आरक्षित करने का संकेत (QoS)। IP=DHCP; routing=OSPF/BGP; names=DNS।
n: RSVP 'reservation' ka protocol hai — circuit-switching jaisi guarantee nahi, bas soft-state reservations.
nh: RSVP = soft-state reservations; पूरी guarantee नहीं।

eh: 2×MSL के इंतज़ार से पुराने duplicates खत्म होते हैं (RFC 793)।

Source port, destination port, window, checksum
oh: Source port, destination port, length, checksum
Source port, destination port, sequence number, ack number
Source port, destination port, window, checksum
e: UDP header = 4 fields × 2 bytes = 8 bytes; sequence/ack/window — sab TCP ke fields hain.
eh: UDP header = 4 fields × 2 bytes = 8; sequence/ack/window — TCP के fields।
n: UDP ka mantra: 'chhota header, koi guarantee nahi'.
nh: UDP: 'छोटा header, कोई guarantee नहीं'।

st: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
q: TCP provides a byte-stream service. This means that:
qh: TCP byte-stream service देता है — इसका अर्थ है कि:
o: Message boundaries are NOT preserved — a record may be split across segments or two records merged into one
Each send() call arrives as one segment
The receiver delivers bytes in the order they were received, even if reordered on the way
oh: Message boundaries नहीं बनतीं — एक record कई segments में बँट सकता है या दो records एक में मिल सकते हैं
हर send() एक segment के रूप में पहुँचता है
Bytes 512-byte के तय blocks में आते हैं
Receiver bytes उसी क्रम में देता है जिसमें प्राप्त हुए, भले रास्ते में बदले हों
e: TCP sirf reliable ordered BYTE stream deta hai — application ki record boundaries TCP ki zimmedari nahi (isliye application khud length/delimiter bhejti hai). Pattern: RPSC Programmer/ACP/DD + GATE.
eh: TCP सिर्फ विश्वसनीय क्रमबद्ध BYTE stream देता है — record boundaries की ज़िम्मेदारी नहीं। Pattern: RPSC Programmer/ACP/DD।
n: UDP message-oriented hai — wahan ek datagram = ek message.
nh: UDP message-oriented है — एक datagram = एक message।

st: Section D — Transport Layer: TCP/UDP, Ports & Sockets
q: The TCP Maximum Segment Size (MSS) is typically the path MTU minus ______ bytes of headers:
qh: TCP Maximum Segment Size (MSS) सामान्यतः path MTU में से ______ bytes के headers घटाने पर मिलती है:
e: MSS = MTU − (20-byte IP header + 20-byte TCP header) = MTU − 40. Ethernet par 1500 − 40 = 1460 bytes. Pattern: RPSC Programmer/ACP/DD + GATE.
eh: MSS = MTU − (20 IP + 20 TCP) = MTU − 40; Ethernet पर 1460 bytes। Pattern: RPSC Programmer/ACP/DD।
n: MSS sirf TCP data ka size hai — headers alag.
nh: MSS सिर्फ TCP data का size है।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: The term 'CIA triad' in information security refers to:
qh: Information security में 'CIA triad' शब्द किसे कहते हैं?
e: The CIA triad = Confidentiality (only authorised access), Integrity (no unauthorised change), Availability (accessible when needed) — the three core security goals.
eh: CIA triad = Confidentiality (केवल authorised access), Integrity (बिना authorisation बदलाव नहीं), Availability (ज़रूरत पर उपलब्ध) — तीन मूल security goals।
n: CIA = Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability. AAA (authentication, authorisation, accounting) is a separate trio.
nh: CIA = Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability। AAA (authentication, authorisation, accounting) अलग trio है।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: The goal of 'Integrity' ensures that:
qh: 'Integrity' का लक्ष्य सुनिश्चित करता है कि:
o: Data can be accessed only by authorised users
Data is accurate and has not been modified
Data is always available when needed
Unauthorised users cannot enter the system
oh: Data can be accessed only by authorised users
Data is accurate and has not been modified
Data is always available when needed
Unauthorised users cannot enter the system
e: Integrity means data remains accurate and unaltered except by authorised people — checksums/digital signatures protect it.
eh: Integrity का अर्थ है data सही और अपरिवर्तित रहे (केवल authorised लोग ही बदलें) — इसे checksums/digital signatures सुरक्षित रखते हैं।
n: Goal map: Confidentiality = authorised access only. Integrity = no unauthorised change. Availability = always accessible.
nh: Goal map: Confidentiality = केवल authorised access। Integrity = बिना authorisation बदलाव नहीं। Availability = हमेशा उपलब्ध।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: Which of the following is NOT a goal of network security?
qh: निम्न में से कौन-सा network security का लक्ष्य नहीं है?
e: Redundancy (duplicate links/equipment) improves fault tolerance — it is a reliability technique, not a security goal.
eh: Redundancy (duplicate links/equipment) fault tolerance बढ़ाती है — यह reliability तकनीक है, security लक्ष्य नहीं।
n: Security goals = CIA. Reliability goals = redundancy, fault tolerance, recovery.
nh: Security goals = CIA। Reliability goals = redundancy, fault tolerance, recovery।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: A modification attack violates which security goal?
qh: Modification attack कौन-से security लक्ष्य का उल्लंघन करता है?
e: A modification attack changes data in transit — that breaks INTEGRITY (data is no longer accurate/unaltered).
eh: Modification attack रास्ते में data बदल देता है — यह INTEGRITY तोड़ता है (data अब सही/अपरिवर्तित नहीं)।
n: Attack→goal: Eavesdropping/Interception → Confidentiality. Modification → Integrity. DoS/Interruption → Availability. Spoofing → Authentication.
nh: Attack→goal: Eavesdropping/Interception → Confidentiality। Modification → Integrity। DoS/Interruption → Availability। Spoofing → Authentication।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: Which of the following attacks violates confidentiality?
qh: निम्न में से कौन-सा attack confidentiality का उल्लंघन करता है?
e: Interception (eavesdropping) lets an unauthorised party READ the data — breaking confidentiality.
eh: Interception (eavesdropping) से unauthorised पक्ष data पढ़ लेता है — confidentiality टूटती है।
n: Attack map: Interception→Confidentiality, Modification→Integrity, Fabrication→Authenticity, Interruption→Availability.
nh: Attack map: Interception→Confidentiality, Modification→Integrity, Fabrication→Authenticity, Interruption→Availability।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: A Denial of Service (DoS) attack violates which goal?
qh: Denial of Service (DoS) attack कौन-से लक्ष्य का उल्लंघन करता है?
e: A DoS attack floods a server/network so legitimate users cannot access the service — breaking AVAILABILITY.
eh: DoS attack server/network को flood करके legitimate users को service से रोकता है — Availability टूटती है।
n: DoS = Availability attack. DDoS = distributed DoS. Smurf/ SYN-flood = DoS variants.
nh: DoS = Availability attack। DDoS = distributed DoS। Smurf/ SYN-flood = DoS variants।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: A spoofing attack targets which security aspect?
qh: Spoofing attack किस security पहलू को लक्षित करता है?
e: Spoofing pretends to be someone else (fake IP/MAC/email id) — it attacks AUTHENTICATION (who you claim to be).
eh: Spoofing किसी और का रूप धारण करता है (fake IP/MAC/email id) — यह AUTHENTICATION पर हमला है (आप कौन हैं)।
n: Spoofing/impersonation → Authentication. Phishing → steals credentials (auth). Sniffing → Confidentiality.
nh: Spoofing/impersonation → Authentication। Phishing → credentials चुराता है (auth)। Sniffing → Confidentiality।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: Which of the following is an ACTIVE attack?
qh: निम्न में से कौन-सा ACTIVE attack है?
e: Modification is an active attack — the attacker CHANGES the data stream; interception/traffic analysis/eavesdropping are passive (they only observe).
eh: Modification एक active attack है — attacker data stream बदलता है; interception/traffic analysis/eavesdropping passive हैं (केवल देखते हैं)।
n: Passive = observe only (eavesdropping, traffic analysis). Active = change/disrupt (modification, fabrication, interruption/DoS).
nh: Passive = केवल देखना (eavesdropping, traffic analysis)। Active = बदलना/बाधा (modification, fabrication, interruption/DoS)।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: The primary difference between active and passive attacks is:
qh: Active और passive attacks के बीच मुख्य अंतर क्या है?
o: Active attacks change data; passive attacks do not
oh: Active attacks change data; passive attacks do not
e: Active attacks intercept AND modify/disrupt the communication; passive attacks only eavesdrop without changing anything.
eh: Active attacks संचार को intercept करके बदलते/बाधित करते हैं; passive attacks केवल सुनते हैं, कुछ नहीं बदलते।
n: Active: modification, fabrication, interruption. Passive: eavesdropping, traffic analysis. Exam one-liner: 'change vs observe'.
nh: Active: modification, fabrication, interruption। Passive: eavesdropping, traffic analysis। Exam one-liner: 'change बनाम observe'।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: In the virus life cycle, which phase actually performs the malicious activity?
qh: Virus life cycle में कौन-सा phase वास्तव में malicious activity करता है?
e: The execution phase runs the payload — the actual damage (deleting files, corrupting data).
eh: Execution phase payload चलाता है — वास्तविक नुकसान (files delete करना, data खराब करना)।
n: Virus phases: Dormant (idle) → Propagation (copy) → Triggering (condition met) → Execution (payload runs).
nh: Virus phases: Dormant (idle) → Propagation (copy) → Triggering (condition met) → Execution (payload runs)।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: Which backup medium provides Write-Once-Read-Many (WORM) functionality?
qh: कौन-सा backup medium Write-Once-Read-Many (WORM) functionality देता है?
e: CD-R/DVD-R optical disks are WORM — data is written once and cannot be altered, making them tamper-proof archives.
eh: CD-R/DVD-R optical disks WORM हैं — data एक बार लिखा जाता है और बदला नहीं जा सकता, इसलिए ये tamper-proof archives हैं।
n: WORM = optical write-once media (CD-R/DVD-R/BD-R). Rewritable: HDD, tape (LTO), flash, CD-RW.
nh: WORM = optical write-once media (CD-R/DVD-R/BD-R)। Rewritable: HDD, tape (LTO), flash, CD-RW।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: Which attack becomes possible if the SAME key is reused many times in symmetric encryption?
qh: यदि symmetric encryption में एक ही key कई बार उपयोग हो, तो कौन-सा attack संभव हो जाता है?
e: With many ciphertexts under one key, an attacker can compare them with known plaintexts and deduce the key — a known-plaintext (or frequency-analysis) attack.
eh: एक key के अंतर्गत अनेक ciphertexts होने पर attacker उन्हें known plaintexts से मिलाकर key निकाल सकता है — known-plaintext (या frequency-analysis) attack।
n: One-time pads are safe ONLY with a fresh key per message. Reuse → pattern analysis. Exam favourite link: key reuse → known-plaintext.
nh: One-time pads केवल हर message पर नई key से सुरक्षित हैं। Reuse → pattern analysis। Exam favourite link: key reuse → known-plaintext।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: Which of the following tools is mainly used for password cracking?
qh: निम्न में से कौन-सा tool मुख्यतः password cracking के लिए उपयोग होता है?
e: Cain and Abel is a well-known password-recovery/cracking tool (sniffing, dictionary & brute-force attacks).
eh: Cain and Abel एक प्रसिद्ध password-recovery/cracking tool है (sniffing, dictionary और brute-force attacks)।
n: Security tools: Wireshark = packet analyser, Nmap = port scanner, Cain&Abel = password cracker, Angry IP Scanner = IP scanner, Snort = IDS.
nh: Security tools: Wireshark = packet analyser, Nmap = port scanner, Cain&Abel = password cracker, Angry IP Scanner = IP scanner, Snort = IDS।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: Which port and IP address scanner is most famous among users?
qh: Users के बीच सबसे प्रसिद्ध port और IP address scanner कौन-सा है?
e: Angry IP Scanner is the popular free tool for scanning IP ranges and open ports.
eh: Angry IP Scanner IP ranges और open ports scan करने वाला लोकप्रिय free tool है।
n: Cain&Abel = password cracking; Angry IP = IP/port scan; Snort = IDS; Ettercap = sniffing/ARP spoofing.
nh: Cain&Abel = password cracking; Angry IP = IP/port scan; Snort = IDS; Ettercap = sniffing/ARP spoofing।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: Match the attacks with their descriptions: (a) Phishing  (b) DoS Attack  (c) Man-in-the-Middle  (d) Spoofing — (i) Flooding network traffic  (ii) Stealing user credentials  (iii) Intercepting communication  (iv) Impersonation attack
qh: हमलों को उनके विवरण से मिलाइए: (a) Phishing  (b) DoS Attack  (c) Man-in-the-Middle  (d) Spoofing — (i) नेटवर्क ट्रैफ़िक भरना  (ii) यूज़र जानकारी चुराना  (iii) संचार में हस्तक्षेप  (iv) पहचान की नकल
e: Phishing steals credentials (ii), DoS floods traffic (i), MitM intercepts communication (iii), Spoofing is impersonation (iv).
eh: Phishing credentials चुराता है (ii), DoS traffic flood करता है (i), MitM संचार intercept करता है (iii), Spoofing impersonation है (iv)।
n: Attack one-liners: Phishing=fake emails/sites, DoS=flood, MitM=middle interception, Spoofing=fake identity.
nh: Attack one-liners: Phishing=fake emails/sites, DoS=flood, MitM=middle interception, Spoofing=fake identity।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: A ______ does not perform any destructive action directly; it only consumes system resources to bring the system down.
qh: एक ______ सीधे कोई विनाशकारी काम नहीं करता; वह सिस्टम को गिराने के लिए सिर्फ system resources खाता है.
e: A worm spreads through the network making copies of itself and eats bandwidth/memory — it does not directly destroy data.
eh: Worm अपनी प्रतियाँ बनाकर network में फैलता है और bandwidth/memory खा जाता है — सीधा डेटा नष्ट नहीं करता.
n: HTET 2024 official key (b). फ़र्क: Virus = फ़ाइल में घुसता; Worm = खुद फैलता; Trojan = छिपकर; Spyware = जासूसी.
nh: HTET 2024 official key (b). फ़र्क: Virus = फ़ाइल में घुसता; Worm = खुद फैलता; Trojan = छिपकर; Spyware = जासूसी.

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: 'Junk email' is also known as:
qh: 'Junk email' को और क्या कहते हैं?
e: Unwanted bulk email = Spam. It fills the inbox and is often a vehicle for fraud.
eh: अवांछित भारी-भरकम email = Spam. यह inbox भर देती है और कई बार धोखाधड़ी का ज़रिया होती है.
n: Spam = junk mail; Spoof = पहचान छिपाना; Sniffer = चोरी से सुनना.
nh: Spam = junk mail; Spoof = पहचान छिपाना; Sniffer = चोरी से सुनना.

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: The text that gets transformed using a cipher algorithm is called:
qh: Cipher algorithm से जिस text को बदला जाता है उसे क्या कहते हैं?
e: The INPUT to the cipher is the plaintext; after transformation it becomes ciphertext.
eh: Cipher का INPUT plaintext है; बदलने के बाद वह ciphertext बनता है।
n: Cryptography flow: Plain text --(cipher + key)--> Ciphertext --(decipher + key)--> Plain text.
nh: Cryptography flow: Plain text --(cipher + key)--> Ciphertext --(decipher + key)--> Plain text।

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: Which statement about plaintext, ciphertext and key is MOST accurate?
qh: Plaintext, ciphertext और key के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सबसे सही है?
o: Plaintext is generated after decryption using a public key
Ciphertext is the original readable message
Plaintext is transformed into ciphertext using an algorithm and a key
Ciphertext and plaintext are always of the same length
oh: Plaintext is generated after decryption using a public key
Ciphertext is the original readable message
Plaintext is transformed into ciphertext using an algorithm and a key
Ciphertext and plaintext are always of the same length
e: Encryption transforms plaintext into ciphertext using a cipher algorithm together with a key — this is the precise description.
eh: Encryption एक cipher algorithm और key के साथ plaintext को ciphertext में बदलता है — यही सटीक विवरण है।
n: Remember the 3 objects: plaintext (readable), ciphertext (scrambled), key (secret parameter). Encryption = f(plaintext, key).
nh: 3 objects याद रखें: plaintext (पढ़ने योग्य), ciphertext (scrambled), key (गुप्त parameter)। Encryption = f(plaintext, key)।

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: Which of the following uses the SAME key for encryption and decryption?
qh: निम्न में से कौन-सा encryption और decryption के लिए एक ही key उपयोग करता है?
e: Symmetric cryptography uses one shared secret key for both encryption and decryption (AES, DES, Blowfish).
eh: Symmetric cryptography encryption और decryption दोनों के लिए एक ही shared secret key उपयोग करता है (AES, DES, Blowfish)।
n: Symmetric = 1 key (fast). Asymmetric = key pair (public+private, slow). Hash = one-way digest. Signature = private-sign/public-verify.
nh: Symmetric = 1 key (तेज़)। Asymmetric = key pair (public+private, धीमा)। Hash = one-way digest। Signature = private-sign/public-verify।

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: Which of the following uses a PAIR of keys (public and private)?
qh: निम्न में से कौन-सा keys की एक जोड़ी (public और private) उपयोग करता है?
e: Asymmetric (public-key) cryptography uses a mathematically linked key pair — public key to encrypt, private key to decrypt (RSA, ECC, Diffie-Hellman).
eh: Asymmetric (public-key) cryptography गणितीय रूप से जुड़ी key pair उपयोग करता है — encrypt के लिए public key, decrypt के लिए private key (RSA, ECC, Diffie-Hellman)।
n: Public-key examples: RSA, Diffie-Hellman, ECC, DSA. Symmetric: DES, 3DES, AES, Blowfish, RC4.
nh: Public-key examples: RSA, Diffie-Hellman, ECC, DSA। Symmetric: DES, 3DES, AES, Blowfish, RC4।

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: Which is FASTER in encryption and decryption?
qh: Encryption और decryption में कौन-सा तेज़ है?
e: Symmetric ciphers (AES/DES) are orders of magnitude faster than asymmetric ones (RSA) — that's why bulk data uses symmetric encryption.
eh: Symmetric ciphers (AES/DES), asymmetric (RSA) से कई गुना तेज़ होते हैं — इसीलिए bulk data में symmetric encryption होती है।
n: Speed: Symmetric >> Asymmetric. Hybrid systems (TLS/PGP) use asymmetric KEYS to exchange a symmetric SESSION key.
nh: Speed: Symmetric >> Asymmetric। Hybrid systems (TLS/PGP) asymmetric KEYS से symmetric SESSION key का आदान-प्रदान करती हैं।

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: What is the main disadvantage of symmetric key encryption?
qh: Symmetric key encryption की मुख्य कमी क्या है?
e: Both sides must share the SAME secret key securely — key distribution over an insecure channel is the classic problem.
eh: दोनों पक्षों को एक ही secret key सुरक्षित रूप से साझा करनी होती है — insecure channel पर key distribution ही classic समस्या है।
n: Symmetric weakness = key distribution (n users → n(n-1)/2 keys). Asymmetric weakness = slow + key authenticity (certificates).
nh: Symmetric कमज़ोरी = key distribution (n users → n(n-1)/2 keys)। Asymmetric कमज़ोरी = धीमा + key authenticity (certificates)।

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: Public key is used to:
qh: Public key का उपयोग किसके लिए होता है?
e: In public-key cryptography anyone can use the recipient's PUBLIC key to encrypt; only the recipient's PRIVATE key can decrypt.
eh: Public-key cryptography में कोई भी प्राप्तकर्ता की PUBLIC key से encrypt कर सकता है; केवल प्राप्तकर्ता की PRIVATE key से decrypt होता है।
n: Encrypt with public → decrypt with private. SIGN with private → verify with public. Exam asks both directions!
nh: Encrypt public से → decrypt private से। SIGN private से → verify public से। Exam दोनों दिशाएँ पूछता है!

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: In public-key cryptography, a message encrypted with the public key can only be decrypted by:
qh: Public-key cryptography में public key से encrypt किया संदेश केवल किसके द्वारा decrypt हो सकता है?
o: The private key corresponding to that public key
oh: The private key corresponding to that public key
e: Only the matching private key of the key pair can decrypt what the public key encrypted.
eh: केवल उस key pair की मेल खाती private key ही public key से encrypt किए गए संदेश को decrypt कर सकती है।
n: Public/private are mathematically paired — like a lock (public) and its only key (private).
nh: Public/private गणितीय रूप से जुड़े हैं — एक ताला (public) और उसकी एकमात्र चाबी (private) की तरह।

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: Which statement about symmetric and asymmetric cryptography is TRUE?
qh: Symmetric और asymmetric cryptography के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सही है?
o: Asymmetric cryptography is faster than symmetric
Symmetric cryptography requires secure key exchange
oh: Asymmetric cryptography is faster than symmetric
Symmetric cryptography requires secure key exchange
e: Symmetric cryptography requires a SECURE key exchange between the parties — that is its defining practical challenge.
eh: Symmetric cryptography के लिए पक्षों के बीच सुरक्षित key exchange आवश्यक है — यही इसकी मुख्य व्यावहारिक चुनौती है।
n: True: symmetric needs secure key exchange. False: symmetric does not inherently authenticate; asymmetric is slower; symmetric uses ONE key.
nh: सही: symmetric को secure key exchange चाहिए। गलत: symmetric स्वयं authentication नहीं देता; asymmetric धीमा; symmetric एक key उपयोग करता है।

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: Data Encryption Standard (DES) is a:
qh: Data Encryption Standard (DES) क्या है?
e: DES encrypts data in 64-bit blocks using a 56-bit key — a classic symmetric BLOCK cipher.
eh: DES data को 64-bit blocks में 56-bit key से encrypt करता है — एक classic symmetric BLOCK cipher।
n: DES = 64-bit block, 56-bit key (symmetric). AES = 128-bit block. RC4 = stream cipher.
nh: DES = 64-bit block, 56-bit key (symmetric)। AES = 128-bit block। RC4 = stream cipher।

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: What is the key length of AES-256 encryption?
qh: AES-256 encryption की key length कितनी है?
e: AES-256 uses a 256-bit key (the number in the name is the key length).
eh: AES-256 में 256-bit key उपयोग होती है (नाम में संख्या key length है)।
n: AES variants: AES-128, AES-192, AES-256 (key sizes). Block size is always 128 bits.
nh: AES variants: AES-128, AES-192, AES-256 (key sizes)। Block size हमेशा 128 bits।

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: Which cipher method encrypts one bit or byte at a time?
qh: कौन-सी cipher method एक बार में एक bit या byte encrypt करती है?
e: A stream cipher encrypts the data one bit (or byte) at a time as a continuous stream (e.g., RC4).
eh: Stream cipher data को एक समय में एक bit (या byte) encrypt करती है, एक निरंतर धारा के रूप में (जैसे RC4)।
n: Stream = 1 bit/byte at a time (RC4, A5/1). Block = fixed-size blocks (DES/AES). Substitution/Transposition = classical techniques.
nh: Stream = 1 bit/byte at a time (RC4, A5/1)। Block = fixed-size blocks (DES/AES)। Substitution/Transposition = classical techniques।

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: Which of the following statements is FALSE?
qh: निम्न में से कौन-सा कथन गलत है?
o: Diffie-Hellman is used for key exchange
oh: Diffie-Hellman is used for key exchange
e: RSA is an ASYMMETRIC (public-key) cipher — the statement 'RSA is symmetric' is false.
eh: RSA एक ASYMMETRIC (public-key) cipher है — 'RSA symmetric है' कथन गलत है।
n: False-statement MCQs: check each. AES=block ✓, RSA=asymmetric ✗, DH=key exchange ✓, DES=symmetric ✓.
nh: False-statement MCQs: हर एक जाँचें। AES=block ✓, RSA=asymmetric ✗, DH=key exchange ✓, DES=symmetric ✓।

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: In the digital signature technique, when the whole message is signed using an asymmetric key, the receiver uses:
qh: Digital signature technique में, जब पूरा संदेश asymmetric key से sign होता है, तो प्राप्तकर्ता उपयोग करता है:
o: Her or his own public key
Her or his own private key
oh: Her or his own public key
Her or his own private key
e: The sender signs with their PRIVATE key; the receiver verifies the signature using the SENDER'S PUBLIC key.
eh: भेजने वाला अपनी PRIVATE key से sign करता है; प्राप्तकर्ता भेजने वाले की PUBLIC key से signature सत्यापित करता है।
n: Signature direction: SIGN with private → VERIFY with public. Encryption direction: ENCRYPT with public → DECRYPT with private.
nh: Signature दिशा: private से SIGN → public से VERIFY। Encryption दिशा: public से ENCRYPT → private से DECRYPT।

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: The Caesar Cipher is an example of which cryptographic technique?
qh: Caesar Cipher किस cryptographic technique का उदाहरण है?
e: The Caesar cipher replaces each letter by another a fixed number of places down the alphabet — a classical SUBSTITUTION cipher.
eh: Caesar cipher में हर अक्षर को वर्णमाला में कुछ स्थान आगे वाले अक्षर से बदला जाता है — एक classical SUBSTITUTION cipher।
n: Classical types: Substitution (Caesar, Playfair) = replace; Transposition (Rail fence) = rearrange.
nh: Classical types: Substitution (Caesar, Playfair) = replace; Transposition (Rail fence) = rearrange।

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: The process of detecting hidden data inside a file is known as:
qh: किसी file के भीतर छिपे data का पता लगाने की प्रक्रिया को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Steganalysis is the art of detecting/extracting data hidden by steganography.
eh: Steganalysis, steganography से छिपाए गए data का पता लगाने/निकालने की कला है।
n: Steganography = HIDING data (cover file). Steganalysis = DETECTING it. Cryptography = scrambling it.
nh: Steganography = data छिपाना (cover file)। Steganalysis = पता लगाना। Cryptography = scramblइंग।

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: What is the output of a steganography process called?
qh: Steganography प्रक्रिया के output को क्या कहते हैं?
e: The carrier file that now contains the hidden message is called the stego-object.
eh: वह carrier file जिसमें अब छिपा संदेश है, stego-object कहलाती है।
n: Stego terms: cover file (original carrier), secret message (hidden data), stego-object (result).
nh: Stego terms: cover file (original carrier), secret message (hidden data), stego-object (result)।

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: In steganography, the file used to hide the secret data is called:
qh: Steganography में secret data छिपाने के लिए जिस file का उपयोग होता है उसे क्या कहते हैं?
e: The innocent-looking carrier (image/audio/document) that hides the secret data is called the cover file.
eh: वह मासूम दिखने वाली carrier (image/audio/document) जो secret data छिपाती है, cover file कहलाती है।
n: Cover file = the disguise. Secret message = hidden data. Stego-object = cover + secret after embedding.
nh: Cover file = छद्म वेश। Secret message = छिपा data। Stego-object = embedding के बाद cover + secret।

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: Which of the following is an example of asymmetric encryption?
qh: निम्न में से कौन-सा asymmetric encryption का उदाहरण है?
e: RSA is the classic public-key (asymmetric) algorithm; AES, DES and Blowfish are all symmetric.
eh: RSA classic public-key (asymmetric) algorithm है; AES, DES और Blowfish सब symmetric हैं।
n: Asymmetric = RSA, ECC, Diffie-Hellman, DSA. Symmetric = DES, 3DES, AES, Blowfish, RC4, IDEA.
nh: Asymmetric = RSA, ECC, Diffie-Hellman, DSA। Symmetric = DES, 3DES, AES, Blowfish, RC4, IDEA।

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: The data to be encrypted at the sender's site is called ______ and the data to be decrypted at the receiver's end is called ______.
qh: Sender की ओर encrypt किए जाने वाले data को ______ और receiver की ओर decrypt किए जाने वाले data को ______ कहते हैं.
e: मूल data = Plain text; encrypt होने के बाद = Cipher text. Receiver पर cipher text decrypt होकर फिर plain text बनता है.
eh: मूल data = Plain text; encrypt होने के बाद = Cipher text. Receiver पर cipher text decrypt होकर फिर plain text बनता है.
n: याद रखो: Plain (सादा) → encrypt → Cipher (गूँथा) → decrypt → Plain.
nh: याद रखो: Plain (सादा) → encrypt → Cipher (गूँथा) → decrypt → Plain.

st: Section B — Cryptography
q: Suppose everyone in a group of N people wants to communicate secretly with the N−1 others using a symmetric-key cryptographic system. The number of keys required in the system as a whole is:
qh: मान लीजिए N लोगों के समूह में हर व्यक्ति बाकी N−1 लोगों से symmetric-key cryptographic system से गुप्त बातचीत करना चाहता है. कुल कितने keys चाहिए होंगी?
e: Symmetric keys are shared in pairs — one key per pair. N people need N(N−1)/2 pairs.
eh: Symmetric keys जोड़ों में बँटती हैं — हर जोड़े की एक key. N लोगों के जोड़े = N(N−1)/2.
n: GATE key (c). Public-key में यह समस्या नहीं — इसीलिए hybrid systems आए.
nh: GATE key (c). Public-key में यह समस्या नहीं — इसीलिए hybrid systems आए.

st: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
q: What is the advantage of setting up a DMZ (Demilitarized Zone) using a firewall?
qh: Firewall का उपयोग करके DMZ (Demilitarized Zone) बनाने का क्या लाभ है?
o: To create multiple zones of trust
Bringing internet service into a home
oh: To create multiple zones of trust
Bringing internet service into a home
e: A DMZ creates separate trust zones — public servers (web/mail) sit in the DMZ so attackers don't directly reach the internal trusted network.
eh: DMZ अलग trust zones बनाता है — public servers (web/mail) DMZ में रहते हैं ताकि attackers सीधे internal trusted network तक न पहुँचें।
n: Official RPSC key. DMZ = buffer zone between untrusted Internet and trusted LAN (3 zones: external / DMZ / internal).
nh: Official RPSC key। DMZ = untrusted Internet और trusted LAN के बीच buffer zone (3 zones: external / DMZ / internal)।

st: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
q: Match the security mechanisms with their OSI layers: (a) Firewall  (b) Digital Signature  (c) MAC Filtering  (d) Port-based Filtering — (i) Network Layer  (ii) Application Layer  (iii) Data Link Layer  (iv) Transport Layer
qh: Security mechanisms को OSI layers से मिलाइए: (a) Firewall  (b) Digital Signature  (c) MAC Filtering  (d) Port-based Filtering — (i) Network Layer  (ii) Application Layer  (iii) Data Link Layer  (iv) Transport Layer
e: Firewall rules work at the network layer (IP), digital signatures are application-level, MAC filtering is data-link, and port filtering is transport-level (TCP/UDP ports).
eh: Firewall rules network layer (IP) पर, digital signatures application level पर, MAC filtering data-link पर, और port filtering transport level (TCP/UDP ports) पर काम करते हैं।
n: Mechanism-layers: Firewall L3/L4 (IP), Port filter L4, MAC filter L2, Digital signature L7. Packet-filtering firewall = L3/L4.
nh: Mechanism-layers: Firewall L3/L4 (IP), Port filter L4, MAC filter L2, Digital signature L7। Packet-filtering firewall = L3/L4।

st: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
q: Match the security protocols with their OSI layers: (a) IPSec  (b) SSL/TLS  (c) PGP  (d) WPA2 — (i) Application Layer  (ii) Network Layer  (iii) Transport/Presentation Layer  (iv) Data Link Layer (Wi-Fi)
qh: Security protocols को OSI layers से मिलाइए: (a) IPSec  (b) SSL/TLS  (c) PGP  (d) WPA2 — (i) Application Layer  (ii) Network Layer  (iii) Transport/Presentation Layer  (iv) Data Link Layer (Wi-Fi)
e: IPSec secures at the network layer (L3), SSL/TLS at transport/presentation, PGP is an application-layer mail security tool, and WPA2 protects Wi-Fi at the data-link layer.
eh: IPSec network layer (L3) पर, SSL/TLS transport/presentation पर, PGP application-layer mail security tool है, और WPA2 Wi-Fi को data-link layer पर सुरक्षित करता है।
n: Protocol layers: IPSec L3, SSL/TLS L4-7 (exam: transport/presentation), PGP L7, WPA2 L2, Kerberos L7.
nh: Protocol layers: IPSec L3, SSL/TLS L4-7 (exam: transport/presentation), PGP L7, WPA2 L2, Kerberos L7।

st: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
q: IPSec is MOST commonly used to implement:
qh: IPSec मुख्यतः किसके लिए उपयोग होता है?
e: IPSec provides encrypted tunnels over the internet — the foundation of most site-to-site and remote-access VPNs.
eh: IPSec internet पर encrypted tunnels देता है — अधिकांश site-to-site और remote-access VPNs की नींव।
n: IPSec = VPN tunneling (ESP/AH). Secure email = PGP/SMIME. Secure web = SSL/TLS. Wireless = WPA2.
nh: IPSec = VPN tunneling (ESP/AH)। Secure email = PGP/SMIME। Secure web = SSL/TLS। Wireless = WPA2।

st: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
q: IPSec operates in which mode(s)?
qh: IPSec किस/किन mode(s) में काम करता है?
o: Both transport mode and tunnel mode
oh: Both transport mode and tunnel mode
e: IPSec has two modes — transport mode (protects the payload, end-to-end) and tunnel mode (protects the whole IP packet, gateway-to-gateway).
eh: IPSec के दो modes हैं — transport mode (payload सुरक्षित, end-to-end) और tunnel mode (पूरा IP packet सुरक्षित, gateway-to-gateway)।
n: IPSec modes: Transport (payload only, host-to-host) & Tunnel (full packet, gateway-to-gateway/VPN).
nh: IPSec modes: Transport (केवल payload, host-to-host) और Tunnel (पूरा packet, gateway-to-gateway/VPN)।

st: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
q: In IPSec Tunnel mode:
qh: IPSec Tunnel mode में:
o: The entire IP packet is encrypted
oh: The entire IP packet is encrypted
e: Tunnel mode encrypts the ENTIRE original IP packet (header + payload) and adds a new header — used for VPN gateways.
eh: Tunnel mode पूरे original IP packet (header + payload) को encrypt करके नया header जोड़ता है — VPN gateways के लिए उपयोग।
n: Tunnel = whole packet + new header (gateway VPN). Transport = payload only (host-to-host).
nh: Tunnel = पूरा packet + नया header (gateway VPN)। Transport = केवल payload (host-to-host)।

st: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
q: Which mode of IPSec provides end-to-end security between two hosts?
qh: IPSec का कौन-सा mode दो hosts के बीच end-to-end security देता है?
e: Transport mode secures communication directly between two hosts (end-to-end) — only the payload is protected.
eh: Transport mode दो hosts के बीच सीधे संचार सुरक्षित करता है (end-to-end) — केवल payload सुरक्षित होता है।
n: End-to-end (host↔host) = Transport mode. Gateway↔gateway (VPN) = Tunnel mode.
nh: End-to-end (host↔host) = Transport mode। Gateway↔gateway (VPN) = Tunnel mode।

st: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
q: The SSL/TLS handshake protocol is mainly used for:
qh: SSL/TLS handshake protocol मुख्यतः किसके लिए उपयोग होता है?
e: The handshake negotiates cipher suites, authenticates the server (certificates) and exchanges keys for the session.
eh: Handshake cipher suites का निर्णय करता है, server को authenticate करता है (certificates) और session के लिए keys का आदान-प्रदान करता है।
n: TLS parts: Handshake = keys+authentication; Record = encryption+integrity. HTTPS = HTTP over TLS (port 443).
nh: TLS parts: Handshake = keys+authentication; Record = encryption+integrity। HTTPS = HTTP over TLS (port 443)।

st: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
q: Which of the following is used in HTTPS for encryption?
qh: HTTPS में encryption के लिए निम्न में से क्या उपयोग होता है?
e: HTTPS = HTTP over SSL/TLS — the TLS layer encrypts the HTTP traffic (port 443).
eh: HTTPS = HTTP over SSL/TLS — TLS layer HTTP traffic को encrypt करता है (port 443)।
n: HTTPS = HTTP + SSL/TLS (443). HTTP = 80 (no encryption). FTP = 21. ARP = IP→MAC. NAT = address translation.
nh: HTTPS = HTTP + SSL/TLS (443)। HTTP = 80 (encryption नहीं)। FTP = 21। ARP = IP→MAC। NAT = address translation।

st: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
q: In which layer of the network architecture is the Secure Socket Layer (SSL) used?
qh: Secure Socket Layer (SSL) network architecture की किस layer में उपयोग होती है?
e: Exam banks place SSL at the Session layer — it establishes a secure session between application and transport (technically it sits between L4 and L7).
eh: Exam banks SSL को Session layer पर रखते हैं — यह application और transport के बीच secure session बनाती है (तकनीकी रूप से यह L4 और L7 के बीच है)।
n: Exam convention: SSL = Session layer (secure session setup + negotiation). Note: TLS = successor of SSL.
nh: Exam convention: SSL = Session layer (secure session setup + negotiation)। नोट: TLS, SSL का उत्तराधिकारी है।

st: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
q: When a logic bomb is activated by a time-related event, it is known as a:
qh: जब कोई logic bomb किसी समय-संबंधी घटना से सक्रिय होता है, तो उसे कहते हैं:
e: A logic bomb driven by date/time is a Time bomb (like the Friday-13 virus).
eh: समय/तारीख़ से चलने वाला logic bomb = Time bomb (जैसे शुक्रवार-13 वायरस).
n: Logic bomb = code that explodes on a condition; if the condition is time, it is a Time bomb.
nh: Logic bomb = शर्त से फटने वाला कोड; शर्त समय हो तो Time bomb.

st: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
q: Verification based on a login ID and password is called:
qh: Login ID और password के आधार पर जाँच कहलाती है:
e: Checking identity (ID + password) = Authentication. This is the first door of security.
eh: पहचान (ID+password) की जाँच = Authentication. यही सुरक्षा का पहला दरवाज़ा है.
n: Authentication = 'तुम कौन हो?'; Authorization = 'तुम्हें क्या अनुमति है?'.
nh: Authentication = 'तुम कौन हो?'; Authorization = 'तुम्हें क्या अनुमति है?'.

st: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
q: Access control based on a person's fingerprints is an example of:
qh: किसी व्यक्ति की उंगलियों के निशान पर आधारित access control का उदाहरण है:
e: Fingerprints, iris, face — these are all biometric identification.
eh: उंगली-छाप, आँख की पुतली, चेहरा — ये सब biometric identification हैं.
n: Physical identity (biometric) is stronger than something known (password).
nh: ज्ञात (password) से बढ़कर है शारीरिक पहचान (biometric).

st: Section C — Firewalls, IPSec & Security Protocols
q: Which one of the following is a key function of a firewall?
qh: निम्न में से firewall का एक मुख्य काम कौन-सा है?
e: Firewall आने-जाने वाले traffic की monitoring करता है और अनधिकृत पहुँच को रोकता है.
eh: Firewall आने-जाने वाले traffic की monitoring करता है और अनधिकृत पहुँच को रोकता है.
n: BPSC 2024 official key (a). VPN = a private limousine on the public road.
nh: Firewall = network का चौकीदार — देखता है, जाँचता है, रोकता है.

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: Ensuring that data has not been altered in transit relates to which security goal?
qh: यह सुनिश्चित करना कि data रास्ते में बदला नहीं, किस security goal से है?
e: Integrity = data badla na gaya ho.
eh: Integrity = data अपरिवर्तित।
n: Confidentiality = chhupana.
nh: Confidentiality = छिपाना।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: A program that replicates itself across networks without needing a host file is a:
qh: वह program जो बिना host file के network पर खुद की प्रतियाँ बनाता है:
e: Worm khud spread hota hai; virus ko host file chahiye.
eh: Worm खुद फैलता है; virus को host चाहिए।
n: Trojan nakli software ban kar aata hai.
nh: Trojan नक़ली software।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: Eavesdropping on network traffic is which type of attack?
qh: Network traffic की जासूसी कौन-सा attack है?
e: Snoop/sunna = passive (data badalta nahi).
eh: सुनना = passive।
n: Modification = active.
nh: बदलाव = active।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: Sending a fake e-mail that appears to come from a bank to steal passwords is called:
qh: बैंक के नाम से नक़ली e-mail भेजकर password चुराना कहलाता है:
e: Phishing = nakli identity se secrets churana.
eh: Phishing = धोखे से चोरी।
n: Spoofing nakli address; sniffing sunna.
nh: Spoofing नक़ली पहचान; sniffing सुनना।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: Flooding a server with so many requests that legitimate users cannot use it is a:
qh: Server को इतने requests से भर देना कि असली users न चला सकें:
e: Denial of Service = availability par hamla.
eh: DoS = availability पर हमला।
n: Confidentiality par interception hota hai.
nh: Interception confidentiality पर।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: A SYN flood (denial-of-service) attack exploits which part of network communication?
qh: SYN flood (denial-of-service) attack संचार के किस भाग का दुरुपयोग करता है?
e: Attacker dheron SYN bhejta hai — server har ek ke liye half-open connection banata hai (SYN-RECV) aur resources khatam ho jaate hain.
eh: Attacker ढेरों SYN भेजता है — server की half-open connections से resources खत्म होती हैं।
n: ARP spoofing = cache poisoning; ICMP flood = echo requests — alag attacks.
nh: ARP spoofing = cache poisoning; ICMP flood = echo — अलग attacks।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: A honeypot in network security is:
qh: Network security में honeypot होता है:
o: A decoy system set up to attract attackers and study their activity
A firewall rule that blocks all traffic
oh: एक प्रलोभन (decoy) system जो attackers को आकर्षित कर उनकी गतिविधि अध्ययन करता है
सभी traffic रोकने वाला firewall rule
e: Honeypot = jaal jaisa fake system/data — attackers usme fass kar apne tools/tarike dikha dete hain; defenders ko intelligence milti hai.
eh: Honeypot = जाल जैसा decoy system — attackers अपने तरीके दिखा देते हैं।
n: Firewall rokta hai; honeypot fasata hai aur seekhata hai.
nh: Firewall रोकता है; honeypot फँसाता और सिखाता है।

st: Section A — Security Goals & Attacks
q: A shadow honeypot combines a honeypot with:
qh: Shadow honeypot जोड़ता है honeypot के साथ:
o: An anomaly detection system (suspect traffic is run inside the honeypot)
oh: Anomaly detection system (संदिग्ध traffic को honeypot के अंदर चलाया जाता है)
